jobs.title: Commercial and Industrial - Outreach Manager II
jobs.description: Franklin Energy is redefining the clean energy future as the only integrated provider of comprehensive solutions, combining unmatched expertise in strategic consulting, program delivery, product solutions, and design/build services. Powered by our advanced AI\-driven technology platforms, we deliver seamless, tech\-driven support across the entire energy service ecosystem to accelerate impactful change and ensure an unmatched customer experience. Since 1994, Franklin Energy has been a trusted partner in protecting communities and our planet, paving the way for a sustainable future for all. Learn more at www.franklinenergy.com and join us in leading the clean energy revolution. POSITION SUMMARY The Outreach Manager II is primarily responsible for providing management and leadership to a team of Energy Advisors, Outreach Specialists, and Energy Engineers who are assigned to one of the company’s energy efficiency programs. This position will also provide energy advice and coordination services for customers. Identify opportunities regarding energy efficiency and introduce the various prescriptive and custom incentive measures that pertain to the customer segment. The position requires coordination with the Management to ensure that outreach processes are implemented efficiently, and that all communication with other programs/departments is conducted properly and timely. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES This list of duties and responsibilities is not all\-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time. Management Responsibilities * Directly supervise and mentor the Outreach team, specifically the Energy Advisors, Outreach Specialists, and Energy Engineers (Sales focused). * Interview, recommend for hire and train employees as needed * Plan, coach, assign and direct work as well as review job contributions, conduct performance reviews and reward and discipline employees as necessary * Achieve program objectives by maintaining productivity standards and goals, including property assessment, production installation, and customer service rates and results * Improve customer service quality results by studying, evaluating, and re\-designing processes, establishing and communicating service metrics, monitoring and analyzing results, and implementing changes * Coordinate with the Technology department by detecting and diagnosing software problems, provide guidance for corrective action and software program enhancements * Research, organize and summarize data for special projects. Develop, evaluate, recommend and implement procedures for data gathering, management and quality control. Analyze data for trends and/or conclusions. * Prepare status reports on program outreach progress and results. In conjunction with the Technology department, help develop, enhance and maintain information systems to support program operations reporting requirements. * Develop and monitor the Outreach team structure in order to accomplish monthly, quarterly and annual goals, along with managing short\-and long\-range planning * Responsible for the operational and department budget, budget monitoring and strategic planning of the Outreach programs and initiatives Outreach Responsibilities * Oversee and, as needed, perform daily outreach duties on programs * Establish a clear vision and direction for programs, including programs in different states, audiences, and specific user groups * Establish and direct outreach programs to meet customer goals * Identify and establish new program and outreach opportunities including coordination with client * Evaluate and strengthen existing processes to achieve program participation and revenue goals, including the establishment of integrated evaluations to allow for ongoing review of all outreach aspects * Coordinate and review with client all external communication pieces for brand, editing, and consistency. This includes mass distribution letters, e\-blasts, faxes, statement stuffers, and any other external communication pieces * Collaborate with the Client Marketing department to coordinate PR and marketing opportunities for programs * Develop, maintain and promote positive and professional relationships with client, internal staff, customers and the general public POSITION REQUIREMENTS Education and Experience * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university or equivalent experience. Technical school degree combined with demonstrated experience in the electric/gas utility field will be considered when deciding on this position. * 5\+ years of experience within customer outreach/sales * Previous experience performing customer outreach initiatives with an energy efficiency program * Previous experience managing staff performing proactive customer outreach activities Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities * Strong customer service and communication skills. * Must be able to handle a wide work variety and work in a fast\-paced environment. * Must be a detail\-oriented, organized, self\-starter, and have an ability to prioritize workload * Ability to identify and resolve project application issues with customers and trade allies * Proficient in Microsoft Office, specifically Word, Excel and Outlook * Strong data entry skills in entering information in tracking systems/databases * Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing with customers, clients and employees * Ability to analyze and interpret data and solve practical problems * Knowledge of mathematical concepts such as fractions, percentages and ratios * Committed to diversity and inclusion * Reliable transportation Licenses \& Certifications * Valid driver’s license Travel Requirements * Willingness to travel up to 40% **Compensation \& Benefits:** Franklin Energy reasonably expects the starting salary for this position to fall between $90,000 and $103,000 Annully. The final offer will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, geographic location, and business needs. Franklin Energy offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits; paid time off; paid holidays; and other company\-sponsored benefits and programs. **Note:** Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position. The above information describes the general duties and requirements necessary to perform the principle functions of the position. This shall not be construed as a detailed description of all the duties and requirements that may be necessary in this position. An Equal Opportunity Employer **Safety \-Sensitive Role Addendum:** Because many roles at Franklin Energy involve regulatory compliance, safety responsibilities, or professional licensing requirements, it is critical that interview responses reflect the candidate’s direct knowledge and experience. Misrepresentation of technical or safety qualifications may result in immediate removal from consideration. **Notice Regarding Automated Tools:** We may use automated or AI\-assisted tools as part of our candidate evaluation process to assess job\-related skills and qualifications. These tools are intended to support fair and consistent review and do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions. All evaluations are conducted in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws.

jobs.title: Controls and Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **What you'll do:** Candidate will be an employee of the Automation group supporting the manufacturing of optical fiber. This individual will provide technical support in the area of PC and PLC based controls and automation for improvement projects and production support. \*\*Principle Functional Responsibilities: \*\* Develop and maintain PLC programs utilized by production and facilities to control manufacturing processes and support equipment. Provide controls and automation support for the manufacturing of optical fiber. Work with the technical staff to resolve daily production issues related to equipment or control software. Support the commissioning of new equipment for production. Ensure proper backups of all programs and critical support files are maintained per plant standards. Comply with all applicable safety procedures and ISO 45001 / ISO 14001 HSE guidelines. Other duties as assigned by supervisor or a member of management. **Who are we looking for?** **Qualifications:** * B.S. in Engineering or Computer Science * Experience with programming Rockwell (Allen\-Bradley), Schneider, and/or Siemens PLC’s * Excellent technical problem\-solving skills * Ability to contribute to the plant's culture of continuous improvement * Excellent communication skills * Detail and quality oriented * Ability to work with little supervision **Preferred:** * Experience in fiber optic or other highly automated manufacturing process * Experience in PLC programming utilizing IEC programming languages including Ladder, Sequential function charts, Structured text, and Function Block Diagrams * Experience with Profibus, Ethernet and Modbus\+ communication protocols * Experience in programming HMI Software with PC to PLC transactions and PC to Database transactions * Experience in programming servo drives and motion controllers

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.** **Job Title: Senior Data Engineer****Role Summary** We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and data platforms supporting analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases. The ideal candidate has strong hands\-on experience with Snowflake on AWS, Python\-based ETL/ELT development, and enterprise scheduling/orchestration tools like Control\-M, along with legacy/enterprise ETL experience in IBM DataStage. You will collaborate across engineering, analytics, and business teams in an Agile delivery model.**Key Responsibilities*** Design, develop, and maintain end\-to\-end data pipelines (batch and near real\-time) using Snowflake, AWS services, and Python. * Build and optimize data models in Snowflake (e.g., dimensional modeling, data vault, or curated data marts) for analytics and downstream consumption. * Develop and maintain ETL/ELT workflows using Python and IBM DataStage; migrate/modernize workloads where applicable. * Implement job scheduling, monitoring, and operational support using Control\-M (alerting, retries, SLAs, and dependency management). * Ensure data quality, governance, lineage, and documentation standards are met across pipelines. * Perform performance tuning and cost optimization across Snowflake and AWS (query optimization, clustering, warehouse sizing, storage management). * Partner with stakeholders (Data Science/AI, BI, Product, and Platform teams) to enable data products and AI\-ready datasets. * Participate in Agile ceremonies, contribute to estimation, planning, and sprint execution; follow SDLC and change management processes. * Troubleshoot production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and drive preventative improvements. **Required Technical Skills*** **Snowflake:** Strong expertise in Snowflake architecture, SQL development, performance tuning, security/roles, data loading/unloading, and best practices. * **AWS:** Hands\-on experience with AWS data ecosystem (commonly S3, IAM, CloudWatch; plus services such as Glue, Lambda, EC2, Step Functions, EMR, or Kinesis as applicable). * **Python:** Strong Python programming for data engineering (ETL/ELT frameworks, API ingestion, automation, unit testing, logging). * **Control\-M:** Experience designing and managing enterprise job scheduling, dependencies, calendars, SLAs, monitoring, and incident handling. * **IBM DataStage:** Solid experience building and maintaining DataStage jobs, handling complex transformations, and supporting production workloads. * **SQL:** Advanced SQL skills for transformations, optimization, and data validation across large datasets. * **CI/CD \& Version Control:** Experience with Git and CI/CD practices for data pipelines (tools may vary). * **Operational Excellence:** Monitoring, alerting, and production support experience in a 24x7 or business\-critical environment. **Good to Have*** **AI/ML exposure:** Experience enabling AI/ML pipelines or feature datasets; familiarity with ML lifecycle concepts, feature engineering, or MLOps tools/processes. * Experience with **data governance/metadata** tools and practices (catalog, lineage, data quality frameworks). * Exposure to **streaming** or event\-driven architectures. **Required Soft Skills*** Strong experience working in **Agile/Scrum** teams and delivering within structured **SDLC** processes. * Excellent **communication** skills (technical and non\-technical) with the ability to explain complex data concepts clearly. * Proven ability to **coordinate across multiple teams** (Data Engineering, Data Science, DevOps, Security, BI, and business stakeholders). * Strong ownership mindset, problem\-solving ability, and attention to detail. **Qualifications (Typical)*** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). * 9\+ years of data engineering experience, including enterprise\-grade data platform delivery and production support. **Kaleidoscope, an Infosys Company, is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, spouse of protected veteran, or disability.**

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: ### Our Mission Salt AI is building the intelligence layer for the enterprise, starting with life sciences, financial services, and the energy sector. In a world where AI is fragmented across models, tools, and data silos, Salt unifies them through a compliance\-first orchestration platform that lets regulated organizations deploy AI securely, at scale, and with confidence. We're creating the backend systems that power real\-world AI workflows across a multitude of industries where out\-of\-the\-box consumer tools don't cut it. Our platform turns complex, regulated environments into intelligent, adaptive systems where autonomous AI agents operate in harmony with existing infrastructure. ### About the Role As a Deployment Strategist, you own our most strategic enterprise deployments end to end — from initial scoping through production go\-live and customer self\-sufficiency. Reporting to the Chief Customer Officer, you'll work with leading pharma, biotech, investment banking, and energy enterprises deploying Salt into demanding SaaS, VPC, and on\-prem environments. This is a senior, judgment\-heavy role. You define what we're building, negotiate what we're not, direct the Forward Deployed Engineers and Customer Solutions Engineers assigned to your accounts, and hold the line when a customer pushes to expand scope mid\-engagement. You'll keep engagement detail current in our existing AI\-first project management flow (Slack Notion Linear), where engineers groom their own tickets — so your time goes to scoping and direction, not ticket administration. You'll deliver highly technical projects on time, on budget, and above expectation. You'll guide customers through the process, manage expectations, manage internal resources to successful delivery, and collaborate with sales to guide them towards expansion opportunities. ### The Role (What You'll Be Doing) **Scope** * Scope engagements down to one or two named workflows with fixed timelines, and drive customer stakeholders to converge on them quickly. Define the engagement exit before work begins: what customer self\-sufficiency looks like, written down and agreed. * Own the SOW Approval Gate on new and expansion business — no contract or SOW goes to a customer without your sign\-off on scope, timeline, and capacity, including the authority to decline out\-of\-scope asks from senior customer stakeholders. * Partner with Sales on expansion: they lead the pursuit, you control what can be committed on scope, timeline, and capacity. **Execute** * Build and run the engagement plan: milestones, workstreams, owners, and dependencies across Salt and customer teams, with a weekly cadence that surfaces slippage early. * Drive customer\-side dependencies to closure — data access, security and IT reviews, environment provisioning, and stakeholder availability — where enterprise deployments most often stall. * Manage risks, issues, and escalations proactively, and escalate early, internally or to the customer sponsor. * Own delivery quality: acceptance criteria and evals agreed at scoping, testing and validation (including GxP where applicable), and production readiness through go\-live and hypercare. * Lead enablement: training, documentation, and change management so customer teams can run the workflows themselves. * Track effort, budget, and capacity across your accounts, and flag early when an engagement is at risk on timeline or cost. **Lead, Grow \& Build** * Provide leadership, prioritization, and technical direction to the Forward Deployed Engineers and Customer Solutions Engineers assigned to your accounts. * Lead executive communication with customer sponsors throughout the engagement lifecycle. * Stay engaged after go\-live on the technical outcome, adoption depth and scoping the next workflow. Sales owns the account relationship and review cadence. * Run post\-engagement debriefs and drive field learning back into product and platform priorities. * Build reusable delivery patterns — templates, integration components, and reference architectures that make each subsequent engagement faster. * Work with the account's Executive Advisor to bring domain expertise into scoping and validate outputs where correctness depends on it. ### Requirements \- Core Skills (Must Have) * 5\+ years owning complex enterprise technical deployments end to end — as a forward deployed engineer, technical program manager, solutions architect, or delivery lead at a technical consultancy or enterprise software company. * Delivery execution: a track record running multi\-workstream enterprise deployments to on\-time go\-live, where much of the critical path sat on the customer side. * Technical fluency: enough depth in cloud architecture, APIs, data pipelines, and integration patterns to scope work credibly and direct engineers without needing translation. Engineering or technical background required. * Scope discipline: demonstrated ability to hold a line against pressure from senior stakeholders, and the judgment to know when holding is right. * Written communication and document hygiene: scopes, exit criteria, and decisions live in writing, not in your head. * Executive presence: credible in the room with VP\- and C\-level customer sponsors at large enterprises. * Comfort with ambiguity: our customers often don't know their highest\-value use case when we arrive, and finding it is part of the job. * Willingness to travel as\-needed for client implementation work. ### Preferred/Bonus Skills (Nice To Have) * Experience with on\-premise, VPC, or air\-gapped deployments in regulated industries — pharma, life sciences, financial services, or government. * Familiarity with GxP, HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar compliance and validation frameworks. * Background at a company running a forward deployed engineering model. * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML workflows, model deployment, or agent orchestration. * Track record turning one\-off engagements into repeatable delivery motions. ### What Makes You A Great Fit * You measure success by whether the customer is actually using what you built — not whether it shipped. * You'd rather say no early than deliver a bloated engagement late. * You run a tight operating rhythm: everyone knows what's happening this week, what's at risk, and who owns it. * You're energized by walking into a messy enterprise environment and finding the one workflow that matters most. * You're comfortable being the most senior person in the room on delivery, and the person accountable when it goes sideways. * You want to build the function, not just work in it — this is the first Deployment Strategist at Salt, and the patterns you set become how we operate. * You're excited to apply your skills to AI in life sciences, financial services, and the energy sector where you can support teams doing high\-impact work. ### Perks And Benefits * Competitive salary based on location and experience. * Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, dental, mental health. * Fully remote role, collaborating primarily within U.S. time zones. **Based in Southern California, Salt AI is pioneering the future of life sciences with advanced AI. Founded in 2024 by Aber Whitcomb and Jim Benedetto—veterans of MySpace, Jam City, Gravity, and Core Scientific—our leadership team brings over 15 years of collaboration. We’re not just building products, but transforming what’s possible in research and discovery. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to an inclusive team. If you’re excited about shaping the future of AI in life sciences, we'd love to connect with you.**

jobs.title: Drilling Operations Coordinator
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** MAK Drilling is the geotechnical drilling division of MAK Construction and one of the fastest\-growing parts of the company. From Grand Forks we run soil borings, rock coring and subsurface exploration for the engineering firms behind data centers, substations, transmission lines and highways across more than 14 states. We went from one rig to four in eighteen months, a fifth comes online this fall, and we have the work to keep adding. The office has not kept pace with the field. That is the job. The Drilling Operations Coordinator runs the drilling back office so the drilling manager can run the drilling. You own the phone line and the bid inbox, get every bid out, know where every crew is and when they are due home, get invoices out and paid, keep our trucks and drivers legal in every state we work in, and take new hires from applicant to job site. You manage the drilling admin and report to the drilling manager every day. You do not need drilling experience; we will teach you the drilling. What we cannot teach is hustle. This fits someone direct, organized and quick, who is comfortable calling a customer's accounts\-payable desk and a driller in Wyoming in the same hour, learns fast, and does not need to be reminded. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Answer the drilling line and the bid inbox, route everything the same day, and send the drilling manager an end\-of\-day recap. * Build bids from our template and price sheet, get pricing approval, and send them within two business days. * Set up every awarded job: work order, boring plan, 811 locate ticket, crew packet, calendar and map. Keep customer W\-9s, portals, purchase orders and certificates of insurance current. * Keep the master rig and crew schedule and the crew rotation calendar, published weekly. Book lodging and travel, order parts and supplies, arrange equipment moves. * Invoice within three business days of the field log closing, follow up at 30, 60 and 90 days, and tie out receivables weekly with our bookkeeping team. * Review daily logs and roll up per diem, hours, footage and mileage for payroll. * Keep driller and helper postings live, run first\-pass screening calls, and run onboarding end to end: payroll, benefits, drug test, DOT file, devices and app access. * Own DOT compliance: driver files, medical cards, drug and alcohol testing, inspections, IFTA, permits and registrations, plus a state\-by\-state checklist for every state we work in. * Maintain the equipment register and maintenance tracker, keep the drilling SharePoint organized, and write down the processes as you build them. * Manage the drilling admin with daily priorities and a weekly check\-in. **EXPERIENCE NEEDED** * At least two to three years running an office or coordinating operations, ideally in a field business (construction, trucking, oilfield, agriculture or similar). This is not an entry\-level seat. * A go\-getter who takes ownership and follows through without reminders. * Comfortable on the phone with customers, field crews and engineers. * Working knowledge of invoicing and receivables. * Strong in Excel and Microsoft 365, and willing to use AI tools daily. * Able to manage another person. * Valid driver's license and able to pass a background check. **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** * Drilling, environmental or heavy civil background. * DOT and FMCSA compliance experience. * QuickBooks and customer portal experience (Coupa, Oracle). * Grand Forks area. **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS** Competitive salary based on experience, with quarterly bonus potential tied to a weekly scorecard. Health insurance after 60 days with 50 percent of the employee premium covered, a company\-paid $50,000 life insurance policy, supplemental dental, vision, disability and accident plans, a 401(k) after 90 days with up to a 4 percent match, paid time off, five paid holidays, and weekly pay. Pay: $20\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour Expected hours: No less than 40\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Engineer in Training-Dallas/Fort Worth, TX
jobs.description: Certerra is a growing national provider of testing, inspection, and certification services that support innovation in new product development, quality assurance, for project delivery, and engineered solutions for asset management. We are passionate about contributing to the sustainable development of the communities we serve. We are a national firm with a global reach serving national and international clients from 30\+ offices located in 10 states and are ranked on ENR’s Top 500 list alongside the nation’s top firms. With a 60\-year history, Certerra has a passion for high\-end services, constant innovation, and investment in the development of world\-class laboratory facilities, and interactive management technologies. Each member of our staff is committed to service, innovation, and the success of our clients. We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented **Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT)** to join our civil engineering team. This entry\-level position is ideal for a recent civil engineering graduate who is preparing to take the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam. The EIT will support project engineers and senior staff in the planning, design, and execution of infrastructure and development projects. **Key Responsibilities*** Assist in the design and analysis of civil engineering projects, including site development, drainage, roadway, and utility systems * Prepare engineering calculations, drawings, specifications, and technical reports * Support the development of construction documents using CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD Civil 3D) * Conduct site visits to observe construction progress and gather field data * Assist with project permitting, regulatory compliance, and coordination with local agencies * Perform quantity takeoffs, cost estimates, and basic project analysis * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including surveyors, planners, and environmental specialists * Maintain organized project documentation and ensure accuracy of data **Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from an accredited university (recent graduate preferred) * Actively preparing for or scheduled to take the **Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam** * Strong understanding of civil engineering principles, including structural, transportation, or water resources fundamentals * Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D or similar design software is preferred * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills * Ability to work both independently and as part of a team **Preferred Qualifications*** Internship or co\-op experience in civil engineering * Exposure to design standards such as AASHTO, TxDOT, or local municipal guidelines * Familiarity with hydrology/hydraulics software (e.g., HEC\-RAS, HEC\-HMS) **Professional Development*** Support and mentorship toward obtaining **Professional Engineer (PE) licensure** * Opportunities for training, continuing education, and career advancement * Hands\-on experience across a variety of civil engineering disciplines **Work Environment*** Combination of office\-based design work and occasional field/site visits * Collaborative team setting with guidance from experienced engineers *We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. This Company is dedicated to both the letter and the spirit of the equal opportunity employment laws. All applicants and all employees will be evaluated based on their ability, competence, and performance of the essential functions of their positions. There will be no discrimination based on race, sex, national origin, religion, age 40 and over, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other classification which may be protected by federal, state, or local laws. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, we specifically offer equal opportunity for all employees or job applicants who may have a physical or mental disability. Such people will be hired based on their ability to perform the essential functions of the job in question. Likewise, their work will be evaluated on their performance of these essential functions. We will offer reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities, to the extent that Company resources allow* *without undue hardship. As part of our equal employment policy, there will be no wage differentials based on gender, between men and women employed in the same establishment, on jobs that require equal skill, effort, and responsibility, and which are performed under similar working conditions.*

jobs.title: Implementation Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ You will own how Cascade actually works for each customer. You're the person who understands both the product internals and the customer's real environment well enough to make them fit together. end to end — scoping, integration, configuration, data setup, testing, and launch — and stay accountable for them in production. * Work directly with each customer's team to understand their systems, constraints, and goals, then translate that into a working Cascade deployment. * Write and ship the code, integrations, and custom configuration required to make each implementation succeed. * Debug and resolve issues in customer environments, and feed recurring problems back to product and engineering. * Join late\-stage sales calls to present real customer implementations to prospects — walking through what we built, the outcomes, and how it maps to their situation. * Build reusable tooling, templates, and playbooks so each new implementation is faster than the last. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Strong engineering fundamentals — you can build and ship production integrations independently, not just configure a UI. * Direct customer\-facing experience: you're jobs.title: Principal
jobs.description: CVector’s mission is to bring real time economic optimization and AI prediction to every energy and manufacturing plant. Industrial facilities make decisions every minute that determine cost, reliability, and margin, but the signals that matter live in different worlds: live asset constraints and process reality on one side, feedstock prices, product prices, demand, and market dynamics on the other. We fuse those worlds into one decision layer that continuously forecasts what is coming, simulates what could happen, and optimizes what to do next, so plants can run closer to their true economic potential every day. This position works from our **New York City office four days per week**. CVector has customers across the United States and operates real\-world systems in demanding industrial environments. Role Overview As a Principal, you will play a critical role in evolving CVector’s core backend platform. You will work on time\-series data systems, AI\-assisted analytics, cloud infrastructure, and data ingestion pipelines that power our customer\-facing applications and internal modeling platforms. This role is well\-suited for an engineer who enjoys working close to the data and infrastructure layers, has strong architectural judgment, and is excited to operate across AI systems, databases, and distributed backend services. You will take ownership of complex systems, drive major technical migrations, and help shape how intelligence is embedded into industrial energy workflows. You will collaborate closely with product, modeling, and frontend engineers, and you will have significant influence over platform direction, reliability, and long\-term scalability. Why This Role Matters This role sits at the intersection of AI systems, time\-series data, and real\-world energy infrastructure. Your work will directly impact system reliability, customer trust, and CVector’s ability to scale intelligent energy management across industries. If you enjoy solving deep backend problems, shaping platform foundations, and embedding intelligence into physical systems, this role offers both technical challenge and real\-world impact. **Requirements** Our current technology stack includes **Python**, **TypeScript**, **Supabase**, **PostgreSQL**, **MQTT**, **TigerData**, **AWS**, and **GitHub**\-based CI/CD workflows. A strong candidate will: * Show how they have left their fingerprint on your corner of the industry, ambitious to do it again * Have a decade or more of experience building and operating production backend systems * Have built and maintained multiple generations of distributed systems * Be tracking the latest developments in agentic system design, ready to grow a leading edge system of their own **Benefits** CVector provides team members with: * A competitive compensation package with meaningful equity upside * A robust selection of health, dental, and vision insurance options * Optional Health Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Unlimited PTO with a three week minimum per year, plus additional sick days * Top of the line work equipment and IT setup, including high performance laptops and a modern developer stack * Unlimited access to the latest AI agent systems and productivity tools to help you move faster and build better * Visa support for candidates currently based in the US, including employer sponsored visa applications where applicable

jobs.title: Senior Bioinformatics Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Title:** Senior Bioinformatics Engineer **Reports To:** Director, Computational Genomics **Job Status:** Exempt **Supervisory Responsibilities:** None Position Summary The Senior Bioinformatics Engineer works at cohort scale — systematically analyzing large collections of complete, personal human genomes across all variant types, including structural variation and difficult\-to\-sequence regions, and building the high\-performance platform and applications that make that analysis possible. Operating as a senior individual contributor, the successful candidate pairs strong software\-engineering practice with scientific rigor to turn assembly\-based, cohort\-scale genome data into reliable research and diagnostic capabilities. This is a hands\-on, application\-driven role. The successful candidate designs and builds efficient, reproducible tools and pipelines; drives research and diagnostic applications such as biomarker discovery, missing\-heritability studies for complex disease, and oncology analysis; and applies AI and machine\-learning methods to process and interpret large cohorts more efficiently. They bring disciplined engineering, careful validation, and scientific rigor to everything they build, make and defend sound technical choices with limited oversight, and thrive amid the ambiguity of a fast\-moving startup environment, working closely with peers across the team. Position Responsibilities Cohort\-Scale Genome and Variant Evaluation * Systematically evaluate large cohorts of human genomes across all variant types — SNVs, indels, structural variants, and other complex events — derived directly from personal, de novo genome assemblies, with particular attention to difficult\-to\-sequence and difficult\-to\-map regions. * Develop and apply metrics and quality frameworks to assess the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of variant calls across the cohort. * High\-Performance Cohort Genome Analysis Platform * Contribute to the engineering work of building a high\-performance platform for cohort\-scale, complete\-genome analysis, and assist with its maintenance and continuing improvement. * Help keep the platform scalable, reproducible, and efficient as cohort size and data volume grow. Research and Diagnostic Applications * Drive research and diagnostic applications built on extensive cohorts of complete human genomes, supporting biomarker discovery, missing\-heritability studies for complex disease, and oncology applications. * Collaborate with scientists, clinicians, and cross\-functional teams to translate cohort\-scale findings into research insight and diagnostic value. AI for Genomics at Cohort Scale * Apply AI and machine\-learning methods to genomics to improve the efficiency of processing and interpreting large cohorts, working closely with peers across the team. * Explore and evaluate AI approaches that help extract biological and clinical insight from complete\-genome cohort data at scale. Applied Research and Continuous Improvement * Conduct scientific study and review the most recent literature, and drive toward applications by turning promising methods and findings into practical tools, analyses, and improvements. * Identify inefficient algorithms or code and improve them when necessary, performing analyses to evaluate and compare alternative approaches on representative data. * Adopt and adapt new computational technologies and software\-engineering tools and practices to keep the platform, methods, and codebase current, efficient, and maintainable. Required Qualifications * M.S. or Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Genomics, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience (or Ph.D. plus 3\+ years) in large\-scale genome analysis, including whole\-genome and pangenome projects. * Extensive prior experience in genome research (not limited to human genomes), and a willingness to apply and extend those skills — and learn new techniques — for human\-scale genome analysis. * Proven ability to scope, design, build, and operate production\-grade, end\-to\-end bioinformatics pipelines with minimal guidance, taking accountability for their correctness, scalability, reproducibility, and performance in high\-throughput and high\-performance computing and cloud environments. * Deep, current understanding of state\-of\-the\-art bioinformatics algorithms across genome assembly, variant calling, structural\-variant calling, haplotype phasing, and pangenome analysis, with the judgment to select, adapt, and benchmark them appropriately rather than applying them off the shelf — the level of expertise the team can treat as a go\-to resource. * Strong software engineering foundations: proficiency in Python (and ideally a compiled language such as C/C\+\+, Rust, or Go), version control, automated testing, containerization (Docker / Singularity), and workflow managers (Nextflow, Snakemake, or WDL). * An independent generalist who thrives in a startup environment — comfortable working with minimal direction across a broad range of tasks, taking ownership of problems from start to finish, and adapting quickly to a fast pace and rapidly changing requirements while prioritizing the most immediate needs. * A track record of elevating a team by developing others — using prior experience to mentor entry\-level and mid\-level staff toward independent, high\-quality work through teaching, design and code review, and stepping in directly only when necessary — rather than through direct management. Preferred (Not Required) * Hands\-on experience with long\-read sequencing (PacBio HiFi, Oxford Nanopore) and modern pangenome tooling (e.g., minigraph\-cactus, vg, pggb). * Experience in oncology / cancer genomics, immunogenomics, neoantigen prediction, HLA or immune\-receptor biology, or pharmacogenomics. * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS / GCP) and optimizing genome\-scale workloads for cost and performance. * Contributions to open\-source bioinformatics tools or methods. * Experience supporting regulated, clinical, or translational genomics programs. Work Environment This position operates in a highly collaborative genomics and laboratory environment and may require interaction with laboratory operations, software engineering, bioinformatics, and leadership teams. Hybrid or onsite presence may be required based on operational needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. *This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee.* Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, B2B Platform Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, B2B Platform Infrastructure** **Remote (US) \| Full\-time** **Compensation is based on experience.** **No visa sponsorships are available for this position.** ***To be considered, you must apply using the link provided.*** https://form.jotform.com/262706443090151 Incomplete or missing application forms will not be considered. **About us** We are a vertically integrated telehealth company: in addition to operating the software platform, we do our own pharmaceutical manufacturing through our compounding pharmacy. Our current focus is GLP\-1 medications, with expansion underway into additional product categories. The company launched in January and is growing quickly, with both a direct\-to\-consumer arm and a B2B arm serving healthcare partners. Our pharmacy is expanding from 2,200 to 14,000 square feet in February to support the growth ahead, and as we scale we expect to deepen our vertical integration further, including eventually rebuilding our compounding pharmacy software in\-house. Because we own the pharmacy, the software you write here drives real\-world fulfillment end to end. The core mission: embed our clinical protocols in software so the platform can serve demand at the scale of tens of thousands of prescriptions per month, for partners of every size, from hospitals to small clinics. This is a product and infrastructure role, not a growth or analytics role. You will build the systems that take a patient from intake through clinical review, prescribing, payment, and pharmacy fulfillment, along with the partner\-facing APIs and portals that let other healthcare businesses run their programs on our platform. **Representative work includes:** * Partner\-facing APIs and integrations that let clinics and health systems plug into the platform * Order orchestration: the multi\-step workflows connecting intake, physician review, payment, and pharmacy routing * Clinical protocol logic encoded in software, such as dosing programs, titration schedules, and eligibility rules * Patient, physician, admin, and pharmacy\-facing web applications * The reliability and infrastructure work that keeps everything running as volume grows **Our stack** TypeScript end to end: a pnpm/Turborepo monorepo with independently deployable microservices on AWS ECS, infrastructure as code in Terraform, Postgres, Stripe, and React frontends. Experience with every piece is not required, but you should be comfortable owning services across the full stack. What we're looking for * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with real ownership of production systems * Strong TypeScript/Node.js skills and solid instincts for API and data\-model design * Experience building multi\-step, failure\-tolerant backend workflows (payments, orders, fulfillment, or similar) * Comfort with AWS and infrastructure as code, or the ability to ramp up quickly * High integrity: this is healthcare, and patients and clinicians depend on what we ship * Strong work ethic and a bias to ship; this is a small team with a lot of autonomy from day one **Bonus points** * Interest in longevity, health optimization, or peptide science (adjacent to our core product area, but not required) * Experience in healthcare, telehealth, pharmacy, or another regulated industry * Experience building B2B platforms or partner\-facing API products **Benefits** * Medical insurance * Dental insurance * Vision insurance * Equity opportunity Why join The platform has been under heavy construction since early this year and is far along. You would be joining a small engineering team right as the B2B business comes online, with a growing partner pipeline and a pharmacy expansion landing in February. It is a rare chance to shape core infrastructure at a company's inflection point rather than maintain someone else's decisions. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

Strategy * **Pricing \& packaging:** build and maintain deal models (costs, margin, resourcing) and help structure complex enterprise deals * **Segmentation \& planning:** define ICP/segmentation, learn from wins/losses, and feed market/customer signal into product \+ GTM planning * **Commercial systems:** turn bespoke deal requirements into repeatable tooling and workflows (calculator, approvals, handoffs) so the team moves faster Operations * **Contracting \& deal desk:** run contracts end\-to\-end (NDA MSA/DPA/order forms), manage outside counsel \+ redlines, and scale templates/approvals for non\-standard terms * **Engagements \& deployments:** coordinate scoping, staffing, timelines, and the path to production (security reviews, questionnaires, cloud access, vendor onboarding) * **Compliance \& systems:** build intake/tracking \+ contract repository; keep SOC 2/ISO evidence and vendor/policy workflows current * **GTM ops \& reporting:** keep CRM/GTM tools clean, build the operating cadence/reporting leaders use, and take on high\-impact projects that don’t yet have a clear owner **What we're looking for** * Strong modeling skills and the judgment * Experience designing pricing, sales compensation, or GTM plans, not only analyzing them * Comfort reading contracts and understanding what a clause means for the business * A strong operator who creates structure out of ambiguity and keeps many threads moving without dropping any of them * Clear, careful writing and good judgment about when to escalate * Real interest in AI, including how our technology works, where a model runs and what data it touches, and how compute costs and model economics shape a business **Strong candidates also have** * Experience at a usage based, consumption, or infrastructure company with a technical sales motion * Experience with enterprise procurement, security reviews, or data protection agreements * Training in consulting, banking, law, or growth investing, followed by time in an operating role at a startup * Comfort with SQL or working directly with data * AI built into your own analytical workflow, or internal tools and automations you've built to take work off your own plate The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time position is **$120,000–$240,000**. Total compensation for this role also includes meaningful equity in a fast\-growing startup, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both personally and professionally. Base salary is determined by a range of factors including individual qualifications, experience, skills, interview performance, market data, and work location. The listed salary range is intended as a guideline and may be adjusted. **About us** ============ Applied Compute builds Specific Intelligence for the enterprise. We provide the continual learning infrastructure for companies to build agent workforces trained on proprietary data and institutional expertise. Our researchers and platform embed directly within customer environments to build custom evals, train models, and deploy agents that get better with use. * **Why we’re excited:** We get to work at a rare intersection. Our product team builds the platform powering a new generation of digital coworkers. Our research team pushes the frontier of post\-training and reinforcement learning. Our applied AI team sits side\-by\-side with customers as they ship agents into production. This combination of strong product, deep research, and boots on the ground is what we believe it takes to bring AI to the enterprise. We are product\-led, research\-enabled, and forward\-deployed. * **Who we are**: We’re a team of engineers, researchers, and operators. Many of us are former founders. We've built RL infrastructure at OpenAI, data foundations at Scale AI, and systems at Together, Two Sigma, Watershed, and others. We work with F50 customers and are fortunate to be backed by partners like Kleiner Perkins, Benchmark, Sequoia, Lux, and Greenoaks. * **Who Thrives Here**: We're looking for people who are excited about applying novel research and complex systems to real\-world problems. Our team genuinely enjoys working with customers: listening, empathizing, and understanding how work actually gets done in their organizations. Former founders, people who've built a lot of side projects, or anyone who's shown they can own something end\-to\-end, tend to do well here. **Benefits \& Logistics** ========================= This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our office in the Mission. We offer: * Competitive compensation and equity * 100% employer\-paid health insurance coverage for you and your family * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave * Daily lunches and dinners * Transportation and relocation support * 5% 401k match We sponsor visas. While we can't guarantee success for every candidate or role, if you're the right fit, we're committed to working through the process with you. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. As set forth in Applied Compute’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Supervisor
jobs.description: **About Company** 1 Click Logistics, founded in 2018, is a third\-party logistics (3PL) provider committed to delivering exceptional service in distribution, warehousing, transportation, and innovative logistics solutions. With locations in Sparks, Nevada; Sacramento, California; Dayton, Ohio; and Hagerstown, Maryland, we are strategically positioned to serve customers across the U.S. Our mission is to serve our customers, team, and community while fostering a unique, employee\-centered culture. Our comprehensive services include warehousing and distribution, retail and e\-commerce fulfillment, and transportation management, all designed to streamline operations and reduce costs for our customers. We also provide value\-added services, such as re\-packaging, labeling, and light assembly, to meet specific customer needs. Drive initiatives that increase team velocity and reduce operational friction. * Cross‑Functional Leadership: Serve as the primary technical liaison for Customer Service, Operations, and other business areas. jobs.title: Frontend Engineer, AI Prototyping
jobs.description: #### **Who we are** SeekWell is the parent company of 1\-800 Contacts, Luna, and The Framery. Our goal is to make it simpler, easier, and more accessible for people to get the vision care they need. We maintain the legendary, award\-winning culture 1\-800 Contacts started almost 30 years ago and continue to develop innovative, pioneering products and businesses that make consumers cheer. We're owned by KKR – one of the world's largest and most successful private equity investment companies. We've built an excellent company and changed an industry by putting the customer first, always. The best is yet to come! #### **Why you want this job** We're building toward a future where every customer interaction with vision care is seamless, informed, and genuinely personal. Our design and product teams are early in building the systems that make that possible, and AI is core to how we're getting there. The CX Incubator exists to rapidly build and test new concepts for our mobile app before larger investments are made. We're looking for a hands\-on Frontend Engineer focused on AI prototyping who combines software engineering, experience applying AI technologies, and strong product and design instincts to turn ambitious customer experience ideas into functional, testable prototypes. You'll work alongside a marketer and designer to take concepts from ideation to realistic, testable simulations and prototypes. You'll build customer\-facing experiences that apply and integrate existing AI technologies, including conversational AI, content decisioning, recommendations, personalization, generative experiences, and voice interactions. You'll also use AI\-native development tools and workflows to move quickly from idea to working simulations and prototypes. This role isn't simply about using AI to code faster; it's about understanding, evaluating, and applying AI technologies to solve real customer problems and independently figuring out how to turn early concepts into working POCs. The goal is to prove out the customer experience and the technology behind it—not to build the final production\-ready solution. This is a role for a builder who is comfortable with ambiguity, enjoys creating working solutions quickly, and learns through experimentation. #### **What you'll do** * Turn ideas, customer problems, and hypotheses into functional, testable prototypes, starting with our mobile app. * Build AI\-powered experiences using LLMs, existing AI models and services, APIs, customer and product data, and modern web and mobile app technologies. * Research, evaluate, and prototype with AI models, services, and capabilities to determine the right approach for customer use cases such as content and intelligent decisioning, recommendations, personalization, generative content, conversational AI, and voice experiences. * Independently determine the technical approach needed to take loosely defined AI\-powered concepts from idea to a functional, testable POC. * Create realistic customer simulations that can be tested with internal and external audiences. * Explore how to ground, guide, and evaluate AI experiences using customer profile data, customer context, and human\-defined guardrails. * Connect prototypes to content libraries, AI SDKs, and staging systems. * Contribute reusable components and integrations to our prototyping platform. * Use AI\-native development workflows with tools like Cursor, Claude, Copilot, and similar technologies. * Help define practical guardrails for safe, reliable, and brand\-appropriate customer\-facing AI experiences. * Use feedback from customer and user testing to rapidly iterate on prototypes and explore different approaches. #### **What you'll need** * Strong software engineering skills with experience building web or native mobile applications using React, Angular, or similar frameworks. Experience with iOS development is a plus. * Hands\-on experience integrating and applying existing AI technologies, models, or services within applications, prototypes, or customer experiences. * Experience working with applied AI technologies such as LLMs, conversational AI, recommendation or decisioning systems, personalization, retrieval/grounding, agents, or generative AI. * Demonstrated ability to independently take an ambiguous AI\-powered concept, determine how to build it, and deliver a functional POC or prototype. * Experience integrating APIs, cloud services, data sources, and external systems. * Familiarity with AI\-native development tools such as Cursor, Claude, Copilot, or similar technologies. * Strong product and design instincts and an appreciation for great customer experiences. * Comfort with ambiguity and rapid iteration. * Experience incorporating user or customer feedback into prototypes and iterating based on what you learn. * Portfolio, prototypes, side projects, or examples that demonstrate curiosity and self\-directed building. #### **Perks** * Free eye exams for your entire family * Deep discounts on lenses, glasses, and other services * Amazing healthcare coverage * 401(k) match * Flexible PTO * Tuition reimbursement program * In\-house restaurant with highly discounted meals (Steak dinner under $6\) * Free snacks, ice cream, and drinks every day * Full onsite gym *We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.* \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.description: **Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.** For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what's next, at the forefront of innovation and what's technologically possible. You will play a critical role in ensuring experiments are executed safely, efficiently, and consistently by operating process equipment, handling wafers and samples, performing routine measurements, maintaining accurate records, and supporting laboratory operations. You will work closely with Process Engineers to collect high\-quality experimental data, maintain laboratory readiness, and assist in basic troubleshooting activities. Your contributions enable rapid learning cycles and successful development of next\-generation semiconductor processes. **What you will be working on** Process Execution * Execute routine wafer processing activities according to defined experimental plans and operating procedures. * Operate semiconductor process equipment under the guidance of Process Engineers. * Prepare, load, unload, and track wafers and test samples throughout experiment flows. * Maintain a well\-organized lab environment, holding yourself and others accountability for following established procedures for handling FOUPs/FOSBs and wafers. * Support process development activities by running repeatable experiments and ensuring process adherence. Metrology and Data Collection * Perform routine wafer inspections and measurements using laboratory metrology tools. * Collect, organize, and record process and metrology data accurately and promptly. * Verify experimental data quality and highlight abnormalities to Process Engineers. * Maintain detailed experimental records and documentation. Laboratory Operations and Logistics * Coordinate wafer and sample movement between laboratories, engineering teams, and external partners when required. * Manage incoming and outgoing samples, consumables, and lab materials. * Support inventory tracking of wafers, chemicals, lab supplies, and consumables. * Ensure workstations, tools, and laboratory areas remain organized and operational. * Assist with lab scheduling, sample tracking, and general laboratory logistics. * Advise management as to how workflows, safety, and procedures can be improved, asking for the equipment, tools, and resources you need to do your best work. Equipment Support * Perform routine equipment preparation, qualification checks, and preventive maintenance activities. * Escalate equipment issues and process abnormalities to Process Engineers. * Support equipment setup, calibration, and recovery activities following established procedures. * Assist engineers during tool qualifications and process characterization activities. Troubleshooting Support * Support Process Engineers in investigating process deviations and equipment issues. * Perform basic troubleshooting activities using established procedures and engineering guidance. * Assist with data collection and root\-cause investigations. * Contribute observations and recommendations for improving laboratory efficiency and process consistency. Safety and Compliance * Follow all cleanroom protocols, contamination\-control requirements, and laboratory safety procedures. * Adhere to chemical handling, gas safety, and equipment operation requirements. * Maintain accurate documentation in compliance with engineering and quality standards. * Promote a safe and organized laboratory environment. What we are looking for * Minimum HS Diploma; an Associates in Engineering, Applied Science, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline is preferred. * Minimum 2 years of experience in a semiconductor manufacturing facility, R\&D laboratory, process development environment, or similar technical settings * Hands\-on experience working in cleanroom environments. * Familiarity with wafer handling, semiconductor process equipment, and laboratory operations. * Experience operating metrology or inspection tools * Ability to follow experimental procedures with a high level of accuracy and consistency. * Strong attention to detail and good documentation practices. * Willingness to support shift work when required. * Good communication and teamwork skills. What sets you apart * Experience supporting semiconductor process development or integration activities. * Familiarity with wafer processing equipment such as deposition, etch, clean, anneal, or metrology systems. * Experience in sample management, laboratory logistics, and inventory control. * Understanding of SPC, DOE, experimental data collection, and process monitoring. * Ability to identify process anomalies and support structured troubleshooting activities. * Experience working closely with Process Engineers in R\&D or technology development environments. * Strong ownership, organization, and execution skills in a fast\-paced laboratory environment. Travel: \<10% Work shift: M\-F, Moring (5a\-2p), Day (9a\-6p), or Evening (2p\-11p) shift may be required. **Apply today to be part of what's next.** We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what's possible through cutting\-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect. and embedded software components. * Lead and support medium\-sized projects, applying project management methodologies to ensure timely completion. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to address recurring reliability issues in both hardware and software domains. * Conduct sustaining activities such as process improvements, tooling updates, and software reliability enhancements. * Apply quality principles and perform complex analysis of quality records and reports to recommend improvements. * Document reliability issues and performance measures for management review. * Provide technical guidance to engineers in the lab and mentor on best practices for hardware/software integration. * Liaise with external vendors and internal design teams to resolve technical challenges. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in a technical (e.g. electrical/mechanical/software) or scientific (e.g. statistics/math) discipline. * Or an equivalent combination of education and work experience * Equivalent experiences is defined as five years in a role responsible for product engineering, ideally in a medical device industry. * Experience in product failure analysis, hardware/software integration, and reliability investigations. * Experience supporting CAPA activities and nonconforming product/procedure investigations * Knowledge of embedded systems, and electrical design principles. * Excellent problem\-solving and critical thinking skills. * Ability to manage complex technical investigations and adapt solutions. * Project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. * Strong technical writing and presentation skills, including the preparation of investigation reports and the communications of findings to management and stakeholders **Preferred Qualifications** * Knowledge of FDA Quality System Regulations (21 CFR Part 820\) and ISO 13485\. * Proficiency with data analysis Analysis (RCA) methodologies, including 5 Whys and Fishbone analysis. * Demonstrated ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams, including Quality Assurance, R\&D, and Manufacturing. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Online Storage)
jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. The Data and Storage Services team is responsible for Affirm's data infrastructure across OLTP and OLAP systems, spanning critical online checkout databases, batch orchestration, streaming infrastructure, event\-driven frameworks, BI, analytics tooling, large\-scale data platforms, and agentic data tools such as semantic layers and internal platform data applications. Our mission is to provide trustworthy, intuitive, and cost\-efficient solutions for Affirmers to secure, store, analyze, and transform data at exceptional scale. The Online Storage team provides a set of managed databases as a platform, used to persist data for all Affirm services. Our platform enables self\-service access to OLTP storage systems, including Relational DB(MySQL), KV(DynamoDB), Distributed SQL(TiDB) and Cache(Redis). As a team, we are responsible for various data and access patterns, including but not limited to mission\-critical financial transactional data, data science models, and any new persistence use case. These responsibilities require us to learn and gain deep expertise in various database systems. We are looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer who can architect, build and scale Relational and Distributed SQL Databases identifying opportunities to improve how we build, productionize, operate and improve this mission\-critical infrastructure to unlock substantial value within our business. You'll have the opportunity to directly influence your team's roadmap in close collaboration with your peers, share your knowledge and expertise with others and learn from some of the best on our shared mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives. ### **What you'll do** * You will build and operate the control plane for large\-scale distributed SQL databases such as MySQL and TiDB, automating provisioning, failover, backups and upgrades end to end. * You will design and execute reliability\-focused schema and data migrations across multi\-tenant database clusters, with zero downtime for the products that depend on them. * You will own the networking stack that connects services to storage on Kubernetes, including connection proxies such as ProxySQL, and tune it for latency, resilience and failover. * You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open\-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery. * You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design \& analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade\-offs. * You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them. * You will support the operations and availability of your team's artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting "keep the lights on" \& on\-call efforts. * You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks. * You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example. ### **What we look for** * You have a total of 5\+ years of experience as a software engineer. * You are experienced in designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale technologies like Python, Kotlin, AWS, MySQL, Terraform and Kubernetes. * You have in\-depth, hands\-on experience with large\-scale database deployments in a production environment. * You have expertise in distributed databases and database technologies such as MySQL(Preferred), TiDB(Preferred), Postgres, Spanner, Vitess, CockroachDB etc. * Solid understanding of distributed database architecture, data modeling, and performance tuning. Particularly, expertise in SQL tuning and performance optimization techniques. * You have expertise in database benchmarking, load testing, and capacity planning. * You are familiar with connection poolers and proxies such as ProxySQL, RDS Proxy, Pg Bouncer, PgDog etc. * You have built control\-plane or automation tooling for databases, such as provisioning, failover, upgrades or schema migrations, ideally on Kubernetes. * You have executed zero\-downtime migrations and major version upgrades on production databases, and have built CLI tooling or runbooks to make those procedures repeatable. * You understand Kubernetes networking, service discovery and TLS well enough to debug connection and failover problems between services and databases. * You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others. * You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely. * Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders. * You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team. * This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field. Pay Grade \- N Equity Grade \- 9 **Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range.** Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job\-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $195,000 \- 255,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $173,000\-233,000 \#LI\-Remote **Remote\-first with flexibility built in** Affirm is proud to be a remote\-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in\-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office\-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in\-person onboarding experience. **Benefits designed for you** Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: * Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. * Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. * Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. * Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We're committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we're happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - AI Trainer
jobs.description: AfterQuery is seeking Full Stack Engineer Experts to build and evaluate the production\-quality full stack application work scenarios that frontier AI labs use to test model judgment. In this remote, asynchronous role you will design realistic engineering problems, review how models reason through them, and give detailed feedback that makes the resulting training data trustworthy. **Why Apply** * Competitive Compensation: $70\-$85/hour, paid weekly * Innovative Impact: Join a YC\-backed research lab shaping how frontier models reason about software * Flexible Engagement: Fully remote and asynchronous, on your own schedule **Responsibilities** * Design challenging, realistic production\-quality full stack application work tasks drawn from production practice * Evaluate model responses for correctness, sound reasoning, and subtle failure modes * Document your reasoning clearly so another engineer can audit the judgement **Required Qualifications** * Professional experience building and shipping full stack web applications * Proficiency with a modern framework such as Next.js, plus SQL schema design * Comfort owning a feature from data model through interface **About AfterQuery** AfterQuery is a research lab investigating the boundaries of artificial intelligence through novel datasets and experimentation. We are backed by top investors, including Y Combinator and Box Group, and support all leading AI labs.

lifecycle. * Contribute to technical discussions, design decisions and delivery planning. **Your profile** ---------------- * Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or environments. * Ability to work independently on complex technical features. * Comfortable acting as a technical reference for the team. * Experience with Git, CI/CD and automated testing. * Strong communication skills. * A genuine interest in mentoring and supporting other developers. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience improving performance on embedded compute platforms. * Experience with Embedded Linux and Docker. * Background in heavy equipment, automotive, mining or industrial systems. * Knowledge of functional safety standards such as ISO 26262, ISO 13849 or equivalent. * Familiarity with Yocto and Conan. **Why choose us** * An international community bringing together more than 110 different nationalities * An environment where trust is central: 70% of our leaders started their careers at the entry level * A strong training system with our internal Academy and more than 250 modules available * A dynamic work environment that frequently comes together for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.) *Amaris Consulting promotes equal opportunities. We are committed to bringing together people from diverse backgrounds and creating an inclusive work environment. In this regard, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of sex, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.* **Who are we?** --------------- **Amaris Consulting** is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses.
