jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (US)
jobs.description: **Senior Site Reliability Engineer** ------------------------------------ Remote \| US **About Climavision** At Climavision, we're rebuilding climate technology from the ground up and changing the way we see weather. We merge the power of our proprietary, high\-resolution weather radar and satellite network with advanced weather prediction modelling and decades of industry expertise to reduce existing coverage gaps and drastically improve forecasting ability. Our revolutionary new approach to climate technology weather solutions is poised to help reduce the economic risks of climate change on companies, governments, and societies alike. We are backed by The Rise Fund, the world's largest global impact platform committed to achieving measurable, positive social and environmental outcomes alongside competitive financial returns. Climavision is headquartered in Louisville, KY, with research and development operations in Raleigh, NC. **The Work** Are you an experienced Site Reliability Engineer who thrives at the intersection of software engineering and production operations? Do you take pride in keeping mission\-critical customer systems reliable under real\-world operational pressure? Are you looking for an opportunity to own production reliability for a modern hybrid infrastructure platform spanning cloud, colocation, and edge environments? If so, we have an exceptional opportunity for you. Climavision is seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to contribute towards reliability, operational excellence, and production resilience across the company's platform and data services. This role sits on a shared SRE team that supports the full business rather than a single product line, covering both the radar network and the weather intelligence sides of the company as priorities shift. A central focus of this role is building the observability layer that puts the health of the full fleet in one place, and then automating recovery so that systems heal themselves. Multi\-cluster and multi\-replica high availability across our distributed edge fleet remains a core part of the work. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who is equally comfortable troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters, leading incident response, and improving operational maturity across the organization. The successful candidate will combine deep production operations expertise with a disciplined approach to reliability engineering and strong automation skills. Climavision operates a hybrid infrastructure footprint spanning Microsoft Azure, colocation data centers, and edge Kubernetes clusters, deployed alongside weather radar systems. This role will drive production reliability across Azure, colocation, and edge environments. Right\-sizing cluster resources and migrating workloads off Azure to reduce spend are active priorities for the team. **35% Kubernetes Platform Reliability and Operations** **30% Production Reliability Engineering and Incident Response** **20% Observability, Monitoring, and Alerting** **15% Automation, Recovery, and Cost Optimization** **Primary Responsibilities:** * Own production reliability for Climavision's customer\-facing platform and data services across Azure, colocation, and edge Kubernetes environments. * Work as part of a shared SRE function supporting the whole company rather than a single product line, taking on work across both the radar network and the weather intelligence sides of the business as priorities shift. * Contribute to the definition and improvement of SLIs, SLOs, alerting standards, and operational metrics used to measure platform reliability. * Build and own the observability layer for the fleet. Today the underlying metrics exist but are only reachable from the command line inside each cluster. This role is responsible for surfacing that data in shared dashboards and building the alerting that tells the team something is going wrong before a customer does. * Design and build automated recovery and self\-healing for production systems, so that common failure modes are detected and remediated without human intervention. * Optimize cluster resourcing and cost, including right\-sizing workloads and nodes and supporting the migration of workloads off Azure to reduce spend. * Support and coordinate production incident response efforts, including troubleshooting, mitigation, communication, and postmortem analysis. * Diagnose and resolve complex production issues across application services, Kubernetes infrastructure, storage, and distributed systems. * Drive multi\-replica and multi\-cluster high availability across Climavision's services, including workload placement, scheduling, and deployment patterns that allow services to run safely as multiple replicas across multiple clusters. * Contribute to the multi\-cluster high\-availability strategy across Climavision's hybrid fleet, including active\-active and active\-passive failover behavior, traffic routing, data replication considerations, and g omation and Infrastructure as Code concepts using tools such as Terraform and Ansible. * Experience supporting CI/CD and production deployment pipelines. GitHub Actions is used for CI/CD at Climavision. * Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability platforms such as DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, or comparable technologies. * Experience operating distributed systems and microservice\-based architectures in production environments. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure infrastructure. * Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, application, and platform layers. * Demonstrated experience participating in a structured production on\-call rotation supporting business\-critical systems. * Working familiarity with Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft Entra, which the team uses day to day for ticketing, documentation, and authentication. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including incident documentation and postmortem authoring. * Experience working in start\-up, scale\-up, or other fast\-moving engineering environments, and comfort with the pace and ambiguity that comes with them. **Nice to have, but not required:** * Experience operating Kubernetes platforms using RKE2 and Rancher, which is how Climavision manages its clusters. * Experience with Octopus Deploy. * Experience with SOC 2 or comparable security auditing and compliance work. * Experience supporting hybrid cloud and colocation infrastructure environments. * Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio. * Experience with Kubernetes\-native storage platforms such as Longhorn. * Experience operating PostgreSQL or PostGIS in Kubernetes environments. * Experience with distributed messaging systems such as RabbitMQ or NATS. * Experience supporting GPU\-enabled workloads in Kubernetes. * Familiarity with reliability engineering practices, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and operational maturity metrics. **Physical Demands \& Work Environment:** * This is a full\-time, exempt position * Fully Remote \- United States * This job requires frequent use of a computer to complete tasks, attend meetings, and communicate via Microsoft Teams. **Once you land this position, you'll get to enjoy:** * Benefits of a dynamic and growing organization * A challenging, hands\-on role that will have real impact on the business * Competitive compensation * Comprehensive benefits package * 401(k) Savings Plan * Medical/Dental/Vision Benefits * Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Unlimited Paid Time\-off * 11 Paid Holidays * Paid Parental Leave * Company Paid Short\-term Disability (STD) * Company Paid Long\-term Disability (LTD) * Company Paid Life Insurance *The salary range for this position is $130,000\-170,000 annually, however Climavision considers several factors when extending an offer of employment including but not limited to, the applicant's education, experience, the responsibilities of the role, training, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Any offer of employment is contingent on completion of a background check to company standard. Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.* *Climavision is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.*

jobs.title: Associate Director, Forward Deployed Product Manager
jobs.description: The Machine is the agentic operating system for marketing, built by Code and Theory. It plugs into the tools marketing teams use and turns disconnected workflows into a single intelligent system, connecting brand strategy, creative production, and media performance. The Machine helps power agencies across Stagwell's network and world\-leading brands. We're looking for a Lead Forward Deployed Product Manager who will provide functional leadership for a pod of 4–5 Forward Deployed Product Managers embedded across client implementations. This person sets the operating standard for how requirements, prototypes, and workflow decisions get made across every active deployment, and acts as the escalation point between the FDPM pod, Technical Account Managers, implementation engineering, and core product. This is not a reporting\-line management role — pod people management sits with the Director of Product — but it is the person who sets the bar the rest of the pod works to. They've done the individual\-contributor version of this role and know where it breaks under pressure. Product\-minded but still executional, they lead by example rather than by authority, and are comfortable operating at the level of a single deployment and the level of the whole pod in the same day. They're the person who builds structure and standards where none exist, then gets peers to actually use them — turning scattered patterns across deployments into a shared playbook and a steady feed of learnings back into the core product. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Set and enforce a consistent bar for requirements quality, prototyping rigor, and documentation across the pod * Unblock FDPMs on ambiguous or contested requirements by making the call or escalating to the right owner * Own the relationship with Technical Account Managers and implementation leads at the program level, not just per\-deployment * Review and sanity\-check the workflows, prototypes, and briefs the pod produces before they reach clients or engineering * Identify which recurring patterns across deployments are worth generalizing, and drive that handoff into the core product roadmap * Build and maintain the shared playbook: templates, workflow patterns, prompting approaches, and documentation standards the pod reuses * Coordinate staffing and workload across concurrent deployments, and flag capacity gaps or performance concerns to the reporting manager * Surface pod\-wide progress and blockers to product and delivery leadership * Stay hands\-on enough to step into a deployment directly when a pod member is blocked, out, or the stakes require it **WHAT YOU'LL NEED** * Prior experience as a forward\-deployed PM, solutions consultant, or implementation lead — including having done the individual\-contributor version of this work and knowing where it breaks under pressure * A track record leading a workstream, initiative, or informal team in a fast\-moving, client\-facing environment; direct people\-management experience is not required * Strong systems thinking with the ability to spot a pattern across multiple different client contexts at once, and the judgment to make the call for the pod, not just yourself, with incomplete information * Hands\-on comfort with prototyping, prompting, and workflow design — well enough to review someone else's work critically, not just do your own * Excellent communication skills across technical, non\-technical, client\-facing, and leadership audiences * High ownership and a bias to action, with the discipline to know when to step back and let an FDPM own it * Comfortable working directly for clients and influencing a team without a reporting line — leading by example, not authority * Likely from a startup, SaaS, or technical services environment, with a builder/operator orientation rather than a pure roadmap PM background **ABOUT US** Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital\-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start\-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic. Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel \& hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok. The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We're always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward\-thinking people to join our team. *The compensation range for this role is $140,000 – $190,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.*

jobs.title: Principal AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Empowered to live. Inspired to work.** Compeer Financial is a member\-owned cooperative located in Illinois, Minnesota and Wisconsin. We bring together team members with a variety of backgrounds and experiences to help provide financial services to support agriculture and rural communities. Join us in a culture that not only promotes meaningful work and professional development, but provides a flexible, hybrid work environment and excellent benefits, which empower you to thrive both personally and professionally. **How we support you:** * Hybrid model – up to 50% work from home * Flexible schedules including ample flexibility in the summer months * Up to 9% towards 401k (3% fixed Compeer contribution plus up to 6% match) * Benefits: medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, life \& AD\&D insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability, wellness program \& EAP * Vacation, sick leave, holidays/floating holidays, parental leave, and volunteer paid time off * Learning and development programs * Mentorship programs * Cross\-functional committee opportunities (i.e. Inclusion Council, emerging professional groups, etc.) * Professional membership/certification reimbursement and more! Casual/seasonal \& intern team members are not eligible for benefits except for state\-mandated programs. To learn more about Compeer Financial visit www.compeer.com/careers. **Where you will work:** This position offers a hybrid work option up to 50% and is open to any Compeer office location in Illinois, Minnesota and Wisconsin. **The contributions you will make:** The highest\-level individual contributor in the software engineering career framework, providing enterprise technical leadership across portfolios, products, platforms, and transformation initiatives, with a focus on leading and expanding responsible AI use across the organization. Sets enterprise AI Enablement Platform direction and partnering with Enterprise Architecture and AI Risk governance workgroup. Connects AI technology platform strategy to enterprise needs, risks, and measurable enterprise value. Advances AI\-enabled engineering and Agentic AI at scale, building tools and platforms that make AI adoption safe, repeatable, and accessible. Serves as a trusted advisor to senior technology and business leaders and models the behaviors that strengthen Compeer's engineering culture. **A typical day:** * Leads AI platform engineering and adoption by building enterprise AI platforms, tools, services, and integrations for LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector search, agents, Model Context Protocol, and AI\-assisted and agentic software development. * Establishes AI operational excellence through reusable components and guardrails, evaluation frameworks, monitoring, cost and performance management, output validation, production support, and responsible scaling of AI tools and agents. * Partners on AI governance and risk with Risk Management, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, and Data Governance, translating requirements into access controls, data protection, model and vendor risk management, human oversight, auditability, and use\-case risk tiering. * Owns AI\-enabled and Agentic AI engineering delivery for the most strategic and ambiguous software initiatives from discovery through sustained operation, making significant cross\-boundary technical decisions and remaining accountable for quality, security, reliability, scalability, and production performance. * Develops engineers and technical leaders through mentoring, communities of practice, training, and reusable guidance on AI\-assisted development, prompt and context engineering, responsible AI, agentic development, and critical evaluation of AI\-generated output. * Advances technical mastery and engineering excellence across architecture, distributed systems, integration, cloud\-native engineering, DevSecOps, testing, CI/CD, security, observability, and reliability while evaluating emerging technologies through experimentation and evidence. * Connects engineering to business outcomes by translating Compeer's strategy, client needs, regulatory obligations, and risk into engineering strategies, investment options, build\-versus\-buy decisions, high\-value AI opportunities, and multi\-year roadmaps. * Leads across organizational boundaries by partnering with engineering, architecture, product, security, data, operations, quality, risk, and business leaders * Influences without authority, resolving conflicts and dependencies, and communicating risks and trade\-offs clearly. **The skills and experience we prefer you have:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent experience, with extensive experience designing, building, and operating complex, business\-critical software, distributed systems, and platforms. * Hands\-on experience designing and building AI applications and platforms using LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector search, agent orchestration, Model Context Protocol, and cloud AI services such as Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Foundry. * Experience scaling responsible AI\-enabled engineering and Agentic AI across the software lifecycle, prompt and model versioning, quality and safety testing, cost and performance monitoring, production support, and validation of AI\-generated outcomes. * Working knowledge of responsible AI and AI governance, model and vendor risk management, privacy, bias and fairness, auditability, human oversight, sensitive\-data protection, and translating governance requirements into practical technical controls; experience in financial services, agriculture, or another regulated industry is preferred. * Experience leading complex solution design and strategic technical decisions across multiple portfolios, products, systems, or business domains, including architecture, integration, technology trade\-offs, engineering strategy, standards, governance, and target\-state architecture. * Distinguished software engineering expertise across application development, APIs and integration, cloud\-native and event\-driven architectures, data, security, platforms, DevSecOps, testing, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and operational excellence. * Ability to analyze highly complex problems, anticipate second\- and third\-order effects, balance technical, security, regulatory, operational, and investment trade\-offs, and connect engineering decisions to Compeer's strategy, client needs, enterprise value, and durable multi\-year direction. * Exceptional communication, influence, leadership, and learning agility, including the ability to advise executives and governance bodies, constructively challenge assumptions, resolve cross\-organizational dependencies, mentor senior technical talent, and rapidly evaluate and responsibly adopt emerging technologies. **How we will take care of you:** Our job titles may span more than one career level (associate, senior, principal, etc.). The actual title and base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role is eligible for variable compensation and other benefits. Compeer Financial is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. Compeer is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Click here to view federal employment laws applicable for applicants.

jobs.title: Data Modeling Engineer (Cribl)
jobs.description: **Data Modeling Security Engineer (Cribl)** **Location:** Remote (up to 100%); client site in Columbia, SC **Openings:** 1 **Type:** Contract, 12 months with possible extension **About the Role** Concordant LLC, a Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business, seeks a Data Modeling Security Engineer to support a government client's information security division. In this new role, you will work directly with full\-time security architects and engineers to design, implement, and integrate Cribl data modeling and log ingestion pipelines across a large enterprise security environment. Cribl pipelines will take most of your time, and you will also provide hands\-on technical support across SIEM, XDR, vulnerability management, data loss prevention (DLP), security awareness, endpoint security, Linux sensor deployment, and security automation. The ideal candidate brings extensive experience designing, implementing, and maintaining Cribl data models for log ingestion in large\-scale security environments. **Primary Responsibilities** * Plan, design, deploy, and support Cribl data modeling and log pipeline ingestion * Support Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) operations * Help design and configure Linux\-based security sensors and endpoint monitoring tools **Secondary Responsibilities** * Support planning, deployment, and operations for XDR, vulnerability management, DLP, and security awareness platforms * Collaborate with security architects to design enterprise security solutions that align with leadership's business goals, regulatory requirements, and risk tolerance * Design, deploy, and manage countermeasures against known threats and contribute to mitigation strategies for emerging threats * Apply security controls consistently across enterprise infrastructure and applications, validate their effectiveness, and recommend improvements * Support incident detection and response through monitoring, log analysis, and reporting * Develop technical documentation, implementation guides, and standard operating procedures * Participate in the on\-call rotation * Perform other duties as assigned **Required Qualifications** * Cribl data modeling and log pipeline design and implementation * Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture and engineering principles * Experience implementing and supporting enterprise security tools (SIEM, XDR, vulnerability management, DLP, endpoint security) * Automation and integration experience with Python and Bash * Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, threat detection, and defensive security strategies * Linux and Windows experience, including system hardening and security configuration * Understanding of networking concepts, security protocols, and secure system design * 5 years of experience supporting large IT environments or system deployments * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Information Security, or a related field; 8 years of relevant experience may substitute for the degree **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on Cribl data modeling experience * Hands\-on SIEM administration, analysis, and reporting * Experience building and deploying Linux\-based security sensors * Familiarity with NIST CSF, CJIS, IRS 1075, and CMS MARS\-E * CISSP or Security\+ * South Carolina residents who can work onsite and handle local administrative tasks as needed **Mandatory Screening Requirements** The client enforces these requirements strictly and grants no exceptions. All candidates must pass: * 7\-year standard background check and full credit history check * Driving record (MVR) check * 10\-panel drug screen * E\-Verify * SLED check After onboarding, the selected candidate must obtain and maintain annual CJIS certification. **Interview Process** An initial round of on\-camera interviews on Microsoft Teams, with in\-person interviews preferred before final selection. Prior public sector experience is not required. Pay: Up to $59\.91 per hour Application Question(s): * Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment? * What is your current physical mailing address? (SBA HUBZone check) * Do you have any relevent certifications? Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * CRIBL data modeling and log pipeline design: 5 years (Required) * SIEM, XDR, DLP, endpoint security: 1 year (Required) * automation/integration w/Python \& Bash: 1 year (Required) * networking concepts: 1 year (Required) * NIST standards: 1 year (Required) * large IT environment: 5 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

This is not an off\-the\-shelf CRM and not a build\-from\-scratch project. You will be working inside real production systems that teams rely on every day. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: What We Need CORPAY is currently looking to hire a Product Manager within our North American Trucking division. This position falls under our US Vehicle Payments line of business and is located in Atlanta, GA. Corpay's North American Trucking team operates differently than a typical large enterprise product organization. While we're part of a global company, our team runs with the speed, ownership, and accountability of a startup. We're looking for a Product Manager who is energized by ambiguity, thrives with autonomy, and enjoys building products and businesses from the ground up. This isn't a role where you are given a roadmap, you'll define your own way, drive alignment, and own execution from concept through launch and beyond. One day you may be interviewing customers and writing product requirements. The next you might be reviewing UI designs, developing go\-to\-market materials, negotiating strategic partnerships, analyzing product performance, or working with engineering to solve technical challenges. Success requires someone who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and rolling up their sleeves to execute. If you're looking for a role with clearly defined boundaries, this probably isn't it. If you're excited by ownership, variety, and building products that make a measurable impact, we'd love to meet you. You will report directly to the VP of Connected Vehicle Products and regularly collaborate with the team and other departments. How We Work As a Product Manager, you will be expected to work in an office environment. CORPAY will set you up for success by providing: * Assigned workspace in the Buckhead Atlanta office. * Company\-issued equipment \+ remote access Role Responsibilities **The responsibilities of the role will include:** * Owning outcomes, not just features. Take full ownership of products and initiatives from idea through launch and ongoing optimization, ensuring they deliver measurable customer and business value. * Driving product strategy and execution. Identify opportunities through customer research, market insights, data analysis, and internal collaboration, then translate those opportunities into actionable roadmaps and product plans. * Leading product development. Define requirements, write epics and user stories, prioritize backlogs, make trade\-off decisions, and partner closely with engineering to deliver high\-quality solutions across both modern platforms and legacy systems. * Being the voice of the customer. Develop a deep understanding of carriers, drivers, fleet operators, and internal users to ensure we're solving meaningful problems with intuitive, scalable solutions. * Shaping the user experience. Collaborate with UX and engineering to review designs, simplify workflows, and create exceptional customer experiences across web, mobile, and internal applications. * Bringing products to market. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Customer Success, and Training to develop positioning, launch plans, enablement materials, and adoption strategies that maximize product success. * Using data to drive decisions. Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and continuously iterate based on customer feedback, analytics, and business results. * Leading through influence. Build alignment across Engineering, Operations, Sales, Credit, Risk, Finance, and executive leadership to move initiatives forward in a highly collaborative environment. * Wearing multiple hats. This role extends well beyond traditional product management. On any given day, you may be writing product requirements, reviewing UI designs, developing marketing content, supporting customer conversations, negotiating partnerships, or solving operational challenges. We value people who embrace variety and are willing to jump in wherever needed. Qualifications \& Skills * 4–7 years of product management experience or equivalent experience leading cross\-functional initiatives and bringing products or platforms to market. * Proven ability to independently lead initiatives from concept through execution, balancing customer needs, business objectives, and technical considerations. * Strong product instincts with experience identifying customer problems, validating opportunities, and translating them into successful product solutions. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across engineering, commercial, operations, and executive teams. * Strong technical aptitude with the ability to work effectively with engineers on APIs, integrations, system architecture, and technical trade\-offs. You don't need to code, but you should be comfortable understanding how systems work. * Experience working in Agile product development environments and collaborating closely with engineering and design teams. * Comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, adapting quickly as priorities evolve, and maintaining momentum in fast\-moving environments. * Hig tual fitness classes offered company\-wide * Robust PTO offerings including major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, \& volunteer time * Employee discounts with major providers (i.e. wireless, gym, car rental, etc.) * Philanthropic support with both local and national organizations * Fun culture with company\-wide contests and prizes About Corpay Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments. At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally. As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre\-employment screening conducted by an authorized third\-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law. **Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:** Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions. **Learn more about Corpay:** https://www.corpay.com Transparency \& Compliance Equal Opportunity Employer Corpay is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Corpay is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals are respected and valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. If you require reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please notify a representative of the Human Resources Department. Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring Corpay may use artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology\-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as application screening, candidate assessment, or interview scheduling. These tools are designed to enhance efficiency, consistency, and fairness throughout the hiring process. AI tools do not make final hiring decisions. All employment decisions involve human review. Corpay is committed to the responsible use of AI, including appropriate oversight and safeguards designed to support fair and unbiased outcomes. Candidate Privacy Notice For information about how Corpay processes personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice: https://www.corpay.com/privacy\-policy. Pay Philosophy Corpay is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices. Compensation decisions are based on objective, job\-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Where required by applicable law, salary or compensation ranges will be included in the job posting or provided prior to the interview process, where required by applicable law. Additional compensation elements such as bonuses, incentives, benefits, or variable pay may apply where applicable.

The ideal candidate will be dedicated to supporting the community's water and wastewater services; possess excellent communication, organizational, and analytical skills; and thrive in a collaborative team environment. jobs.title: Distinguished Software Engineer
jobs.description: Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award\-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world\-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country. Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture! Credit Acceptance makes vehicle ownership possible for consumers other lenders decline, through a dealer network, an originations and servicing platform, and pricing and decisioning models refined over decades. The technology estate underneath this business was built project by project over a long period, and modernizing it is the largest engineering opportunity at the company. As the Distinguished Engineer, you are the senior\-most individual contributor in Technology, reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer. You will set the multi\-year technical strategy for the company while staying close enough to the code and systems to remain credible — this is not an architect role that reviews designs from a distance, nor a strong engineer role that goes deep in a single domain. Two things sit at the center of the job: the target architecture for the enterprise, and the architecture for running AI agents across it. You will not own a team; you will own the hardest technical problems the company has, and get them resolved by convincing the people who do own the teams. This position will work from home and also require some work onsite at an assigned office work location. **Outcomes and Activities** * **Enterprise target architecture:** Convene the principal and staff engineers who own each domain to define the end\-state architecture across originations, servicing, marketplace, data, and AI, and use it to drive the multi\-year plan. Ensure every component has a defined interface with stated inputs and outputs, every unmade decision has a written principle standing in for it, and the document states honestly how close the organization is to the end state. Publish the architecture, including the tradeoffs that were rejected and why. * **Agentic AI architecture across the enterprise:** Own the enterprise agent architecture spanning servicing and collections, the dealer side, originations, and internal engineering and back\-office workflows, built on one common foundation rather than one stack per team. Work within the Data Science Team to define common problems and identify opportunities in the existing codebase to solve current and future problems Develop libraries and services to address common requirements for our machine learning products Collaborate with data scientists to get their machine learning models from prototype to production Champion the use and adoption of Toolkit libraries and services Required Skills \- Programming experience. Your job will require you to code. We mainly write in Python, so experience in this language is preferred. Familiarity with another lower\-level language (C/C\+\+, Go, etc) is a plus Software engineering experience. You enjoy software engineering and know your way around algorithm design and data structures. You are comfortable working in Linux\-based systems and are familiar with using Docker to develop and deliver RESTful APIs. You won’t be on your own on day one, but you will need the capacity to manage your time between research and tool development. Strong communication skills. You can context shift depending on the problem and can adjust if new problems and/or requirements arise requiring rethinking the approach to solving a problem. Detail oriented. jobs.title: Field Engineer 1
jobs.description: Company Description: Crown Equipment Corporation is a leading innovator in world\-class forklift and material handling equipment and technology. As one of the world’s largest lift truck manufacturers, we are committed to providing the customer with the safest, most efficient and ergonomic lift truck possible to lower their total cost of ownership. **Job Posting External** ------------------------ **Job Duties** * Road System Design and Delivery \- Collaborate during Solution Definition phase of the project and create two\-dimensional computer\-aided (CAD) files for Field Engineer 2 review. Support and participate in the site survey and point cloud gathering process; combine two and three\-dimensional (point cloud) imagery to assist in determining space required for the automated guided vehicle (AGV) road system. Incorporate this data into a Road System proposal. Work at customer site to implement/refine/validate the actual Road System. Work directly with the Software Engineer to incorporate blocking, itinerary checks, decision points, order, and vehicle priorities. * Navigation Design and Delivery \- Support and participate in the onsite map gathering process; compile and validate the data to generate the initial site map. Work onsite to test/refine/validate the navigational map, adding any necessary infrastructure to ensure high navigational confidence is maintained throughout the facility. Review navigation map with Field Engineer II before implementing in a production environment. * Solution Support \- Participate in Project meetings and conference calls with internal resources. Assist in work required in preparation for all site visits. Analyze data to support inquiries and decisions being made by customers and other departments. Beyond technical service representatives (1st level troubleshooting), provide 2nd level troubleshooting assistance for other resources in the department and branch or dealer technical leads. * System and Acceptance Testing \- Support internal resources through system and acceptance testing process; understanding of the solution scope, working to align on testing process, participating in testing, identification \& resolution of issues will be required during this phase. Work with all internal resources to document aligned consensus through both processes. * Project Documentation \- Document all work related to the design and development of any solution for Field Engineer 2 review. **Minimum Qualifications** * Less than 2 years' related experience * Bachelor’s degree (Electrical, Mechanical, or Mechatronics Engineering) * Non\-degree considered if 12\+ years of related experience along with a high school diploma or GED * Extensive travel (over 20%) * Extensive overnight stays (over 20%) * Job requires employee to drive a lift truck * Job requires employee to drive a personal vehicle to conduct company business \< 20% per week (8 hours) and/or travel locally between company locations during scheduled workday * Must be within one hour of a major airport * Per 8\-hour shift. Sit 4 hours and stand 4 hours. Typical office environment (low noise level, limited exposure hot/cold temperatures, dust, fumes, and vibrations). Regular interaction with others and performs a degree of independent work. Physical and mental demands are akin to the majority of office positions with prolonged periods of sitting and prolonged use of a computer/keyboard. Infrequent lifting, walking and climbing stairs. Occasional use of office equipment (copiers, printers, etc.). **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in trouble shooting technical challenges. * Professional communication skills. Possess AutoCAD and basic SQL database knowledge. **Work Authorization:** Crown will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire. jobs.title: Business Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title** Business Analytics Engineer **Job Description Summary** As a Business Analytics Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain data, analytics, reporting, and geospatial solutions that help account teams and clients make better business decisions across complex real estate portfolios. You will work across the analytics lifecycle, from data acquisition and transformation to reporting, visualization, automation, and geospatial analysis, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions regarding portfolio performance, occupancy, workplace strategy, operational efficiency, and real estate investments. This role bridges business analytics, data engineering, and technology enablement. You will partner closely with account teams, analysts, operations leaders, and clients to transform business requirements into scalable solutions that improve visibility, reduce manual effort, and support data\-driven decision making. As a member of Cushman \& Wakefield's Portfolio Advisory Group, you will support one or more strategic client accounts while helping advance PAG's broader analytics, automation, geospatial, and emerging technology capabilities. The successful candidate combines strong analytical thinking, business acumen, technical capabilities, and a passion for solving complex business problems through data and technology. **Job Description** **This role will primarily:** * Develop and maintain reporting, analytics, and geospatial solutions that improve visibility into portfolio performance, workplace trends, operational metrics, and business outcomes. * Transform, validate, and manage data from multiple sources to support portfolio intelligence, operational reporting, forecasting, and decision support. * Partner with business stakeholders, account teams, and clients to translate business requirements into reusable technical solutions. * Support portfolio planning, workplace strategy, occupancy analysis, location intelligence, and operational decision\-making through insight generation and visualization. * Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation, standardization, and adoption of emerging technologies, including AI\-enabled tools. * Support the continued evolution of PAG's analytics, reporting, geospatial, and technology capabilities. **Success in this role looks like:** * Stakeholders trust the data, reporting, and analytics solutions used to support business and real estate decisions. * Reporting and analysis processes become more automated, scalable, and consistent. * Business users spend less time gathering, validating, and preparing data and more time acting on insights. * Analytics and geospatial solutions become integrated into standard account operations and decision\-making. * Stakeholders use reporting, analytics, and geospatial solutions to support portfolio planning, occupancy strategy, location decisions, operational performance, and workplace initiatives. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop dashboarding and reporting solutions that support portfolio performance, workplace strategy, occupancy trends, operational efficiency, and service delivery using Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms. * Build and maintain data pipelines, transformation processes, and data models that support analytics and reporting solutions, with Databricks experience strongly preferred. * Integrate data from internal systems, client platforms, commercial real estate technologies, and external sources. * Develop and maintain ArcGIS Online initiatives. * Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting, data preparation, and operational processes. * Leverage AI\-enabled tools to improve productivity, accelerate development, and enhance analytics capabilities. * Partner with account teams, business stakeholders, and clients to understand business needs and priorities. * Communicate technical concepts in a clear, understandable manner to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Support user adoption, training, documentation, and continuous improvement efforts. **Qualifications** **Must\-Have jobs.title: AI & Data Governance Engineer
jobs.description: Cyber Advisors LLC (CA), headquartered in Maple Grove, MN, is seeking an experienced AI \& Data Governance Engineer to help organizations confidently embrace artificial intelligence while maintaining strong security, compliance, and governance controls. CA is a steadily growing IT managed services provider (MSP) and cybersecurity business that specializes in a very high\-quality, customer\-focused approach to designing, managing, and maintaining our customers' IT environment. We have invested a tremendous amount of time to develop our technology, processes, and support platform. We are now adding to our team of outstanding individuals to help in our growth. Come grow with us! You can learn more about us at (http://www.cyberadvisors.com%3C/p%3E%3Cp%3EThis) (http://www.cyberadvisors.com%3C/p%3E%3Cp%3EThis)https://cyberadvisors.com/ This is a full\-time position. Working hours are Monday\-Friday. Ideally be based in the Twin Cites, MN area, but can be a fully remote role. **Position Overview** This role will work directly with mid\-market organizations to assess AI readiness, develop governance frameworks, implement Microsoft Purview solutions, and guide clients through the adoption of Microsoft Copilot and other AI technologies. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Copilot, data protection, compliance, and information governance, while also maintaining a broad understanding of emerging AI platforms such as Anthropic Claude, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and other large language models (LLMs). The successful candidate will be equally comfortable leading executive conversations, conducting technical workshops, developing client\-facing documentation, and implementing governance and security controls that enable responsible AI adoption. **Key Responsibilities** AI Strategy \& Advisory * Lead AI readiness assessments and AI governance engagements for mid\-sized organizations. * Facilitate executive and stakeholder workshops focused on AI adoption, governance, security, and business transformation. * Develop AI governance roadmaps, policies, standards, and operating models. * Provide guidance on responsible AI usage, risk management, compliance, and organizational change management. * Help organizations define approved AI use cases and establish controls for emerging AI technologies. **Microsoft Purview \& Data Governance** * Design and implement Microsoft Purview solutions, including: * Data Loss Prevention (DLP) * Information Protection and Sensitivity Labels * Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) * Insider Risk Management * Compliance Manager * eDiscovery and Audit * Data Lifecycle Management * Data Classification and Discovery * Conduct data governance assessments and assist clients in developing governance programs. * Create data classification strategies and governance standards. * Identify and remediate oversharing, excessive permissions, and AI\-related data exposure risks. * Establish governance practices for structured and unstructured data across Microsoft 365, Azure, and other platforms. **Microsoft Copilot \& AI Governance** * Lead Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness and adoption engagements. * Assess data security risks associated with Copilot deployment. * Develop governance frameworks for Copilot, Copilot Studio, and AI agents. * Design controls for prompt security, data protection, retention, auditing, and monitoring. * Assist clients with AI policy development, user training, and AI acceptable\-use programs. * Conduct assessments of shadow AI usage and unauthorized AI services. **Client Delivery \& Consulting** * Lead discovery workshops and requirements\-gathering sessions. * Develop assessment reports, implementation plans, architecture diagrams, and executive presentations. * Serve as a trusted advisor for business and technology leadership teams. * Deliver both strategic recommendations and technical implementation guidance. * Collaborate with internal engineering teams to ensure successful project execution. **Required Qualifications** Technical Skills * 3\+ years of experience with Microsoft Purview. * Strong expertise in Microsoft Information Protection, Microsoft Purview DLP, compliance and risk management, data classification and labeling, records and retention management, and eDiscovery and Audit. * Experience implementing Microsoft 365 security and governance controls. * Deep understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot governance, Copilot readiness assessments, AI risk management, and data governance frameworks. * Familiarity with Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Entra ID, SharePoint, Teams, Exchange Online, and Microsoft 365 security architecture. * Knowledge of regulatory and security frameworks such as GLBA, FFIEC, HIPAA, SOX, CJIS, CMMC, and NIST. Consulting \& Communication Skills * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. * Strong documentation and presentation abilities. * Experience leading executive\-level and stakeholder conversations. * Ability to translate technical concepts into business\-focused outcomes. * Experience creating governance documentation, standards, policies, and assessment reports. * Proven ability to lead projects independently. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or Microsoft Fabric. * Experience with AI governance platforms and frameworks. * Familiarity with Anthropic Claude, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, and other enterprise AI platforms. * Knowledge of AI risk management frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and Microsoft Responsible AI principles. * Experience developing AI governance programs from the ground up. * Prior consulting or professional services experience. **Preferred Certifications** * Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate (SC\-400\) * Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC\-100\) * Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC\-200\) * Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\) * Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\) * Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert **What Success Looks Like** In the first year, this individual will: * Lead Microsoft Purview and AI governance engagements for clients. * Become a trusted advisor for data governance and AI strategy initiatives. * Develop repeatable service offerings and governance frameworks. * Assist organizations in securely adopting Microsoft Copilot and other AI solutions. * Contribute to the growth and maturity of Cyber Advisors' AI \& Data Governance practice. ### **About Cyber Advisors:** Cyber Advisors' culture is like no other. First and absolutely foremost, we believe in taking care of our employees and their families. Whether we are blowing off steam at Top Golf, gathering for a fun summer car show, or hosting sales –vs\- engineering paintball war, we play just as hard as we work. We believe good things come to those who sweat. **WHAT WE OFFER** * Competitive salary depending on skills and experience * PTO and 8 Paid Holidays * Employer\-paid Health and Dental Insurance for CA employees * Great opportunities for career advancement * 401k with employer matching * Disability and Life Insurance

At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life\-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies. This entry‑level role works under the guidance of senior engineers and project leaders to assist with PLC\-based hardware and software, automation projects, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives. This position reports to the Global Sr Manager Controls and Automation and is part of the Advanced Engineering Team located in Pensacola FL and will be an on\-site role. **What you will do:** * Assist in analyzing manufacturing processes and identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements, improvement of new processes, technologies, and equipment to support OEE improvements * Support documentation including modification of electrical and control systems schematics, control narratives, and standard procedures * Assist with writing, testing, and debugging PLC and HMI control logic * Support troubleshooting of electrical, control, and process\-related issues * Support validation, installation, commissioning, and startup activities for automation projects **Who you are:** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, or Computer Engineering * Experience in electrical, controls, or automation engineering (co\-op or internship experience acceptable) * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills * Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical. * Willingness to learn, take direction, and grow into increased technical **It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:** * Internship or co\-op experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment * Basic knowledge of electrical concepts, control systems, NEC requirements, automation safety standards and ability to read and develop electrical schematics (AutoCAD experience preferred) * Familiarity with troubleshooting PLC\-controlled equipment and common industrial electrical components (sensors, VFDs, motors, relays, PLC I/O) Cytiva, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info. This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay. We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees. Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law. Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT CYVL** ============== The best infrastructure is invisible. You only notice it when it fails. For decades, the people responsible for our roads, bridges and sidewalks have been asked to manage the physical world with tools that can't see it. Cyvl is the Physical AI company changing that. We build purpose\-built sensors, computer vision and AI that turn every drive into current data: what exists, where it is and what condition it's in. 500\+ cities and towns use our Infrastructure Intelligence Platform to direct the work and fix problems before they fail. 1 in 30 Americans drive on roads managed with Cyvl data. The proof isn't a dashboard. It's a smoother commute, a safer walk to school and public dollars going where they matter most. We're a fast\-moving team in Boston building hardware, software and AI for the real world. If you believe technology's highest calling is public good, come build with us. **THE ROLE** ============ As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll embed with our largest city and agency customers, starting in New York City, and make Cyvl indispensable to how they run. You'll configure the platform against real agency data, prototype custom outputs and integrations with AI coding tools and our API, and find the next problem we can solve for them. This is a strategic growth role that looks like an implementation role, and you'll write the playbook for how we operate in every major US city that follows. This role is based in New York City or San Francisco. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ * Own key city accounts: onboarding, training, and ongoing enablement across field operations, technical teams, IT, and agency leadership. * Build and deploy solutions: configure Cyvl against agency data and workflows, and prototype custom outputs and integrations using Claude Code and Cyvl's API. * Drive expansion: surface budget cycles, RFPs, and unmet needs, and support proposals and renewals with technical depth. * Build durable adoption, so Cyvl never depends on one champion's memory or enthusiasm. * Build the FDE playbook: onboarding sequences, integration patterns, expansion triggers, and ROI frameworks that scale to new cities. **WHAT YOU BRING** ------------------ * 5\+ years in a client\-facing technical role (solutions engineering, technical account management, implementation, or similar), ideally at a B2B SaaS company * Experience managing enterprise accounts with many stakeholders, long cycles, and real organizational complexity * Hands\-on with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), enough to build working custom outputs, not just spec them * Fluency in SaaS and API concepts, and comfort with IT conversations on SSO, integrations, and data access * Credibility in a room with a field operations lead, a city IT team, or an agency commissioner * Based in, or willing to relocate to, New York City or San Francisco **NICE TO HAVE** ---------------- * Government or municipal client experience, including procurement and budget cycles * GIS, geospatial, LiDAR, or infrastructure asset management experience * A track record of expanding accounts, not just retaining them * Appetite to build and lead a team as the FDE function grows **WHY CYVL** ============ **Hard tech. Real streets. Your name on it.** * **Hard problems in the real world.** You build end\-to\-end: our own hardware, software and AI, with work that shows up on the street in the real world. * **Ownership that compounds.** You own outcomes, not tasks. You work directly with customers and across our team, and you'll own more, sooner, than almost anywhere else. * **Intense, with heart.** We're building a category, so it's not a place to coast. We also take care of each other, have genuine fun together, and believe in what we are doing. **WHAT WE ASK** --------------- * **Cross lanes.** "Not my job" doesn't exist here. * **Own without a playbook.** The plan is still being written, often by you. * **Try, miss, try again.** We make big bets. Some won't land, and we learn fast. * **Show up where the work is.** This role is based in New York City or San Francisco. You'll be on\-site with customers regularly and with the team in Somerville for the moments that matter like onboarding, kick\-offs, and milestones. We're a startup building a category. If that sounds like the draw, not the risk, we'd love to talk. **BENEFITS** ------------ * **Equity.** You'll own a piece of what you're building. * **Health, dental, and vision.** Cyvl covers most of the premium for you and your family. * **401k with a real match, vested day one.** Your money is yours from the start. * **Generous PTO \& Paid Parental leave.** Doing hard work well includes stepping away from it. * **Learning stipend.** Spend it on whatever makes you sharper. * **Team events.** Time together in Boston with a team you’ll love working with. **OUR VALUES** -------------- * **Real:** Authentic and transparent. Focused on solving real problems with simple, effective solutions. * **All Out:** Bold, driven, and committed to delivering results that matter. * **Accelerating:** Always learning, growing, and moving with intention. * **Reliable:** We follow through and deliver at a consistently high bar. * **Empowering:** We lift each other up and help governments build infrastructure they can be proud of. **SEE OUR WORK** ---------------- * How Atlanta cut downtown potholes by 60% * How Buffalo turned a campaign promise into a paving plan * How to rebuild US infrastructure smarter **We build for every community, so we hire from all of them.** The best people for this work come from different backgrounds, paths, and places, and many of them don't check every box. If this role excites you, apply anyway. If you need an adjustment to our interview process, tell us and we'll make it work. Compensation Range: $120K \- $195K

jobs.description: **Posting Date** 09/30/2026 601 Hawaii St, El Segundo, California, 90245\-4814, United States of America**Senior DevOps Engineer \- FinOps (Remote)** ============================================= **About the Role** ------------------ As a Senior DevOps Engineer specializing in FinOps, you will lead the technical strategy, design, and implementation of cloud financial engineering and automated cost governance across our enterprise cloud infrastructure. In this role, you will bridge platform engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), and cloud economics by building automated guardrails, developer tooling, and intelligent infrastructure systems that maximize cloud ROI and operational efficiency. You will embed financial accountability and cost transparency directly into the software development lifecycle (SDLC)\-architecting shift\-left CI/CD guardrails, policy\-as\-code validation, automated resource lifecycle workflows, and container\-level cost allocation frameworks. We are seeking an experienced DevOps professional with deep expertise in enterprise cloud architecture, infrastructure as code (IaC), container orchestration, and software automation, paired with an advanced mastery of the FinOps Framework, cloud economic models, and unit economics. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Cloud FinOps Architecture \& Strategy**: Architect, implement, and maintain enterprise\-grade cloud cost allocation, governance, and automated remediation systems across cloud environments. * **Shift\-Left Cost Governance \& Policy\-as\-Code**: Implement automated cost estimation, budget limits, and policy\-as\-code validation (e.g., Infracost, Open Policy Agent/OPA, Sentinel, Checkov) directly into CI/CD pipelines to prevent architectural cost regressions prior to deployment. * **Infrastructure Automation \& Tooling**: Develop robust internal tools, microservices, and event\-driven automation (Python, Go, serverless functions) for automated idle resource teardown, instance right\-sizing, anomaly detection, and tag compliance enforcement. * **Kubernetes \& Container Cost Optimization**: Design and operationalize granular container cost allocation, bin\-packing, and autoscaling strategies across Kubernetes platforms. * **Enterprise Billing Data Engineering**: Build and scale automated data pipelines and analytical models to ingest, normalize, and analyze cloud billing datasets adhering to the FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS) using SQL, Athena, BigQuery, or Snowflake. * **Rate \& Commitment Optimization Engineering**: Model, automate, and manage enterprise commitment lifecycles (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, Committed Use Discounts) and engineer resilient architectures for Spot and preemptible workload adoption. * **Unit Economics \& Observability**: Establish real\-time telemetry systems linking infrastructure consumption metrics with business KPIs (e.g., cost per transaction, cost per tenant, cost per API call) in partnership with observability and analytics teams. * **Technical Leadership \& FinOps Culture**: Lead recurring technical cost architecture reviews with engineering directors and platform leads, providing actionable optimization recommendations and fostering a culture of cost\-conscious engineering. * **Mentorship \& Enablement**: Mentor DevOps, SRE, and software engineers on cloud financial engineering principles, cost\-effective system design patterns, and sustainable cloud architecture. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Minimum Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, or Cloud Infrastructure Architecture in high\-scale enterprise environments. * 3\+ years of dedicated technical experience implementing FinOps practices, cloud economic modeling, and automated cloud cost optimization. * Advanced hands\-on expertise with at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including multi\-account organization structures, networking, IAM, and enterprise billing APIs. * Deep production expertise with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration tooling (e.g., Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, or Pulumi). * Advanced proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, Go, Bash, or TypeScript) for developing automation, CLI tools, and API integrations. * Production experience integrating automated checks, linters, and policy\-as\-code into modern CI/CD ecosystems (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Jenkins). * Strong working knowledge of container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes / EKS / AKS / GKE), resource management, and container cost visibility tooling (e.g., Kubecost, OpenCost, Karpenter). * Demonstrated experience with cloud rate optimization instruments (Savings Plans, RIs, CUDs), discount modeling, and enterprise commitment management. * Strong data querying and modeling skills (SQL) with experience analyzing large\-scale billing datasets (AWS CUR, Azure Cost ure \& Container Cost Allocation (EKS/AKS/GKE, Kubecost, OpenCost, Karpenter) * CI/CD Pipeline Automation (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD) * Cloud Rate Optimization \& Commitment Management (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, Spot/Preemptibles) * Billing Data Pipelines, SQL \& Unit Economics Telemetry * Enterprise Governance, Tagging Enforcement \& Account Hierarchy Architecture **What We’ll Provide** More than just pay, our DaVita Rewards package connects teammates to what matters most.
