jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: We’re looking for talented professionals to join us in bringing smart money management and payment solutions to everyone’s fingertips. This position is classified as structured hybrid, with an expectation of a minimum of three (3\) days per week working in the office and flexibility to work remotely on the remaining days. On\-site expectations may evolve over time to support business needs, with clear communication provided in advance. \<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\> **JOB DESCRIPTION** **Location Requirement** This position is open only to candidates who currently reside in one of the following approved locations: **West Los Angeles, CA** **Role Overview** ----------------- We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Lead Software Engineer to join our Firewire team, supporting a highly transactional (approx. 500\-800 TPS) system. This role will be instrumental in building and supporting scalable, secure, and high\-performance systems that enable embedded financial services across our partner ecosystem. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead the design and development of APIs and microservices that support Firewire stack. * Design, develop, and oversee large\-scale software systems, ensuring alignment with business goals and long\-term scalability. Make high\-level design choices and establish coding standards, design patterns, and architectural principles for the engineering organization * Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other engineering teams to define technical requirements and deliver robust solutions. * Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, mentoring, and best practices in CI/CD, testing, and observability. * Ensure compliance with SLA standards and contribute to the development of monitoring and alerting systems. * Lead incident response and root cause analysis to improve system reliability. * Drive architectural decisions and long\-term technical strategy for BaaS platform, including generating documentation around architectural and design options analysis and decisions. * Champion emerging technologies evaluation and adoption. * Refactor and extend the existing codebase to fix defects and add features/functionality * Create systems that are durable and flexible by developing for change – favor configurability over customization. * Manage software development projects, including planning, system analysis, testing, deployment, and troubleshooting complex issues * Operate in an **AI driven SDLC environment** and familiarity with **AI code assistants** like **GitHub Copilot** or similar tools. * Work closely with product managers, architects, and cross\-functional teams to translate requirements into robust technical designs and ensure software meets user needs * Drive adoption of new technologies, frameworks, and development methodologies, and develop prototypes or proofs\-of\-concept to mitigate implementation risks **Qualifications** ------------------ * 9\+ years of hands\-on experience in software engineering, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership role. * Strong portfolio of work showing experience developing secure and standards\-compliant code across multiple platforms. * Advanced experience in several of the following languages/platforms/libraries: C\#, .NET, SQL, and hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure native services such as APIM, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB and Key Vault), container technologies, and caching frameworks. * Deep understanding of RESTful API design, OAuth2, and OpenAPI specifications. * Strong expertise in event\-driven (Service Bus, Event Hubs) and microservice based architecture patterns. * Ability to troubleshoot complex software issues, work independently, and provide innovative solutions * Hands\-on experience with leveraging and implementing observability dashboards and platforms (Datadog, Grafana). * Strong leadership, communication, and collaboration skills, with a passion for quality, learning, and mentoring * Ability to handle a fast\-paced environment for iterative project turnarounds on mission \& revenue critical, customer\-facing applications * Deep knowledge in Git, DevOps, Agile Scrum, and security best practices in financial services and compliance standards (PCI DSS, SOC 2\). **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Prior experience in fintech or embedded finance platforms. * Familiarity with partner integration workflows using API and SLA management. * Contributions to open\-source projects or technical publications. \*\***Ability to work in the U.S. without sponsorship\*\*** **\*\*Ability to meet the location requirement outlined above\*\*** **POSITION TYPE** Contractor**PAY RANGE** The targeted base salary for this position is $159,400 to $229,300 per year. The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location. \<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\> **We’re Here to Support You—Accommodations Upon Request** Green Dot is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, we encourage you to let us know. We will work with you to meet your needs in a way that respects your privacy and ensures equal opportunity. Our goal is to support every applicant in showcasing their talents and potential. **Work Authorization Requirement** At Green Dot Corporation, we value diversity and strive for fair and inclusive hiring practices. However, we are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship. All applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout the duration of employment, without the need for current or future sponsorship. **Important Notice on Application Accuracy** We value integrity in our hiring process. Please ensure that all information provided in your resume and application is accurate and authentic. Submissions found to be fraudulent or misleading will result in disqualification from consideration, and any offers extended may be rescinded.

jobs.title: People Technology Senior SWE
jobs.description: **About Gusto** At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve. All full\-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy. AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process. **About the Role:** We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our People Technology team as the dedicated architect and hands on engineer behind PeopleOS — our AI\-native internal HR platform — and the broader suite of custom tools and integrations that power our People tech ecosystem. In this role, you will design, build, and ship software that directly shapes how every Gustie experiences HR, from recruiting and onboarding to performance and offboarding. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on full\-stack engineer and problem solver who thrives in ambiguity, cares about the employee experience, and wants to see their work used every day by real people. **About the Team:** The People Solutions team is transforming how Gusto supports its people by pairing cutting\-edge AI with smart automation. We build — not just configure — the systems that power People programs and processes. We optimize workflows, enhance service delivery, and free up teams to focus on meaningful, high\-impact work to support a more responsive, efficient, and future\-ready people experience. **Here's what you'll do day\-to\-day:** **Product Engineering — PeopleOS** * Be the technical owner for PeopleOS, our internal AI\-powered HR platform that was built with the purpose of enhanced Gustie experiences for people programs and a more efficient People team with features like the Offer Workflow Engine, People Home Base portal, Celebration tools, and automated Talk Track generation * Partner directly with People Ops stakeholders to translate workflows into working software driving technical design, implementation, UAT support, and release **Integration \& Systems Development** * Design, build, test, and maintain integrations across Workday, Greenhouse, Lattice, Slack, and Google Workspace * Build and maintain custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that give AI agents structured access to People Systems data where no native tool MCP exists **AI\-Powered Tooling** * Integrate the Anthropic API (Claude) to build intelligent internal tools including QPR coaching agents, HR front door chatbots, and ticket deflection workflows * Design prompts, handle structured outputs, and build safe, reliable AI\-assisted workflows for People Ops use cases **Collaboration \& Quality** * Document integration specs, data mappings, and system configurations in Notion * Participate in Jira sprint planning and demo work to stakeholders bi\-weekly * Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and proactively implement corrective actions across the portfolio **Here's what we're looking for:** * 7\+ years of full\-stack software engineering experience, with production\-quality work in Python, TypeScript/Node.js, or both * Strong experience building and consuming REST APIs — including OAuth flows, rate limiting, pagination, and error handling * Demonstrated ability to integrate SaaS platforms (bonus: Workday, Greenhouse, Slack, or Google Workspace) * Comfort with AI/LLM API integration — Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent — including prompt design and response parsing * Experience shipping internal tools or developer tooling with real end users and feedback loops * Strong written communication: you can document your own APIs, write a clear tech spec, and explain trade\-offs to non\-engineers * An understanding of sensitivity of HR data and familiarity with implications of labor law and data retention guidelines **Preferred** * Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) server architecture * Experience with HR Tech ecosystems: HRIS, ATS, LMS platforms * Background in People Ops, HR Systems, or internal tools engineering at a high\-growth tech company * Experience with XML, XSLT, JSON, and related integration technologies Our cash compensation amount for this role is between $138,000 \- $194,000 in Denver, between $168,895 \- $235,000/year for New York/San Francisco. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above. Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately **2\-3 days** per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale. Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas. When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non\-office days for hybrid employees. Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto. Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you. Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer. Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Secure Execution
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ New York **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Security **Compensation** ---------------- * $231K – $346\.4K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus *Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in our equity plan and benefits program. Benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.* **Why Harvey** ============== At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. **Role Overview** ================= As a Staff Software Engineer on the Security Engineering team, you will join as a founding team member and build the security foundations that let Harvey put increasingly capable AI agents to work. You'll lead development of a platform for agents to perform security work, while shaping how agents are sandboxed across our product and internal platforms. One of the central challenges is enabling models with advanced cybersecurity capabilities to discover and validate vulnerabilities automatically, including through authorized penetration testing, while protecting sensitive data and systems. You'll build the execution environments, orchestration, and controls that make this possible, and help enable the internal use of open\-source models with appropriate protections around inference, tool use, and data access. You'll work closely with the teams building Harvey's product sandbox and internal AI agent platform, shaping architecture and contributing production code to strengthen execution boundaries. Your impact will come from shipping systems, establishing a shared technical direction, and making security capabilities reusable across teams. You'll own work from design through rollout and operation, balancing containment with the reliability, performance, and flexibility that useful agents need. **What you'll do** ================== * Set the technical direction for secure agent execution, working across Security, Infrastructure, and Product Engineering to turn emerging capabilities and risks into a concrete roadmap. * Design, build, and operate a platform for security agents to discover and validate vulnerabilities within authorized targets and execution boundaries, producing reproducible evidence that engineers can act on. * Build reusable controls for agent tool use, code execution, network and filesystem access, resource consumption, and workload lifecycle. Integrate with identity and secrets platforms to limit access to the data and credentials each task needs. * Partner with the owners of Harvey's product sandbox and internal agent platform to make architectural decisions, implement protections, and integrate shared security capabilities into their execution environments. * Enable internal use of open\-source models alongside infrastructure teams, building protections around model serving, agent execution, and sensitive\-data handling. * Develop adversarial tests, evaluations, and telemetry that verify containment and expose failures. Build mechanisms to scope, observe, interrupt, and safely terminate agent activity. * Lead delivery and adoption across teams, mentor engineers, and remain hands\-on through implementation and production operation, making clear tradeoffs across security, reliability, latency, and cost. **What You Have** ================= * 10\+ years developing and running production software, including technical leadership on initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams. * Strong software engineering skills in languages such as Go, Rust, Python, or C\+\+, with practical experience in Linux systems, networking, and containerized infrastructure. * Deep expertise in one or more areas of execution security, such as sandboxing, operating\-system isolation, container or virtual\-machine security, or platforms that execute untrusted code. You can translate threats into enforceable boundaries and test how those boundaries fail. * Experience building shared platforms, services, or libraries and helping other teams adopt them through clear interfaces, documentation, and safe migrations. * Experience with cloud infrastructure and distributed systems, including observability, failure handling, capacity management, and dependable production operation. * Fluency with AI\-assisted engineering and agentic workflows: you use models to accelerate development, validate their output, and reason about the risks introduced when agents use tools, execute code, or access sensitive data. * Strong communication and technical judgment, with a record of bringing teams to agreement on ambiguous problems and carrying decisions through to delivery. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with microVMs, hypervisors, or sandbox runtimes such as Firecracker, gVisor, or Kata Containers, or Linux isolation mechanisms such as namespaces, seccomp, and Landlock. * Experience building agent runtimes, tool\-execution frameworks, or automated security\-testing platforms. * Experience with vulnerability research, penetration testing, or adversarial evaluation of agent systems, including turning findings into reproducible tests and effective controls. * Experience deploying or securing self\-hosted inference and open\-source models, including isolation of model\-serving workloads and protection of sensitive inputs and outputs. **Compensation** ================ $231,000 \- $346,400 USD ### **Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices \[****here****].** \#LI\-NP1 *Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.* We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made by emailing accommodations@harvey.ai

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About HUD** ============= HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25\. **About the role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Product Engineer to turn important, cross\-cutting product problems into shipped experiences across HUD’s platform and marketplace. You’ll work with our product, design, engineering, research, and GTM teams to understand where environment creators and research teams get stuck, decide what to improve, and build the solution. This role combines product judgment, interaction design, and full\-stack engineering. You’ll move from user conversations and early prototypes to production software, making technically dense workflows clear and useful without losing the detail users need. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Talk with users and internal teams to find friction in creating, testing, evaluating, and discovering RL environments; shape those findings into clear product priorities * Design, prototype, and ship product improvements across HUD’s platform and marketplace, owning work from problem definition through launch and iteration * Make agent runs, evaluation results, reward signals, and quality feedback easier to understand and act on through thoughtful interfaces and workflows * Build the frontend and backend pieces needed to improve vendor onboarding, environment submission, review, and discovery for research teams * Use user feedback and product signals to assess what works, refine the experience, and help product, design, and engineering make tradeoffs **Experience** -------------- **You may be a good fit if you have:** * A record of shipping software products end\-to\-end, from understanding the user problem through implementation and iteration * Strong product judgment: you can identify the problem behind a request, set a useful scope, and make sound tradeoffs with incomplete information * Interaction design skills and a high bar for clarity and usability in complex, technical workflows * Full\-stack engineering ability, including building polished web interfaces and the backend services or APIs that support them * Comfort talking directly with users and using qualitative feedback and product data to improve what you ship * Clear communication and the ability to work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, researchers, and other partners **Strong candidates may also have:** * Experience with developer tools, data\-rich products, marketplaces, or products serving distinct groups of users * Familiarity with AI agents, evaluations, reinforcement learning, or training data * Experience designing workflows for review, debugging, quality feedback, or other complex operational work * Experience finding and owning product gaps in a growing, cross\-functional team *We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.* **Team \& company details** --------------------------- * **Team Size**: \~25 people currently, mostly full\-time in\-person, but some remote. * **Our team:** Our team includes 4 International Olympiad medalists (IOI, ILO, IPhO), serial AI startup founders, and researchers with publications at ICLR, NeurIPS, etc. * **Company stage:** We have 8 figures in funding and are scaling profitably and quickly to meet very strong demand. **Logistics** ------------- * **Employment**: Full\-time. * **Location**: We have offices in San Francisco or Singapore but are open to remote candidates who **can work hours that 70\-80% overlap with either San Francisco or Singapore time zones.** * **Visa Sponsorship**: We provide support for relocation and visas for strong full\-time candidates to the US or Singapore. * **Timeline**: Applications are rolling. The process is 2 technical interviews and a 2\-3 day work trial. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation * 100% covered top\-of\-the\-line medical, dental, and vision from Blue Shield of CA (US employees) * Lunch and dinner when you’re in the office (in\-office employees) * Company\-wide holiday break (Christmas Eve to New Year’s Day) on top of PTO and paid holidays * Other perks including an Equinox membership, 401k, and commuter benefits (US employees) * Unlimited\* access to tokens for ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, etc. \**By unlimited, we mean no one on our token usage leaderboard has ever hit a limit. So we have no idea what the limit is.* Due to high volume, we may not actively respond to every application, but feel free to contact us at recruiting@hud.so or elsewhere if we missed your application!

jobs.title: Media Solutions Engineer II (Remote)
jobs.description: The Media Solutions Engineer 2 is a senior position responsible for supporting the design, implementation, and operation of Hallmark Media’s content management and supply chain systems. This role collaborates with both technical and business teams to automate workflows, integrate media systems, and ensure reliable content delivery to all consumer platforms. The position works closely with internal business units—including Distribution, Media Solutions Engineering, Technical Operations, Media IT, and Corporate IT—to facilitate the proper implementation, availability, and operation of media management systems. As a member of the Technical Operations team, you will help manage Hallmark Media’s content library, post\-production, and media supply chain systems. Key responsibilities include designing technical solutions for business process automation and system integration to create a unified media ecosystem that supports all Hallmark Media consumer endpoints. ***The salary range for this job is between*** ***$98,500\-$133,100\. Salary*** ***rate will take into consideration several factors including location.*** **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Supports the development of solutions that utilize our existing media systems to meet business requirements, helping to identify technological gaps and opportunities. * Collaborates with the Media Services Solutions Team and other departments within Technical Operations, IT \& Distribution, contributing to the execution of functional designs, including support of our business partners automation at Comcast Technical Services and Amagi. * Assists related teams in meeting infrastructure requirements and participates in leading support responses and escalations for system issues. * Supports change control processes for all media systems, including coordinating outages, deployment windows, upgrades, and system installations. * Contributes to quality assurance (QA) and testing efforts by assisting in the coordination, writing, and execution of test plans for software applications. * Supports the development of system monitoring techniques and reporting methods to provide issue notifications, performance trends, and metrics for management. * Addresses user requests and issues related to media management systems, directing users to appropriate support teams, or resolving issues directly when possible. * Aids in training staff on systems and supports the development of application support strategies and coverage schedules. * Utilizes project management methodologies, such as Agile, to organize tasks and ensure the delivery of projects that align with business needs. * Participates in documenting and analyzing user stories/requirements, acceptance criteria, and success factors to ensure proposed solutions are effective. **BASIC REQUIREMENTS** * Minimum of five years of experience in Media/Broadcast/Information technology and operations. * Proven experience with SOAP/REST APIs and scripting languages \& a willingness to expand these skills in integration workflows is essential. * Proven experience in enterprise\-level Media Asset Management systems is sought. * Exhibits a basic understanding in video production/post\-production technologies, workflows, and systems such as Helmut PAM, Adobe Suite, Amberfin, AWS Media Convert and Telestream Vantage. * Prior experience in Windows and Linux Server Administration * Exhibits a basic knowledge of relational databases. * Exhibits an understanding of storage systems, including Cloud, SAN, NAS, and LTO. * Exhibits basic knowledge of networking principles, including TCP/UDP protocols. **OTHER REQUIREMENTS** * Preferred AWS Certification in one of Solution Architecture, DevOps, Systems Engineer * System thinkers who understand not only how a code works and looks but also how it fits into the larger ecosystem of services. * Self\-starter who exhibits ownership on assigned tasks and who will push for solutions that solve immediate problems while building towards long\-term goals. * Strong attention to detail. * Ability to build rapport with clients and manage expectations. ***Hallmark Media is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, pregnancy, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally\-protected status. Principals only please.*** Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description: Location: Sunnyvale \- California, USA Additional Location: Northridge \- California, USA Job Family: Engineering Worker Type Reference: Regular \- Permanent Pay Rate Type: Salary Career Level: E1 Job ID: R\-55858\-2026 ### **Description \& Requirements** **Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Corporate** We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Corporate, you are integral to our company’s award\-winning success. * Enrich your managerial and organizational talents – from finance, quality, and supply chain to human resources, IT, sales, and strategy * Augment your comprehensive skillset with expert training across decision\-making, change management, leadership, and business development Obtain 360\-degree support throughout your career life cycle, from early\-stage to seasoned leader * **What You’ll Be Part Of** You will serve as a senior technical leader across HARMAN, helping turn emerging technologies and HARMAN's Technology Strategy into differentiated technical capabilities and future business opportunities. You are an authentic technologist with the depth to earn the respect of HARMAN's strongest engineers and scientists and the breadth to operate across Automotive, Consumer and Professional markets. You combine first\-principles technical thinking with business judgment and understand the full journey from research and experimentation through architecture, engineering and productization. This is not a technology\-strategy or divisional engineering role. You will partner closely with Technology Strategy and HARMAN's business engineering leaders, providing technical leadership where opportunities cross organizational boundaries, are still immature, or require capabilities that do not yet exist. **Your Team** You will join the HARMAN Chief Technology Officer's direct reports team as a key member. You will work across HARMAN Research, Technology Strategy, Automotive, Lifestyle and Samsung technology organizations. Depending on the strategic technology domains being pursued, you will establish and lead focused teams combining HARMAN experts with external partners, academia, startups and Samsung research and pre\-development organizations. **How You’ll Make An Impact** * Serve as a senior technical authority across HARMAN and provide independent technical judgment on strategically important technologies and architectures. * Translate priorities identified through HARMAN's Technology Strategy into technical hypotheses, architectures, experiments and capability\-building programs. * Identify technical discontinuities and opportunities that could materially affect HARMAN's future competitiveness. * Lead selected advanced\-technology initiatives from early exploration through demonstrated technical and business viability and transition toward the businesses. * Build strategic technology capabilities and high\-caliber technical teams in areas where HARMAN needs to establish or strengthen differentiated expertise. * Connect and challenge technical communities across Automotive, Consumer, Professional, HARMAN Research and Samsung. * Advise HARMAN technology and business leaders on complex technology choices, including build, partner, acquire or experiment decisions. * Establish strong relationships with leading technology companies, startups, academia and Samsung research organizations and represent HARMAN credibly with customers, partners and the external technology community. **What Makes You A Strong Fit** * Exceptional technical track record with demonstrated hands\-on depth in a combination of relevant technology domains like physics, software, AI, Machine Learning, acoustics, material science or signal processing, and the ability to reason credibly across adjacent fields. * Proven experience creating significant technologies, architectures, platforms or products \- not only managing organizations that created them. * Experience spanning research or advanced development and industrial\-scale product development or productization. * Broad systems thinking across software, hardware and physical systems; relevant domains may include AI/ML, embedded systems, software platforms, UX/HMI, audio and signal processing, sensing, compute, connectivity and multi\-physics systems. * Proven ability to rapidly understand unfamiliar technical domains, identify the critical questions and engage credibly with deep experts. * Demonstrated ability to translate complex technology into business, competitive and investment implications. * This role ensures continuous availability of video services for Commissioners’ Court, Multi\-Purpose and Conference Rooms. The engineer plays a critical role in system configuration, upgrades, troubleshooting, and providing 24/7 support for video endpoints, recording systems, and livestream environments. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Provide technical support for the Commissioners Court live streaming via service provider. * Install and update software \& firmware for AV related devices. * Design and manage AV projects between vendor and customer. * Update configuration of Crestron, Extron, QSC and AMX control systems * Update and maintain AV assets in monitoring tools. * Provide backup support for AV Architect and their duties. * Provide technical support AV and video conferencing systems. **Harris County is an Equal Opportunity Employer** https://hrrm.harriscountytx.gov/Pages/EqualEmploymentOpportunityPlan.aspx If you need special services or accommodations, please call (713\) 274\-5445 or email ADACoordinator@bmd.hctx.net. **This position is subject to a criminal history check. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Applied AI
jobs.description: **About the company** ===================== Headstart is built for people who want to think like founders. We work inside real enterprises ($100M\+ ARR), shipping production AI systems that change how they operate. Every engagement is a different industry, problem, and set of constraints. We're bootstrapped, cash\-flow positive, and growing fast, and we're building our own platform to deliver truly agentic systems. **Why join us** =============== Enterprise clients bring us messy, high\-stakes problems, often with no clear picture of what the AI system should be. Our engineers work out what to build, build it, and run it in production. Most of the time, they're the experts in the room. This role is part player, part coach, part staffing partner. Most of your time stays on a client engagement, hands\-on, close to the work and to where engineers get stuck. You'll manage a group of engineers across a few engagements and grow with the team as we do. **Level:** Reports to the Head of Engineering. You run a team inside our system: you apply the bar, keep your engineers growing, and stay close to the work. **What you'll own** =================== * **Your engineers.** Manage engineers up to senior, hold a high bar, and give direct, actionable feedback. Coach on execution and help strong engineers step up toward tech lead. * **Technical leadership.** Review architecture, agent, prompt, and eval design on your engagements. Step into hard technical and client situations, like production regressions and unclear requirements, and make the call. Raise trouble early, while it's cheap to fix. * **Engagement delivery.** Run the engagement\-level relationship with clients and their stakeholders, alongside product and client partners, so each engagement lands. * **Staffing.** Manage transitions on your team, plan ahead, and flag risks before they reach a client. Escalate conflicts across engagements to the Head of Engineering. * **Hiring.** Interview, calibrate, close, and onboard new engineers against the bar the Head of Engineering sets. * **Practice.** Follow the team's practices and tell us what isn't working. Bring patterns you see to the wider team so they can become standing practice, and make sure your engineers use what exists. **Your background** =================== * 3\+ years managing engineers, with real experience giving feedback and developing people. * 5\+ years in software engineering, deep enough to review designs and challenge the team's approach. Hands\-on with Python. * Experience delivering software in real client environments. * Curious about agents, evals, and multi\-agent systems, with a sense of where they're reliable and where a person needs to take the wheel. Fluent with AI coding tools. Depth matters more than prior title. **Bonus:** management experience in a consulting, services, or forward deployed engineering organization, or experience taking a team or practice from zero to one. **How we work** =============== High trust, high agency, low ego. We push back when something isn't right and share what we learn, so good instincts spread fast. * **We are our first client.** We built Friday, our coding agent, and Statum, our knowledge infrastructure, and we run them on ourselves. * **AI\-first, human\-accountable.** Agents write nearly all our client code. Every output is reviewed, and the person is accountable. * **Partners, not a vendor.** You're in the room when hard calls get made, and you're expected to have a point of view. * **Breadth that compounds.** You'll see more industries and problems in a year than most people see in a career. * **Weekends are yours.** Pay is transparent, and we don't confuse long hours with good work. **What to expect** ================== * **Initial screen (30 min):** with our recruiting partner. * **Technical screen (30 min):** a short, real\-world coding exercise with an engineer. * **Hiring manager interview (45 min):** behavioral and past work. * **Technical interviews (2\.5 hrs, two sessions):** coding and systems design. Use AI tools in the coding interview, since it reflects how we work. * **Case study (75 min):** a live, scenario\-based discussion covering staffing, feedback, technical review, and closing the loop. No prep needed. **What we offer** ================= * Base salary of $285,000 USD plus competitive equity * 401k with 4\.5% employer match, and fully covered medical, dental, and vision premiums * Monthly wellness stipend, Citi Bike, and pre\-tax commuter benefits * 12 weeks parental leave, with an optional 4\-week ramp\-up at 50% * Loft office in Soho with lunch and snacks * Hybrid in NYC. We're open to fully remote candidates in the US or Canada. Compensation Range: $285K

It's What We Do We provide total building system design and construction services across multiple high\-growth markets throughout the country for industry leaders. You'll get to use your talent to work on projects for some of the biggest names in mission\-critical, higher education, sports, healthcare, grocery, restaurant, and retail within the sectors we serve in business, community, grocery, health, retail, and venue. jobs.description: **OUR HIRING PROCESS:** * We will review your application against our job requirements. Please note: We do not conduct interviews via text message, Telegram, etc. and we never hire anyone into our organization without having met you face\-to\-face (or via Zoom). You will be invited to come to a live meeting or Zoom, where you will meet our INFUSE team. * From there on, it's decision time! If you are still excited to join INFUSE and we like you as much, we will have a conversation about your offer. We do not make offers without giving you the opportunity to speak with us live. INFUSE is committed to complying with applicable data privacy and security laws and regulations. For more information, please see our Privacy Policy We are looking for an AI \& Software Solutions Architect to guide architectural decisions across INFUSE's products and teams. You will review solutions built by internal teams and external vendors, establish shared engineering standards, guide legacy modernisation, and help ensure that production AI systems are reliable, secure and cost\-effective. As the Software Development department's sole Solutions Architect, you will report directly to the Director of Technology and work across a landscape of 500\+ repositories, including backend services, LLM\-based products and several legacy systems requiring ongoing modernisation. This is a senior individual contributor role with company\-wide technical influence and no direct people management. Success in this role depends on strong technical judgement, clear communication and the ability to influence engineering decisions across teams. Your work will centre on architecture, reviews and cross\-project improvements, alongside prototypes and selected hands\-on development tasks. Engineering teams will deliver the broader implementation. ### **What you will do:** * Translate business needs into architectural decisions, explaining trade\-offs, costs and risks and balancing technical quality with delivery priorities. * Review code, architecture and vendor deliverables. Produce concise, actionable findings, prioritise improvements, and verify that critical issues have been resolved. * Establish shared standards across projects, including security, documentation, service contracts and observability, and guide teams in adopting them. * Define guardrails for production LLM and agentic systems, covering evaluation, prompt management, model routing, multi\-provider access, security and cost control. * Guide legacy modernisation initiatives, including application decomposition, authorisation modernisation, workflow migration and safe transition planning. * Work with engineering and DevOps teams to advance Kubernetes adoption, improve deployment workflows and observability, and diagnose architectural bottlenecks. * Build prototypes and reference implementations to validate decisions, and conduct technical interviews for engineering hires. ### **What you will bring:** * 5\+ years in software engineering, including 3\+ years owning architectural decisions for production systems as an architect, principal engineer or technical lead, with experience taking solutions from initial concept through implementation to production. * Strong computer science and system design fundamentals for scalable, high\-load distributed systems, including reliability, failure handling, observability and architectural trade\-offs. * Hands\-on AWS experience designing and running production services, plus practical Kubernetes experience and the ability to work closely with DevOps on deployment and operational improvements. * Experience delivering production LLM\-based solutions, with an understanding of their lifecycle from business need and design through implementation and operation. Relevant experience includes RAG, tool calling, multi\-provider integrations and cost optimisation. * Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems across quality, latency and cost using observability and evaluation tooling such as Langfuse or similar platforms. * Experience reviewing other teams' code and architecture and guiding legacy modernisation or migrations. * A strong software engineering background, preferably with substantial Python and/or Node.js experience, and the flexibility to review and work across different stacks, including legacy PHP. * Experience with PostgreSQL and NoSQL design and query optimisation, and asynchronous, event\-driven systems using Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar brokers. * Practical experience using agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex or similar, with sound judgement about verifying generated code and assessing proposed changes. * Clear technical writing and communication with engineers and non\-technical stakeholders. You connect technical decisions to business goals, cost, risk and measurable outcomes, take responsibility for their consequences, and adjust your approach based on evidence. * B2 or higher English for collaboration with distributed teams. ### **Nice to have:** * Experience with AIOps: applying AI to operational workflows, including anomaly detection, alert correlation, incident triage and observability. * Understanding when classical ML is more appropriate than an LLM, and experience with MLOps. * Experience with Keycloak or Azure AD SSO migrations. * Experience with Backstage. * Experience conducting vendor delivery audits. * AWS Solutions Architect – Professional or Anthropic Claude certification. ### **We offer:** * We offer a competitive salary tailored to the candidate's experience and skills. Payments are processed monthly (USD) * Full Remote. Work schedule: Monday\-Friday, from 1:00 pm to 9:00 pm EEST (incl. 60\-min breaks) * Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI and cloud solutions * Access to the latest AI tools and premium subscriptions * Long\-term B2B collaboration * Paid sick leave, vacation, and public holidays * Reduced Fridays during the summer

This is a builder's role first: you'll write production code, own complex components end to end, and lead by doing, while also guiding architecture and mentoring the engineers around you. You'll work closely with product, clinical, and engineering peers to turn ambitious healthcare goals into robust, scalable software that ships. If you want to operate at Principal scope without stepping away from the keyboard, this role is for you. **A Day in the Life** * Design, build, and ship the most complex and critical components of Innovaccer's platform — backend services, APIs, and data pipelines — writing high\-quality production code yourself. * Build AI/ML\-powered product features end to end: integrating models, designing the systems and data flows around them, and ensuring they perform reliably in production. * Own technical architecture for major systems, making hands\-on design decisions for scalability, performance, security, and cost, then implementing them. * Lead by example on engineering best practices across the full SDLC — code quality, testing, security, observability, and operational excellence — and raise the bar through the code you write and review. * Build resilient, well\-tested services that integrate cleanly across products and with external healthcare systems. * Ensure the software you build complies with healthcare and data\-protection requirements, including HIPAA and GDPR, embedding compliance and security into the implementation. * Debug, profile, and harden production systems, taking ownership of reliability and incident response for the systems you build. * Provide hands\-on technical mentorship to senior and staff engineers through design reviews, pairing, and code review. * Partner with product and clinical stakeholders to turn real\-world needs into well\-scoped, technically sound designs you can deliver. * Evaluate and select technologies, frameworks, and tooling, balancing capability, cost, risk, and time\-to\-value. **Requirements** ---------------- * Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 10\+ years of software engineering experience with a strong track record of personally building and shipping large\-scale production systems. * Deep, current, hands\-on coding expertise in one or more modern languages (e.g.,Python, Java, Go, or similar) — this role writes code daily. * Strong software design skills across distributed systems, backend services, APIs, and data\-intensive architectures. * Experience building and integrating AI/ML into products — connecting models to real systems, handling data flows, and operationalizing them in production (you don't need to be a research scientist, but you should be comfortable building AI/ML\-powered features). * Hands\-on experience operating production systems: CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, monitoring, performance tuning, and incident response. * Familiarity with healthcare data standards (e.g., FHIR, HL7\) and regulatory compliance (HIPAA, GDPR), or the ability to ramp quickly on a regulated domain. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and strong communication, with the ability to align engineers and stakeholders around a technical approach. * Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). **Benefits** ------------ We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work. **Here’s What We Offer** * Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and relax with 20 days of fixed time off per year, in addition to company holidays—because we believe work\-life balance fuels performance. * Best\-in\-Class Parental Leave: Spend quality time with your growing family. We offer one of the industry’s most generous parental leave policies to support you during life’s most important moments. * Recognition \& Rewards: We celebrate wins—big and small. Get rewarded with monetary incentives and company\-wide recognition for your impact and dedication. Your hard work won’t go unnoticed. * Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Stay covered with medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus 100% company\-paid short\- and long\-term disability and basic life insurance. Optional perks include discounted legal aid and pet insurance.

jobs.description: Our employees are at the heart of what we do: helping people, businesses and society prosper in good times and be resilient in bad times. When you join our team, you are bringing this purpose to life alongside a passionate community. Feel empowered to learn and grow while being valued for who you are. At Intact, we commit to supporting you in reaching your goals with tools, opportunities, and flexibility. It’s our promise to you. **Who we are** At Intact Insurance Specialty Solutions, we are experts at what we do in protecting what makes businesses unique. Our deep understanding of the specialty insurance market is the foundation for our customized solutions, backed by targeted risk control and claims services. Our employees are passionate about providing insurance coverage that’s aligned to our targeted customer groups. Intact’s Global Specialty Lines business spans across more than 20 verticals in four distinct markets: U.S., Canada, UK and Europe. The following opportunity is for our U.S. team. **The opportunity** We currently have an opportunity for a Quality Engineering Analyst to join our IT team in our Canton, MA; Boston, MA; Farmington, CT; Raleigh, NC offices on a hybrid schedule. The Quality Engineering Analyst must have 3\-5 years of experience in manual and test automation who is eager to explore, adopt, and implement AI‑driven testing approaches. This role is ideal for a quality engineer who has a strong automation foundation and is motivated to evolve traditional testing practices using modern AI and intelligent automation techniques. Some of the Quality Engineering Analyst responsibilities include but are not limited to: **Principal Duties and Responsibilities** * Maintain manual and automated test frameworks for web and API applications. * Participate in test planning, estimation, and release activities. * Execute and enhance functional, regression, integration, and smoke tests. * Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to understand requirements and define test strategies early in the SDLC. * Identify opportunities to leverage AI/ML‑based testing tools to improve test coverage, defect detection, and execution efficiency. * Analyze test results, identify root causes, and clearly document defects with actionable insights. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines by integrating automated tests into build and deployment workflows. * Promote quality, best practices and continuous improvement within the QE team. * Contribute to documentation, standards, and continuous improvement initiatives. **Minimum Requirements/Essential Functions** * Ability to demonstrate analytical, decision making, problem solving, and organizational skills. * Must be able to communicate professionally and effectively using oral and written * communication in various forms including video. * Must be able to work both independently, as a member of a team, and have the ability to interact * with a diverse group of follow\-through on commitments. * Requires the ability to maintain confidential information. * Capable and willing to adopt to changes as needed. * Ability to follow work instructions as directed. * Ability to stay focused and productive during required working hours. * Respond to internal and external clients as established by department guidelines. * Ability to travel when the position requires. **The expertise you bring** * Degree in computer science * 3–5 years of hands‑on experience in QE /test automation * Familiarity with Property/Casualty or Specialty insurance preferred. * Experience with automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar * Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language (Java, Python, JavaScript, or similar) * Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals, test design techniques, and SDLC/STLC * Experience testing web applications and APIs (REST, JSON, Postman, etc.) * Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar * Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills * Genuine interest and willingness to explore AI‑powered testing tools and approaches * SQL knowledge * Growth mindset with a passion for innovation in quality engineering Our salary ranges are determined by many factors including location, role, experience and skillset of the candidate. The following ranges displayed reflect the target base salary for new hires; however, your recruiter will provide more specific compensation details during the hiring process. The typical base salary range for this position is: $71,000 \- $ 101,000 based on the factors aforementioned. For candidates located in San Francisco, CA; Washington DC; our Massachusetts based offices and the New York City metro area, the base salary range is $90,000 \- $105,000\. In addition to base salary, full time Intact employees are also eligible for bonus potential and a full range of benefits to include but not limited to: * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance with no waiting period * Competitive paid time off programs * 401(k) savings and annual contributions of up to 12% of annual salary * Mental health support programs, life and disability insurance, paid parental leave and a variety of additional voluntary benefits *This position will remain posted until a final candidate is selected. Intuit Fintech, one of Intuit's fastest\-growing business units, is seeking a **Software Engineer 2** to help shape the technology vision, strategy, and development for the Intuit Fintech Risk Platform. The position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting\-edge Fintech innovations, advanced analytics, and enterprise\-scale development. challenges, this is the opportunity for you! **Responsibilities** * Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and high\-performing software solutions for the Fintech Risk Platform, utilizing React ecosystem by implementing robust compliance measures and risk mitigation strategies. * Utilize advanced statistical models, AI/ML techniques, and risk analytics to power decision\-making and feature development within the risk platform. * Partner with product managers to understand analytics needs, define metrics, and implement executive dashboards to monitor platform performance. * Build data pipelines and models for risk data, ensuring automation, consistency, and scalability across Fintech systems. * Conduct A/B testing and experimentation, interpreting results to optimize platform efficiencies and drive informed decision\-making. * Stay updated with developments in Fintech and AI technologies, identifying opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field (Master's degree preferred) or equivalent work experience. * 2\+ years of professional experience in designing and developing software solutions, with expertise in both front\-end technologies (React) and/or back\-end frameworks (Java, Spring Boot). * Hands\-on experience in GenAI concepts and frameworks (e.g., OpenAI, GPT, SageMaker, Bedrock) and the ability to integrate AI in practical applications. * Prior experience in risk and compliance domains within financial platforms is highly desirable. * Knowledge of Fintech concepts, including payment systems, risk analytics, and compliance strategies. * Proficiency in cloud solutions, particularly AWS, and strong familiarity with modern CI/CD and DevOps practices. * Expertise in scripting languages like Python, SQL, and frameworks for data visualization tools. * Excellent problem\-solving skills, with strong analytical abilities and data storytelling expertise. * Proven experience driving collaboration across engineering, product, and analytics teams to deliver impactful outcomes. * Highly motivated and results\-oriented jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Engineering * JOB219610 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Primary Function of Position** The Ion™ endoluminal system is Intuitive's robotic platform designed for minimally invasive biopsy in the peripheral lung, with the goal of improving early lung cancer diagnosis. This position is part of the New Product Development Platform Software team and will focus on developing embedded application software, middleware, and system services that enable applications and subsystems across the robotic platform. The engineer will work with software, systems, hardware, and test teams to design, implement, integrate, and debug reliable software for a heterogeneous embedded computing platform incorporating CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, and other specialized hardware. The successful candidate should have strong C/C\+\+ application development skills, an understanding of software architecture and data management, and an interest in building reusable platform services and APIs. **Essential Job Duties** **Middleware \& Application Software Development** * Design, implement, test, and maintain C/C\+\+ applications and middleware running on embedded Linux platforms. * Develop reusable system services, libraries, and APIs used by multiple applications and subsystems. * Develop software for configuration, preferences, persistent system data, diagnostics, and system management. * Design and implement software for structured data storage and retrieval. * Develop multi\-threaded applications and software using inter\-process communication mechanisms. * Integrate application and middleware software across heterogeneous computing elements, including CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, and other specialized processors. * Develop and maintain software interfaces between applications, platform services, and hardware\-accelerated components. * Extend existing software frameworks to support new product features and system capabilities. * Participate in API, interface, and software design reviews. **Software Integration \& Debugging** * Debug issues across application, middleware, operating system, and hardware interfaces. * Investigate software defects and perform root\-cause analysis. * Diagnose issues involving interactions between CPU\-hosted software and GPU\-, FPGA\-, or hardware\-accelerated components. * Use Linux debugging and diagnostic tools such as gdb, logs, tracing tools, and command\-line utilities. * Work with other software functions, EE, and FPGA engineers to understand interfaces and troubleshoot integration issues. * Support software integration, verification, validation, and product bring\-up activities. **Software Quality \& Reliability** * Develop maintainable, modular, and testable software. * Write unit and integration tests for new software components. * Design software with robustness, fault handling, data integrity, and serviceability in mind. * Participate in code reviews and contribute to team coding and design practices. * Support CI/CD and automated software testing. * undefined ### **Qualifications** **Required Skills and Experience** * Strong programming skills in C or C\+\+ (C\+\+11 or newer), with experience developing production software. * Experience developing applications or middleware on Linux or another POSIX\-based operating system. * Understanding of object\-oriented design, modular software architecture, and API design. * Experience with multi\-threaded software and concurrency concepts. * Understanding of inter\-process communication and client/server software architectures. * Experience designing or developing software that manages persistent application or system data. * Understanding of data modeling, schemas, transactions, concurrency, and data integrity. * Experience debugging application and system\-level software using Linux development tools. * Familiarity with networking concepts and protocols such as TCP/IP. * Ability to understand and work with software interfaces in heter perience with IPC technologies such as sockets, shared memory, message queues, or RPC frameworks. * Familiarity with serialization technologies such as protobuf or JSON. * Experience developing embedded Linux applications. * Familiarity with systemd or similar Linux service\-management frameworks. * Experience with asynchronous or event\-driven application architectures. * Familiarity with Yocto/OpenEmbedded or embedded Linux build environments. * Experience with medical devices, robotics, automotive, industrial automation, or other complex embedded systems. * Experience working in regulated, safety\-critical, or mission\-critical product development environments. ### **Additional Information** Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. Details can vary by role. Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. Mandatory Notices U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743\.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status. Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6\+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process). For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws. Preference will be given to qualified candidates who do not reside, or plan to reside, in Alabama, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Indiana, Iowa, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, or Tennessee. This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills. Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law. Accommodation \& Accessibility Notice: Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at HRHelpNow@intusurg.com. We provide market\-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. jobs.description: **Job Summary** Entry\-Level Engineer – Millwork Manufacturing Position summary Location Giddings, Texas \- Onsite Monday \- Friday Kaemark designs and manufactures custom cabinetry for the beauty and wellness, animal health, and school industries. We turn customer and architect designs into shop drawings, CNC programs, and finished products installed on job sites. We are hiring an Entry\-Level Engineer to join our engineering team. You will learn to interpret architectural plans, produce shop drawings, engineer parts for production, and support the shop floor from order to install. This role suits a recent graduate who wants hands\-on experience where design meets manufacturing. Key responsibilities * Review architectural drawings, specifications, and submittals to understand project scope and millwork requirements. * Prepare shop drawings, elevations, sections, and details in AutoCAD, and 3D models in SolidWorks, Microvellum, Cabinet Vision, or similar software. * Engineer casework and custom millwork for production: part lists, cut lists, bills of materials, and hardware schedules. * Create and check CNC programs and nested sheet layouts to maximize material yield. * Apply AWI/AWS standards, building codes, and ADA requirements to designs. * Track RFIs, drawing revisions, and architect comments, and update drawings accordingly. * Work with project managers, estimators, the shop floor, and installers to resolve design and fabrication issues. * Take field measurements and verify site conditions when needed. * Support continuous improvement: standard details, drawing templates, and process documentation. * Follow all safety procedures on the shop floor and job sites. Required qualifications * Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably Mechanical, Construction, Industrial, or Architectural Engineering. An associate degree in drafting or engineering technology plus relevant experience will also be considered. * 0–2 years of engineering, drafting, or manufacturing experience (internships and co\-ops count). * Working knowledge of AutoCAD and at least one 3D CAD program. * Ability to read and interpret architectural and construction drawings. * Strong math and spatial reasoning, with close attention to detail and tolerances. * Clear written and verbal communication. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel. * Ability to work in a manufacturing environment, including standing, walking, and lifting up to 50 lbs. **Preferred qualifications** * Experience with millwork\-specific software such as Microvellum, Cabinet Vision, or AutoCAD with millwork add\-ons. * Exposure to CNC routers, panel saws, edgebanders, or other woodworking equipment. * Familiarity with AWI Architectural Woodwork Standards. * Knowledge of wood species, sheet goods, laminates, solid surface, and cabinet hardware. * Hands\-on woodworking, construction, or fabrication experience. * Familiarity with ERP or MRP systems. **Work environment and schedule** This role splits time between the engineering office and the production floor, with occasional job\-site visits. Standard hours are Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM, with occasional overtime to meet project deadlines. What we offer * Starting pay: $50,000–$60,000 per year, based on education and experience * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and paid holidays * Structured on\-the\-job training and mentorship from senior engineers Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $55,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Giddings, TX 78942
