jobs.title: Sr. Manager, BIM/VDC
jobs.description: **Careers at Keel** Keel Infrastructure is a publicly traded energy and digital infrastructure company that develops and owns data centers and power assets across North America. At Keel, you're not just joining a company, you're helping build the infrastructure behind the future of compute. **Why Keel** We're at the intersection of energy and technology, two industries transforming in real time. The work is complex. The pace is fast. The impact is real. You'll be part of a team that values: * **Ownership —** we take responsibility and follow through * **Collaboration —** we work across teams, functions, and borders * **Curiosity —** we ask questions and keep learning * **Endurance —** we build for the long term **What It Feels Like to Work Here** * Fast\-moving, high\-growth, and hands\-on * Smart, driven people solving real challenges together * Work that directly supports AI and next\-generation infrastructure * Room to grow, stretch, and take on more **What We Offer** * Competitive salary, bonus and equity opportunities * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits * Retirement savings with company contribution * Employee referral program Interested? This is a great opportunity to work for a young and dynamic company! We are currently looking for a **Senior Manager, BIM/VDC** to join our team! **Purpose of the Role** ----------------------- *The Sr. Manager of BIM/VDC is a senior leadership role responsible for defining, owning, and continuously advancing the company's BIM and VDC standards across all data center development projects. This individual serves as the internal authority on model authoring standards, multi\-discipline coordination, clash detection workflows, and model\-based documentation, ensuring that every facility we develop is fully coordinated, constructible, and accurately documented from design through turnover.* *This role partners closely with architecture, structural, mechanical, electrical, and controls engineering, construction management, and general contractors to drive coordinated BIM/VDC workflows from design development through construction and turnover. The Sr. Manager of BIM/VDC sets the frameworks, specifications, and modeling standards that govern how our portfolio is designed and coordinated.* **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **BIM/VDC Leadership \& Standards** * Develop and own the company's BIM standards, BIM Execution Plan (BEP) templates, Level of Development (LOD) matrices, and modeling specifications governing all disciplines across new data center development. * Establish and enforce model authoring standards across architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, and controls disciplines, including naming conventions, model federation protocols, and file structure standards. * Define standards for clash detection and coordination workflows using Navisworks and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)/BIM 360, including coordination meeting cadence and issue\-tracking protocols. * Drive continuous improvement of model\-based quantity takeoff, 4D scheduling, and model\-based estimating to improve cost and schedule certainty. * Lead evaluation, selection, and standardization of BIM/VDC software platforms across the portfolio to maximize interoperability, reduce license complexity, and improve consultant/vendor leverage. **Project Execution** * Provide BIM/VDC leadership and technical review across all project phases, from schematic design through design development, construction documents, construction, and turnover. * Review and approve BIM Execution Plans and federated models from external engineers of record (EORs), general contractors, and trade subcontractors, ensuring compliance with company standards and LOD requirements. * Oversee the development of federated models, clash detection reports, and coordination logs as living design documents throughout the project lifecycle. * Lead BIM\-driven value engineering, using model data to evaluate constructability, prefabrication opportunities, and schedule impacts across each project. * Support RFP development, bid evaluation, and selection of BIM/VDC consultants and trade coordination partners; review subcontractor BIM capabilities and proposed coordination workflows. * Oversee construction\-phase BIM administration including RFI tracking tied to model elements, as\-built model updates, and coordination with the commissioning team for turnover documentation. **Team \& Stakeholder Management** * Build, mentor, and lead an internal BIM/VDC team as the company's development pipeline grows. * Manage relationships with external engineers of record, general contractors, trade subcontractors, and BIM/VDC consultants across the portfolio. * Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, and controls engineering to ensure MEP systems are modeled to the fidelity required for coordination and prefabrication. * Partner with commissioning and facilities/operations teams to ensure models transition into accurate as\-built documentation and, where applicable, digital twin and DCIM platforms. * Present BIM/VDC strategy, coordination outcomes, and technology investment recommendations to executive leadership and, where applicable, to customers and investors. **Innovation \& Technology Roadmap** * Evaluate and develop the company's strategy for digital twin integration, leveraging as\-built models to support facility operations, DCIM, and predictive maintenance. * Develop roadmap for reality capture technologies and AI\-assisted clash detection. * Monitor evolving BIM standards (ISO 19650, NBIMS\-US) and industry technology across key development markets; update company standards accordingly. * Participate in relevant industry organizations (buildingSMART, AGC BIM Forum, 7x24 Exchange) and contribute to thought leadership. **Requirements** ---------------- ### **Experience \& Background** * 8\+ years of progressive BIM/VDC experience. * Demonstrated experience leading BIM/VDC coordination on hyperscale, colocation, or other large\-scale mission\-critical construction projects. * Experience as a technical owner or discipline lead for BIM/VDC, not just a modeler or contributor, on large capital projects. * Prior experience managing or mentoring BIM staff and external consultants or trade coordination teams. ### **Technical Knowledge** * Deep knowledge of BIM authoring and coordination platforms: Revit, Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)/BIM 360, and Civil 3D. * Proficiency in clash detection, model federation, and multi\-discipline coordination workflows. * Strong knowledge of LOD frameworks, BIM Execution Planning (BEP), and ISO 19650 information management principles. * Experience with 4D scheduling and model\-based quantity takeoff and estimating tools. * Familiarity with reality capture technologies, including LiDAR scanning, photogrammetry, and drone survey, and scan\-to\-BIM workflows. * Familiarity with DCIM and digital twin platforms, and the handoff of as\-built models into facility operations. ### **Leadership \& Competencies** * Ability to translate complex BIM/VDC concepts for non\-technical audiences including executives and investors. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously. * Excellent written and verbal communication; experience authoring design standards and technical specifications. * Collaborative mindset with experience working cross\-functionally in fast\-paced development environments. ### **Educational Requirements** * Bachelor's in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. * Autodesk certifications (Revit, Navisworks) strongly preferred. * Professional certifications (buildingSMART, Certified Construction Industry Technologist, PMP, or similar) are a significant asset. **Work Arrangement** -------------------- * Location: Remote * Travel: Occasional travel to other Keel sites or vendor/partner locations as required. In addition to the stated base salary range, this role receives an end of year cash bonus and participates in our yearly equity grant.

**BIM/VDC Leadership \& Standards** * Develop and own the company's BIM standards, BIM Execution Plan (BEP) templates, Level of Development (LOD) matrices, and modeling specifications governing all disciplines across new data center development. * Establish and enforce model authoring standards across architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, and controls disciplines, including naming conventions, model federation protocols, and file structure standards. * Define standards for clash detection and coordination workflows using Navisworks and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)/BIM 360, including coordination meeting cadence and issue\-tracking protocols. * Drive continuous improvement of model\-based quantity takeoff, 4D scheduling, and model\-based estimating to improve cost and schedule certainty. * Lead evaluation, selection, and standardization of BIM/VDC software platforms across the portfolio to maximize interoperability, reduce license complexity, and improve consultant/vendor leverage. **Project Execution** * Provide BIM/VDC leadership and technical review across all project phases, from schematic design through design development, construction documents, with company standards and LOD requirements. * Oversee the development of federated models, clash detection reports, and coordination logs as living design documents throughout the project lifecycle. * Lead BIM\-driven value engineering, using model data to evaluate constructability, prefabrication opportunities, and schedule impacts across each project. * Support RFP development, bid evaluation, and selection of BIM/VDC consultants and trade coordination partners; review subcontractor BIM capabilities and proposed coordination workflows. * Oversee construction\-phase BIM administration lead an internal BIM/VDC team as the company's development pipeline grows. * Manage relationships with external engineers of record, general contractors, trade subcontractors, and BIM/VDC consultants across the portfolio. * Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, and controls engineering to ensure MEP systems are modeled to the fidelity required for coordination and prefabrication. * Partner with commissioning and facilities/operations teams to ensure models transition into accurate as\-built documentation and, where applicable, digital twin and DCIM platforms. * Present BIM/VDC strategy, coordination outcomes, and technology investment recommendations to executive leadership and, where applicable, to customers and investors. **Innovation \& Technology Roadmap** * Evaluate and develop the company's strategy for digital twin integration, leveraging as\-built models to support facility operations, DCIM, and predictive maintenance. * Develop roadmap for reality capture technologies and AI\-assisted clash detection. * Monitor evolving BIM standards (ISO 19650, NBIMS\-US) and industry technology across key development markets; update company standards accordingly. * Participate in relevant industry organizations (buildingSMART, AGC BIM Forum, 7x24 Exchange) and contribute to thought leadership. **Requirements** ---------------- ### **Experience \& Background** * 8\+ years of progressive BIM/VDC experience. * Demonstrated experience leading BIM/VDC coordination on hyperscale, colocation, or other large\-scale mission\-critical construction projects. * Experience as a technical owner or discipline lead for BIM/VDC, not just a modeler or contributor, on large capital projects. * Prior experience managing or mentoring BIM staff and external consultants or trade coordination teams. ### **Technical Knowledge** * Deep knowledge of BIM authoring and coordination platforms: Revit, Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)/BIM 360, and Civil 3D. * Proficiency in clash detection, model federation, and multi\-discipline coordination workflows. * Strong knowledge of LOD frameworks, BIM Execution Planning (BEP), and ISO 19650 information management principles. * Experience with 4D scheduling and model\-based quantity takeoff and estimating tools. * Familiarity with reality capture technologies, including LiDAR scanning, photogrammetry, and drone survey, and scan\-to\-BIM workflows. * Familiarity with DCIM and digital twin platforms, and the handoff of as\-built models into facility operations. ### **Leadership \& Competencies** * Ability to translate complex BIM/VDC concepts for non\-technical audiences including executives and investors. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously. * Excellent written and verbal communication; experience authoring design standards and technical specifications. * Collaborative mindset with experience working cross\-functionally in fast\-paced development environments. ### **Educational Requirements** * Bachelor's in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. * Autodesk certifications (Revit, Navisworks) strongly preferred. * Professional certifications (buildingSMART, Certified Construction Industry Technologist, PMP, or similar) are a significant asset. **Work Arrangement** -------------------- * Location: Remote * Travel: Occasional travel to other Keel sites or vendor/partner locations as required. In addition to the stated base salary range, this role receives an end of year cash bonus and participates in our yearly equity grant.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Data Center Controls
jobs.description: **Careers at Keel** Keel Infrastructure is a publicly traded energy and digital infrastructure company that develops and owns data centers and power assets across North America. At Keel, you're not just joining a company, you're helping build the infrastructure behind the future of compute. **Why Keel** We're at the intersection of energy and technology, two industries transforming in real time. The work is complex. The pace is fast. The impact is real. You'll be part of a team that values: * **Ownership —** we take responsibility and follow through * **Collaboration —** we work across teams, functions, and borders * **Curiosity —** we ask questions and keep learning * **Endurance —** we build for the long term **What It Feels Like to Work Here** * Fast\-moving, high\-growth, and hands\-on * Smart, driven people solving real challenges together * Work that directly supports AI and next\-generation infrastructure * Room to grow, stretch, and take on more **What We Offer** * Competitive salary, bonus and equity opportunities * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits * Retirement savings with company contribution * Employee referral program Interested? This is a great opportunity to work for a young and dynamic company! We are currently looking for a **Senior Manager, Data Center Controls** to join our team! **Purpose of the Role** *The Sr. Manager of Data Center Controls is a senior leader responsible for defining, owning, and continuously advancing the company's controls engineering standards, spanning Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) and Building Management Systems (BMS) across all data center development and operating projects. This individual serves as the internal authority on controls architecture, SCADA/EPMS integration, BMS sequences of operation, alarm management, points and network standards, and OT cybersecurity, ensuring that every facility we develop is fully visible, automated, and controllable to the reliability standard our customers and business require.* *This role partners closely with electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, commissioning, IT/OT security, construction management, and controls systems integrators to drive coordinated design decisions from basis\-of\-design through construction, commissioning, and energization. The Sr. Manager of Data Center Controls sets the frameworks, specifications, and design standards that govern how our portfolio is monitored and controlled, and ensures those standards are consistently applied and continuously improved as the company scales.* **Key Responsibilities** **Engineering Leadership \& Standards** * Develop and own the company's EPMS and BMS design standards, basis\-of\-design documentation, points list templates, and technical specifications governing all controls systems across new data center development. * Establish and enforce controls architecture criteria for EPMS and BMS; utility and generator metering, protective relay integration, power quality monitoring, SCADA front\-end, mechanical plant control, VFD integration, environmental monitoring, and fire/life\-safety interfaces. * Define standards for controls network architecture, including OT network segmentation, redundancy, cybersecurity hardening, and integration pathways with corporate IT. * Drive continuous improvement of data center automation, remote monitoring, and alarm management to reduce manual intervention and improve incident response time. * Lead evaluation, selection, and standardization of controls platforms, PLCs, RTUs, sensors, and software across the portfolio to maximize reliability, reduce integration complexity, and improve vendor leverage. **Project Execution** * Provide controls engineering leadership and technical review across all project phases, from site feasibility and schematic design through design development, construction documents, and commissioning. * Review and approve EPMS and BMS design packages from external engineers of record (EORs) and systems integrators, ensuring compliance with company standards and jurisdictional requirements. * Oversee the development of points lists, sequences of operation, network architecture diagrams, and alarm matrices as living design documents throughout the project lifecycle. * Lead controls value engineering efforts, balancing first cost, lifecycle cost, licensing model, vendor lock\-in risk, and schedule across each project. * Support RFP development, bid evaluation, and systems integrator/vendor selection for EPMS and BMS scopes of work; review integrator qualifications and proposed means and methods. * Oversee controls construction administration including submittal review, RFI responses, points\-to\-device verification, and coordination with the commissioning team during startup and energization. **Team \& Stakeholder Management** * Build, mentor, and lead an internal controls engineering team as the company's development pipeline grows. * Manage relationships with EPMS/BMS systems integrators, controls vendors, cybersecurity consultants, and metering/utility contacts. * Collaborate with electrical engineering to define EPMS metering points, protective relay integration, and power quality monitoring requirements across the critical power path. * Collaborate with mechanical engineering to define BMS sequences of operation for chilled water plants, CRAH/CRAC units, and economizer control, and partner with commissioning to ensure controls systems are designed for testability. * Present controls strategy, system architecture decisions, and cybersecurity posture to executive leadership and, where applicable, to customers and investors. **Innovation \& Technology Roadmap** * Evaluate and develop the company's strategy for AI/HPC\-ready controls, including high\-resolution power monitoring, dynamic cooling control, and predictive, analytics\-driven fault detection. * Develop roadmap for DCIM integration, digital twin capability, and analytics platforms to support grid resiliency, demand response, and sustainability goals. * Monitor and respond to evolving controls protocols and cybersecurity requirements (BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, NIST/IEC 62443\) across key development markets; update company standards accordingly. * Participate in relevant industry organizations (7x24 Exchange, ASHRAE, Uptime Institute, BICSI) and contribute to thought leadership. **Requirements** **Experience \& Background** * 10\+ years of progressive controls or instrumentation engineering experience, with a focus on mission\-critical or data center facilities. * Demonstrated experience leading EPMS/BMS design on hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise data center projects. * Experience as a technical owner or discipline lead, not just a contributor, on large capital projects. * Prior experience managing or mentoring engineering staff and external systems integrators. **Technical Knowledge** * Deep knowledge of EPMS architecture: power monitoring, metering, protective relay integration, and historian/trending platforms. * Deep knowledge of BMS architecture: DDC controls, sequences of operation, and alarm management for mechanical and electrical plant equipment. * Proficiency with controls protocols and standards, including BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, SNMP, and IEC 61850\. * Experience integrating EPMS/BMS with SCADA and DCIM platforms and building automation front\-ends. * Familiarity with OT cybersecurity best practices, including network segmentation and NIST/IEC 62443 frameworks. * Experience with functional performance testing and commissioning of controls systems (L0–L5\). **Leadership \& Competencies** * Ability to translate complex controls engineering concepts for non\-technical audiences including executives and investors. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously. * Excellent written and verbal communication; experience authoring design standards and technical specifications. * Collaborative mindset with experience working cross\-functionally in fast\-paced development environments. **Educational Requirements** * Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Controls/Instrumentation Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Professional Engineer (PE) license a plus. * Professional certifications (Certified Automation Professional (CAP), Tridium Niagara certification, CDCDP, PMP, or similar) are a significant asset. **Work Arrangement** -------------------- * Location: Remote * Travel: Occasional travel to other Keel sites or vendor/partner locations as required. In addition to the stated base salary range, this role receives an end of year cash bonus and participates in our yearly equity grant.

This individual serves as the internal authority on controls architecture, SCADA/EPMS integration, BMS sequences of operation, alarm management, points and network standards, and OT cybersecurity, ensuring that every facility we develop is fully visible, automated, and controllable to the reliability standard our customers and business require.* *This role partners closely with electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, commissioning, IT/OT security, construction management, and controls systems integrators to drive coordinated design decisions from basis\-of\-design through construction, commissioning, and energization. The Sr. Manager of Data Center Controls sets the frameworks, specifications, and design standards that govern how our portfolio is monitored and controlled, and ensures those standards are consistently applied and continuously improved as the company scales.* **Key Responsibilities** **Engineering Leadership \& Standards** * Develop and own the company's EPMS and BMS design standards, basis\-of\-design documentation, points list templates, and technical specifications governing all controls systems across new data center development. * Establish and enforce controls architecture criteria for EPMS and BMS; utility and generator metering, protective relay integration, power quality monitoring, SCADA front\-end, mechanical plant control, VFD integration, environmental monitoring, and fire/life\-safety interfaces. * Define standards for controls network architecture, including OT network segmentation, redundancy, cybersecurity hardening, and integration pathways with corporate IT. * Drive continuous improvement of data center automation, remote monitoring, and alarm management to reduce manual intervention and improve incident response time. * Lead evaluation, selection, and standardization of controls platforms, PLCs, RTUs, sensors, and software across the portfolio to maximize reliability, reduce integration complexity, and improve vendor leverage. **Project Execution** * Provide controls engineering leadership and technical review across all project phases, from site feasibility and schematic design through design development, construction documents, and commissioning. * Review and approve EPMS and BMS design packages from external engineers of record (EORs) and systems integrators, ensuring compliance with company standards and jurisdictional requirements. * Oversee the development of points lists, sequences of operation, network architecture diagrams, and alarm matrices as living design documents throughout the project lifecycle. * Lead controls value engineering efforts, balancing first cost, lifecycle cost, licensing model, vendor lock\-in risk, and schedule across each project. * Support RFP development, bid evaluation, and systems integrator/vendor selection for EPMS and BMS scopes of work; review integrator qualifications and proposed means and methods. * Oversee controls construction administration including submittal review, RFI responses, points\-to\-device verification, and coordination with the commissioning team during startup and energization. **Team \& Stakeholder Management** * Build, mentor, and lead an internal controls engineering team as the company's development pipeline grows. * Manage relationships with EPMS/BMS systems integrators, controls vendors, cybersecurity consultants, and metering/utility contacts. * Collaborate with electrical engineering to define EPMS metering points, protective relay integration, and power quality monitoring requirements across the critical power path. * Collaborate with mechanical engineering to define BMS sequences of operation for chilled water plants, CRAH/CRAC units, and economizer control, and partner with commissioning to ensure controls systems are designed for testability. * Present controls strategy, system architecture decisions, and cybersecurity posture to executive leadership and, where applicable, to customers and investors. **Innovation \& Technology Roadmap** * Evaluate and develop the company's strategy for AI/HPC\-ready controls, including high\-resolution power monitoring, dynamic cooling control, and predictive, analytics\-driven fault detection. * Develop roadmap for DCIM integration, digital twin capability, and analytics platforms to support grid resiliency, demand response, and sustainability goals. * Monitor and respond to evolving controls protocols and cybersecurity requirements (BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, NIST/IEC 62443\) across key development markets; update company standards accordingly. * Participate in relevant industry organizations (7x24 Exchange, ASHRAE, Uptime Institute, BICSI) and contribute to thought leadership. **Requirements** **Experience \& Background** * 10\+ years of progressive controls or instrumentation engineering experience, with a focus on mission\-critical or data center facilities. * Demonstrated experience leading EPMS/BMS design on hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise data center projects. * Experience as a technical owner or discipline lead, not just a contributor, on large capital projects. * Prior experience managing or mentoring engineering staff and external systems integrators. **Technical Knowledge** * Deep knowledge of EPMS architecture: power monitoring, metering, protective relay integration, and historian/trending platforms. * Deep knowledge of BMS architecture: DDC controls, sequences of operation, and alarm management for mechanical and electrical plant equipment. * Proficiency with controls protocols and standards, including BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, SNMP, and IEC 61850\. * Experience integrating EPMS/BMS with SCADA and DCIM platforms and building automation front\-ends. * Familiarity with OT cybersecurity best practices, including network segmentation and NIST/IEC 62443 frameworks. * Experience with functional performance testing and commissioning of controls systems (L0–L5\). **Leadership \& Competencies** * Ability to translate complex controls engineering concepts for non\-technical audiences including executives and investors. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously. * Excellent written and verbal communication; experience authoring design standards and technical specifications. * Collaborative mindset with experience working cross\-functionally in fast\-paced development environments. **Educational Requirements** * Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Controls/Instrumentation Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Professional Engineer (PE) license a plus. * Professional certifications (Certified Automation Professional (CAP), Tridium Niagara certification, CDCDP, PMP, or similar) are a significant asset. **Work Arrangement** -------------------- * Location: Remote * Travel: Occasional travel to other Keel sites or vendor/partner locations as required. In addition to the stated base salary range, this role receives an end of year cash bonus and participates in our yearly equity grant.

jobs.description: **Careers at Keel** Keel Infrastructure is a publicly traded energy and digital infrastructure company that develops and owns data centers and power assets across North America. This is a great opportunity to work for a young and dynamic company! We are currently looking for a **Senior Manager, Data Center Sales Engineer** to join our team! **Purpose of the Role** *Keel Infrastructure is seeking a Sales Engineer to support the sale of datacenter capacity. This role sits at the intersection of sales and technical delivery, translating Keel's design standard and site capabilities into terms a customer's technical teams can evaluate and trust, while translating customer requirements back into what Keel can commit to without slowing down site delivery.* *The Sales Engineer works directly with prospective and existing customers through the sales cycle: joining prospecting calls to qualify technical requirements, presenting Keel's MEP and facility design approach, responding to RFPs, and building the technical designs and documentation that support a signed deal. This is a customer\-facing technical role, not a design\-authority role. The Sales Engineer represents Keel's standard to the market; the Design \& Engineering team owns and evolves that standard internally.* *The ideal candidate has deep fluency across power, cooling, and electrical systems in mission\-critical facilities, along with a working understanding of compute and networking technology and how it drives those requirements. As rack densities and chip architectures evolve, this person needs to know what that means for power delivery, cooling approach, and electrical design, not just describe the systems as they exist today. That fluency is what lets them hold a credible, detailed technical conversation with a customer's infrastructure team, while keeping sight of the commercial goal: closing capacity deals on a timeline that protects speed to market.* **Key Responsibilities** **Customer\-Facing Technical Sales** * Serve as the primary technical resource in the sales cycle, presenting Keel's MEP systems, cooling architecture, electrical topology, and facility design approach to prospective customers. * Join customer prospecting calls alongside Sales to assess technical fit early, ask the right diagnostic questions, and set realistic expectations before a deal moves forward. * Join design calls with customer technical teams to walk through system specifications, resolve open technical questions, and work toward a design that satisfies both the customer's requirements and Keel's standard. * Build confidence with customer technical resources (facilities, infrastructure, and engineering teams) by speaking credibly to system design, redundancy, and capacity delivery. * Answer detailed technical questions on power density, cooling systems, and electrical distribution in real time during customer meetings and evaluations. **Requirements Translation** * Translate customer requirements (power density, redundancy, timeline, and site preferences) into what Keel's standard design and site pipeline can deliver. * Translate Keel's standard design and vendor (A\&E/MEP) deliverables into customer\-facing materials that are accurate without exposing internal design detail that should stay with delivery teams. * When a customer requirement doesn't match Keel's standard design on its face, assess whether Keel's existing solution meets the underlying need in a different way before treating it as a deviation. Where a true deviation is required, flag it and work with Design \& Engineering and Development to assess feasibility, cost, and schedule impact before any commitment is made. **RFP Response \& Design Support** * Own the technical sections of complex RFPs and RFIs, building supporting designs, capacity models, and system diagrams as needed to answer customer requirements. * Build conceptual or preliminary technical designs to support a proposal, coordinating with A\&E/MEP partners and Design \& Engineering to ensure alignment with Keel's approved standard. * Maintain a library of reusable technical proposal content (system descriptions, capacity tables, standard diagrams) to shorten RFP turnaround without sacrificing accuracy. **Cross\-Functional Coordination** * Partner with Sales and Development leadership to scope deals that are technically sound and deliverable within Keel's speed\-to\-market model. * Work with the Design \& Engineering team to stay current on Keel's design standard and any changes that affect what can be represented to customers. * Coordinate with Construction and Development Project Managers to validate delivery timelines referenced in customer\-facing materials. * Loop in Power Strategy \& Procurement and Utility Interconnection on any customer conversation involving load, interconnection timing, or power availability. **Requirements** **Experience \& Background** * 8\+ years of experience in mission\-critical facility engineering, datacenter MEP systems, or technical sales engineering supporting large\-scale infrastructure or datacenter customers. * Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical systems for a customer audience, including customer technical stakeholders directly. * Experience responding to and winning complex RFPs involving technical design content. * Direct experience selling or supporting sales of large\-scale or colocation datacenter capacity. * Experience working alongside A\&E/MEP design firms or an internal design standards function. **Technical Knowledge** * Deep fluency across power, cooling, and electrical systems in mission\-critical facilities. * Working understanding of compute and networking technology and how evolving chip and rack architectures drive power, cooling, and electrical requirements. * Familiarity with liquid cooling and high\-density rack architectures for AI/HPC workloads. **Leadership \& Competencies** * Technical credibility strong enough to hold a room of customer engineers, paired with the commercial instinct to know when a detail matters to the deal and when it doesn't. * Skilled translator across audiences: equally comfortable with a customer's infrastructure team, Keel's internal design and delivery teams, and sales leadership. * Sound judgment to tell the difference between a customer request Keel can already meet in a different way and one that truly requires a deviation and escalation. * Strong written and verbal communicator, especially under RFP deadline pressure. * Collaborative by default: this role only works if Design \& Engineering, Development, and Sales trust what gets represented to the customer. * Experience presenting technical trade\-offs to executive audiences on either the customer or Keel side of the table. **Educational Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or a related engineering discipline. **Work Arrangement** -------------------- * Location: Remote * Schedule: On\-site (NYC HQ) a minimum of one week per month. * Travel: Occasional travel to other Keel sites or vendor/partner locations as required. In addition to the stated base salary range, this role receives an end of year cash bonus and participates in our yearly equity grant.

jobs.description: **Careers at Keel** Keel Infrastructure is a publicly traded energy and digital infrastructure company that develops and owns data centers and power assets across North America. At Keel, you're not just joining a company, you're helping build the infrastructure behind the future of compute. **Why Keel** We're at the intersection of energy and technology, two industries transforming in real time. The work is complex. The pace is fast. The impact is real. You'll be part of a team that values: * **Ownership —** we take responsibility and follow through * **Collaboration —** we work across teams, functions, and borders * **Curiosity —** we ask questions and keep learning * **Endurance —** we build for the long term **What It Feels Like to Work Here** * Fast\-moving, high\-growth, and hands\-on * Smart, driven people solving real challenges together * Work that directly supports AI and next\-generation infrastructure * Room to grow, stretch, and take on more **What We Offer** * Competitive salary, bonus and equity opportunities * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits * Retirement savings with company contribution * Employee referral program Interested? This is a great opportunity to work for a young and dynamic company! We are currently looking for a **Senior Manager, Data Center Sales Engineer** to join our team! **Purpose of the Role** *Keel Infrastructure is seeking a Sales Engineer to support the sale of datacenter capacity. This role sits at the intersection of sales and technical delivery, translating Keel's design standard and site capabilities into terms a customer's technical teams can evaluate and trust, while translating customer requirements back into what Keel can commit to without slowing down site delivery.* *The Sales Engineer works directly with prospective and existing customers through the sales cycle: joining prospecting calls to qualify technical requirements, presenting Keel's MEP and facility design approach, responding to RFPs, and building the technical designs and documentation that support a signed deal. This is a customer\-facing technical role, not a design\-authority role. The Sales Engineer represents Keel's standard to the market; the Design \& Engineering team owns and evolves that standard internally.* *The ideal candidate has deep fluency across power, cooling, and electrical systems in mission\-critical facilities, along with a working understanding of compute and networking technology and how it drives those requirements. As rack densities and chip architectures evolve, this person needs to know what that means for power delivery, cooling approach, and electrical design, not just describe the systems as they exist today. That fluency is what lets them hold a credible, detailed technical conversation with a customer's infrastructure team, while keeping sight of the commercial goal: closing capacity deals on a timeline that protects speed to market.* **Key Responsibilities** **Customer\-Facing Technical Sales** * Serve as the primary technical resource in the sales cycle, presenting Keel's MEP systems, cooling architecture, electrical topology, and facility design approach to prospective customers. * Join customer prospecting calls alongside Sales to assess technical fit early, ask the right diagnostic questions, and set realistic expectations before a deal moves forward. * Join design calls with customer technical teams to walk through system specifications, resolve open technical questions, and work toward a design that satisfies both the customer's requirements and Keel's standard. * Build confidence with customer technical resources (facilities, infrastructure, and engineering teams) by speaking credibly to system design, redundancy, and capacity delivery. * Answer detailed technical questions on power density, cooling systems, and electrical distribution in real time during customer meetings and evaluations. **Requirements Translation** * Translate customer requirements (power density, redundancy, timeline, and site preferences) into what Keel's standard design and site pipeline can deliver. * Translate Keel's standard design and vendor (A\&E/MEP) deliverables into customer\-facing materials that are accurate without exposing internal design detail that should stay with delivery teams. * When a customer requirement doesn't match Keel's standard design on its face, assess whether Keel's existing solution meets the underlying need in a different way before treating it as a deviation. Where a true deviation is required, flag it and work with Design \& Engineering and Development to assess feasibility, cost, and schedule impact before any commitment is made. **RFP Response \& Design Support** * Own the technical sections of complex RFPs and RFIs, building supporting designs, capacity models, and system diagrams as needed to answer customer requirements. * Build conceptual or preliminary technical designs to support a proposal, coordinating with A\&E/MEP partners and Design \& Engineering to ensure alignment with Keel's approved standard. * Maintain a library of reusable technical proposal content (system descriptions, capacity tables, standard diagrams) to shorten RFP turnaround without sacrificing accuracy. **Cross\-Functional Coordination** * Partner with Sales and Development leadership to scope deals that are technically sound and deliverable within Keel's speed\-to\-market model. * Work with the Design \& Engineering team to stay current on Keel's design standard and any changes that affect what can be represented to customers. * Coordinate with Construction and Development Project Managers to validate delivery timelines referenced in customer\-facing materials. * Loop in Power Strategy \& Procurement and Utility Interconnection on any customer conversation involving load, interconnection timing, or power availability. **Requirements** **Experience \& Background** * 8\+ years of experience in mission\-critical facility engineering, datacenter MEP systems, or technical sales engineering supporting large\-scale infrastructure or datacenter customers. * Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical systems for a customer audience, including customer technical stakeholders directly. * Experience responding to and winning complex RFPs involving technical design content. * Direct experience selling or supporting sales of large\-scale or colocation datacenter capacity. * Experience working alongside A\&E/MEP design firms or an internal design standards function. **Technical Knowledge** * Deep fluency across power, cooling, and electrical systems in mission\-critical facilities. * Working understanding of compute and networking technology and how evolving chip and rack architectures drive power, cooling, and electrical requirements. * Familiarity with liquid cooling and high\-density rack architectures for AI/HPC workloads. **Leadership \& Competencies** * Technical credibility strong enough to hold a room of customer engineers, paired with the commercial instinct to know when a detail matters to the deal and when it doesn't. * Skilled translator across audiences: equally comfortable with a customer's infrastructure team, Keel's internal design and delivery teams, and sales leadership. * Sound judgment to tell the difference between a customer request Keel can already meet in a different way and one that truly requires a deviation and escalation. * Strong written and verbal communicator, especially under RFP deadline pressure. * Collaborative by default: this role only works if Design \& Engineering, Development, and Sales trust what gets represented to the customer. * Experience presenting technical trade\-offs to executive audiences on either the customer or Keel side of the table. **Educational Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or a related engineering discipline. **Work Arrangement** -------------------- * Location: Remote * Schedule: On\-site (NYC HQ) a minimum of one week per month. * Travel: Occasional travel to other Keel sites or vendor/partner locations as required. In addition to the stated base salary range, this role receives an end of year cash bonus and participates in our yearly equity grant.

healthcare data or in a healthcare enterprise environment. * Experience working as a consultant or in client\-facing technical roles. * Relevant Google Cloud or machine learning certifications. **Why jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Platform

Academic Operations. * Serve as the product manager for Kuali Build and Kuali Ready, owning their roadmaps, backlogs, and customer and business outcomes. * Define and manage cross\-module platform capabilities such as authentication and SSO, user and group management, roles and permissions, workflow and forms engines, notifications, audit logging, data access, and platform reporting, dashboards, and analytics. * Own Kuali’s integration strategy, including APIs, webhooks, the integration framework, and connectors to ERP, HCM, SIS, and LMS systems, so institutions can easily connect phased rollouts, release notes, and communication to customers and internal teams, so releases are predictable, high quality, and low risk. * Partner with Engineering on platform health, including privacy, security, accessibility, and compliance expectations of higher education institutions (for example FERPA, SOC 2, and WCAG). * Translate customer feedback, institutional requirements, and product vision into clearly defined problems, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Define and track platform KPIs such as adoption of shared capabilities, integration usage, uptime and incident trends, release quality, and time\-to\-value for new implementations. * Partner with Implementation, Services, Support, and Customer Success to improve the onboarding, configuration, and integration experience, and enable customer\-facing teams on platform capabilities and releases. * Communicate platform strategy, priorities, release plans, progress, and risks clearly to executive leaders, product teams, customers, and cross\-functional stakeholders. * I  * Translate market insights, product data, customer feedback, and user research into clearly defined problems, desired outcomes, hypotheses, requirements, and roadmap priorities. * Build evidence\-based business cases for product investments, considering customer value, market potential, revenue impact, cost, risk, and resource requirements. * Establish clear prioritization frameworks and make informed tradeoffs among customer needs, business objectives, technical considerations, and available capacity. * Partner with Engineering and Design throughout discovery and delivery to evaluate feasibility, manage scope and dependencies, and deliver accessible, scalable, and high\-quality solutions. * Lead cross\-functional teams through product discovery, validation, prioritization, development, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. * Partner with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Services, and Implementation to develop positioning, support go\-to\-market execution, enable customer\-facing teams, and drive product adoption. * Contribute to packaging, pricing, and commercialization decisions that strengthen the portfolio’s market position and business performance. * Define product KPIs and use quantitative and qualitative insights to measure adoption, customer satisfaction, retention, operational performance, and customer and business outcomes. * Monitor product performance following launch and use the results to continuously improve the product and inform future investment decisions. * Identify and manage product risks and dependencies, including data privacy, security, accessibility, compliance, integration, scalability, and responsible AI use. * Communicate product strategy, work while championing its responsible and effective use throughout the product development process. * Contribute to the continued development of Kuali’s product management practices, tools, and jobs.description: **Full Stack Engineer** ----------------------- **About LaunchDarkly Engineering** ---------------------------------- LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears. delivery plans. * Own features from discovery and design through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration. * Collaborate with Product, Design, Data, and engineering partners to make decisions that balance usability, performance, reliability, and time to value. * Write readable, maintainable, well\-tested code and contribute to shared engineering practices. * Improve observability, operational health, and the quality of the systems you touch. * Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, incident response, and continuous improvement. ### **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience building and operating production software in a professional environment, or equivalent demonstrable experience. * Experience contributing across both frontend and backend layers, with a willingness to work at the API boundary rather than in only one part of the stack. * Experience with a backend language such as **Go, Python**, Rust, or an equivalent language. **(Most of our teams use Go)** * Experience with a modern frontend framework, such as **React,** and a typed language, such as **TypeScript.** * Experience designing or consuming APIs and working with backend services, data stores, or asynchronous systems. * Strong product instincts and an ability to connect technical decisions to customer outcomes. * Clear communication and a collaborative approach to working with engineers and cross\-functional partners. * A commitment to quality, accessibility, maintainability, and continuous learning. **Pay:** *Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones\* for jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory’s Integrated Circuit Design Group is looking for a highly skilled and motivated analog/mixed\-signal **IC Design Engineer** to join our group. In this role, you will develop custom ASICs for major Laboratory projects in the fields of high\-energy physics, nuclear science, scientific imaging, and beyond. You will collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to design and deliver advanced integrated circuits that power next‑generation instruments \- from new particle discoveries to cutting\-edge imaging, to probing fundamental questions about the origins of the universe. **Employer:** Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory is a U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science laboratory at the forefront of discovery, tackling grand challenges in energy, the environment, health, materials, and fundamental physics \- work that has led to 17 Nobel Prizes, and countless scientific discoveries. Home to world\-class user facilities \- including the Advanced Light Source, the Molecular Foundry, NERSC, and the Joint Genome Institute \- the Lab empowers thousands of researchers each year to probe matter and the cosmos with unprecedented precision. Its interdisciplinary teams translate breakthrough science into real\-world impact, from cleaner energy technologies and climate insights to advanced detectors, imaging systems, and data platforms that shape entire fields. **Responsibilities:** * Develop high\-performance analog and mixed\-signal integrated circuits for detector instrumentation with a focus on development of high channel\-count sensor readout ASICs operating in extreme environments (such as high\-radiation, cryogenic, or in\-vacuum environments). * Under general supervision, take responsibility for specific subtasks such as block design, layout, verification, and ensuring successful chip integration. Test and evaluate integrated circuits and interface with other electronic equipment. * Contribute to proposals for new IC technologies supporting scientific projects and programs. * Provide engineering judgment to solve a variety of technical problems, with due consideration for scientific and practical concerns. * Collaborate effectively with engineering and scientific teams. * Provide guidance to and assist technical staff as needed. * Prepare technical or progress reports and documentation. **Minimum qualifications:** ***IC Design Engineer Level 2:*** * Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) with 2\+ years of relevant IC design experience, or an advanced degree with no experience required. * Comprehensive knowledge of circuit theory and design. * Proficiency with IC design suites (such as Cadence) and transistor\-level simulators such as Spectre, Eldo, or HSPICE. * Broad experience designing analog and mixed signal functional blocks such as opamps, bandgap references, switched capacitor circuits, data converters, charge sensitive front ends, image sensor arrays, LDOs, PLLs, feedback and compensation techniques. * Ability to manage multiple projects and complete tasks with moderate supervision. * Skilled in breaking down assignments, applying engineering judgment, and developing creative technical solutions. * Demonstrated written and oral communication skills in authoring technical and scientific reports and publications and presenting conceptual and completed designs through design reviews and documentation. ***In Addition, IC Design Engineer Level 3:*** * Typically requires 5\+ years of IC design experience with a Bachelor’s degree, 3\+ years with a Master’s, or equivalent work experience. * Extended experience with integrated circuit design, ranging all the way from concept to full\-chip integration. * Experience working in multidisciplinary teams, cross\-functional collaboration, system specification, and solving complex engineering problems. * Ability to manage multiple projects and complete tasks with minimal supervision, ability to manage projects. **Preferred qualifications:** * Develop ASIC test systems using FPGAs and custom software. * Expertise in scientific instrumentation, data acquisition systems, and physics. * Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering with an IC design focus preferred. * Digital design experience with Verilog or VHDL. * Experience in system modeling and specification. * Ability to maintain, evaluate, and install process design kits (PDKs). **Additional information:** * **Appointment type:** This is a full\-time 2 year, term appointment with the possibility of extension or conversion to Career appointment based upon satisfactory job performance, continuing availability of funds and ongoing operational needs. * **Union represented:** This position is represented by a union for collective bargaining purposes. * **Salary range:** + The expected salary for the IC Design Engineer Level 2 position is $125,000 \- $153,000, which fits into the full salary of $111,204 \- $187,680 depending upon the candidate’s skills, knowledge, and abilities. This includes education, certifications, and years of experience. + The expected salary for the IC Design Engineer Level 3 position is $149,000 \- $182,000, which fits into the full salary of $132,264 \- $223,176 depending upon the candidate’s skills, knowledge, and abilities. This includes education, certifications, and years of experience. * **Background check:** This position is subject to a background check. Any convictions will be evaluated to determine if they directly relate to the responsibilities and requirements of the position. Having a conviction history will not automatically disqualify an applicant from being considered for employment. * **Work modality:** Work will be primarily performed at:Lawrence Berkeley National Lab, 1 Cyclotron Road, Berkeley, CA. jobs.title: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Lifeloc Technologies \| Wheat Ridge, Colorado** Lifeloc Technologies, a leader in breath alcohol testing and emerging drug\-detection technologies, is seeking an experienced **Senior Embedded Systems Engineer** to support the development and commercialization of next\-generation electronic instrumentation. This position will play a key role in the design, development, integration, testing, and sustaining engineering of embedded systems used within Lifeloc products, including our next\-generation **breath alcohol** and **drug\-detection** product lines. The ideal candidate is a strong hands\-on embedded engineer with experience developing reliable, production\-ready systems and working at the interface between hardware, firmware, software, sensors, and electromechanical components. We are also looking for an engineer who understands how modern **AI\-assisted engineering tools** can be used responsibly to improve development efficiency, debugging, testing, documentation, and technical problem\-solving. Key Responsibilities · Design, develop, integrate, and maintain embedded firmware and software for new and existing products. · Develop embedded applications using **C/C\+\+** and related programming languages. · Develop and maintain systems utilizing **FreeRTOS and/or Embedded Linux environments**. · Support embedded hardware design, processor and peripheral selection, board bring\-up, and hardware/firmware integration. · Develop and troubleshoot interfaces including **USB, UART, SPI, I²C, Ethernet, Wi\-Fi, and Bluetooth/BLE**. · Integrate sensors, motors, displays, wireless devices, and other electromechanical components into embedded systems. · Perform system\-level troubleshooting involving interactions between hardware, firmware, software, and mechanical components. · Participate in requirements development, system architecture, design reviews, risk analysis, verification, and validation activities. · Develop engineering test methods, automated test scripts, diagnostic tools, and regression testing approaches. · Support prototype development, manufacturing transfer, production testing, and sustaining engineering activities. · Investigate field and production issues and perform root\-cause analysis and corrective\-action support. · Create and maintain software requirements, architecture documentation, interface specifications, test protocols, engineering reports, and release documentation. · Collaborate closely with electrical, mechanical, software, scientific, manufacturing, and quality personnel. AI\-Assisted Engineering Lifeloc is expanding the responsible use of artificial intelligence within its engineering organization. The successful candidate will be expected to incorporate modern AI\-assisted tools where they provide meaningful improvements in engineering efficiency and quality. Applications may include: · Using AI coding assistants to support code development, review, refactoring, and troubleshooting. · Using AI to assist with debugging, log analysis, error interpretation, and root\-cause investigation. · Developing test cases, test scripts, regression tests, and automated engineering tools with AI assistance. · Using AI\-supported tools for analysis of device, sensor, manufacturing, and test data. · Assisting with development and review of technical documentation, requirements, test protocols, and engineering reports. · Evaluating alternative software and system architectures. · Using AI to accelerate technical research and investigation of unfamiliar technologies. AI\-generated code, analysis, and recommendations must be independently reviewed and validated using sound engineering practices before implementation. Required Qualifications · Bachelor’s degree in **Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science**, or a closely related technical discipline. · Approximately **5\+ years of professional embedded systems development experience**, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. · Strong programming experience with **C and C\+\+** in embedded environments. · Experience with microcontrollers, microprocessors, embedded peripherals, and hardware interfaces. · Experience developing within **RTOS and/or Embedded Linux environments**. · Strong understanding of embedded hardware/software interaction. · Experience debugging embedded systems using tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, protocol analyzers, and related engineering equipment. · Experience with source control and modern software\-development practices. · Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis skills. · Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team. · Strong written and verbal technical communication skills. AI and Modern Development Skills Candidates should have experience with, or a demonstrated willingness to effectively utilize, modern engineering productivity tools such as: · Claude · Copilot · Gemini · ChatGPT · GitHub and others The successful candidate must be capable of independently evaluating the accuracy, safety, reliability, and appropriateness of AI\-generated code and technical recommendations. Preferred Qualifications Experience in one or more of the following areas is desirable: · Real\-time operating systems such as **FreeRTOS**. · Hardware\-in\-the\-loop or automated system testing. · Embedded Linux development, including **Yocto Linux**. · Bluetooth/BLE and Wi\-Fi integration. · Ethernet and network communications. · Touchscreen or embedded GUI development. · Battery\-powered embedded devices. · Motor control and electromechanical systems. · Medical, diagnostic, analytical, or regulated instrumentation. · Design verification and validation. · Manufacturing test development and production support. · EMI/EMC troubleshooting and regulatory compliance testing. · Python scripting and automated data analysis. · Cloud\-connected or IoT devices. · REST APIs and device\-to\-cloud communications. Experience with **machine learning, edge AI, computer vision, signal classification, anomaly detection, or deployment of AI/ML models on embedded platforms** is a plus but is not required. What We Are Looking For We are looking for an engineer who combines strong embedded systems fundamentals with a practical, forward\-looking approach to engineering. The right candidate should be comfortable moving between **firmware, hardware, system integration, troubleshooting, testing, and product development** rather than working exclusively within a narrowly defined software role. Just as importantly, we want someone who views AI as an engineering productivity tool—not a substitute for engineering judgment. The successful candidate will know how to use emerging technologies to accelerate development while maintaining the discipline, verification, documentation, and technical rigor required to develop reliable commercial products. Compensation Salary $130,000 – 160,000 per year. Benefits include our standard paid time off, subsidized medical and dental insurance, short term disability through Colorado FAMLI program, long term disability and life insurance paid by company, 401k with 50% company matching of up to 3% and vesting schedule. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Lab Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **LIGHT LABS** *Powering a healthier food system through data, transparency, and accountability.* **Lab Operations Engineer** **Light Labs \| Ann Arbor, MI (On\-site, Lab)** **The Opportunity** Are you a software or automation engineer who'd rather be on a lab floor than behind a screen? Someone who looks at a messy operation and sees a system waiting to be built? Then you'd be a great fit as our Lab Operations Engineer. You'll build what we call the Lab Operating System: the most modern, observable, controllable lab operation in the industry. Right now, it's a blank page. You'll own two outcomes, turnaround time and accuracy. That's the role. **Why Light Labs** Most labs sell turnaround time. We had to engineer it. Light Labs returns results in about three days where the industry takes seven to fourteen, and today a lot of that speed still depends on people who know where everything is. That won't carry us where we're going. We're scaling to $50M by 2027 and $100M by 2028, and lab capacity is the constraint standing in the way, one we can't solve with headcount. We don't need someone to maintain what exists. We need someone to build what comes next. **What You'll Own** You'll walk into a high\-volume, high\-stakes environment with no playbook yet. Your first month is spent on the floor, mapping every process as a system, every checkpoint and every handoff, and standing up a single source of truth for how work actually moves. Then you find the first bottleneck and go after it. What you build first becomes the foundation for everything that follows: * **Build the source of truth.** Real\-time visibility into where every sample is, who owns it, and whether it's on track, no floor\-walking required. * **Find the bottleneck, then kill it.** Locate where time, capacity, or accuracy is being lost, fix it, measure the result, standardize it, repeat. * **Make turnaround time (TAT) predictable.** Build the visibility to catch a late sample before it's late, not after. * **Build proactive quality management.** Real\-time trending and pattern detection for drift, QC failures, and out\-of\-spec results, so errors get caught in the lab instead of by a customer. * **Make partner labs measurable.** Full visibility from shipped to released, with real SLAs and scorecards. * **Bring data to staffing.** Replace reactive staffing with real numbers on coverage, cross\-training, and utilization. * **Systematize method development.** LLM\-assisted workflows for literature review, protocol drafting, SOP generation, and validation. * **Build the playbook, not just the fix.** Everything you build deploys on day one at our next lab, built or acquired. You'll work side by side with our scientists, technicians, and lab leadership, and with engineering and product so the Lab OS plugs into the broader Light Labs platform instead of living on an island. **What You'll Need** * A real software or automation engineering background. You build systems, pipelines, and integrations other people can run and extend, not a script only you can maintain. * Real time inside laboratory, scientific, manufacturing, or other complex physical\-world operations. Pharma, biotech, analytical testing, laboratory automation, and high\-throughput environments are all strong fits, and bioinformatics, computational biology, scientific software, or hands\-on instrumentation experience is an even stronger one. * A track record of replacing manual workflows with software or automation, personally, not just adjacent to the work, especially if that's an instrument\-heavy process like LC\-MS or involves pointing AI at a real scientific problem. * You find the operational problem nobody's defined for you yet, build the fix, and prove it moved the needle, measurably, ideally on throughput, turnaround time, quality, or efficiency. That's what ownership of an outcome actually looks like here. * Real communication skills. You'll be changing how scientists and technicians work. You'll need to explain the why and bring them along, not just go around them. * Ready to be on the lab floor in Ann Arbor, MI. This is on\-site, not remote. **Who We Are** Light Labs is building the modern platform for lab testing, starting with consumer goods brands: cheaper, faster testing that also automates regulatory compliance and drives revenue. Testing is a cost line everywhere else. Here it's a growth line. Brands publish their Light Labs results straight to their own product pages, and those that do have seen conversion lift of around 12%. Hundreds of food and supplement brands already test with us, including AG1, Chomps, David Protein, Seed Health, Momentous, Caraway, and Little Spoon. Consumers deserve to know what's actually in the products that affect their families' health, and transparency is what creates that informed customer. Beyond a faster, cheaper lab, we're building the infrastructure for brands to push lab data straight to their product pages (what's in it, what's not, claims ve  transparent. **Our Mission** Everything we consume is getting more toxic and less nutritious, and the problem is invisible. You can't see, taste, or smell it: * Cinnamon apple puree pouches, marketed for children and labeled preservative\-free, kosher, and gluten\-free, contained lead levels 200 times greater than the FDA's proposed guidelines. * 87% of 650 children's food samples tested positive for glyphosate. * Over 1,300 chemicals are banned in cosmetics in the EU, while only 11 are banned in the United States. * The US allows thousands of food additives that are banned in other countries. * A study of 168 baby foods found that 95% contained at least one heavy metal (arsenic, lead, mercury, cadmium), with a quarter containing all four. * Seven out of eight samples of kale tested contained disturbing levels of PFAs, with organic kale containing even higher levels of the toxic compounds. Testing for purity today is slow, expensive, and nearly impossible to interpret without a PhD. No feedback loop means no pressure to change, but if people knew what was actually in their food, they'd shop differently. Nothing changes until someone can measure it, publish it, and be right. That's our mission: real transparency, built with the lab you'd be running. **Founding Team** * **Nick Mares**, 2x founder (Kettle \& Fire, a $100M/year brand, and Upside Financing, exited 2022\), $60M\+ raised, CEO and COO experience, Thiel Fellow. * **Vijay Manohar**, helped scale Samsara to $1B ARR and IPO (NYSE: IOT). B.S. computer engineering, UT Austin. **What You Get** * Top\-decile salary, plus equity for every employee * Full health, dental, and vision coverage * Generous PTO and company holidays * Direct access to the founders and a promote\-from\-within culture at a company that's adding labs, not consolidating them **Values We're Looking For** * **First Principles.** We're looking for team members who can deal with ambiguity, deconstruct problems, and build the optimal solution. Question every requirement, delete any part or process you can, simplify and optimize, accelerate cycle time, automate. That same instinct should make you curious enough to ask why something is done a certain way, and forward\-looking enough to notice what won't hold up once we're 5 to 10 times this size. * **Standard of Excellence.** High standards are contagious. A\+ talent attracts A\+ talent. There's a glut of mediocrity in the world. We're chasing after the products and people that strive for excellence. * **Bias for Action.** Take initiative, make decisions quickly, and have a willingness to experiment and learn from failures. Customer expectations aren't static, they rise over time, which means we have to continuously improve every single day. * **Low Ego.** Coachability: it's not about being right, it's about getting to the right answer. React calmly to criticism or negative feedback, treat feedback as an opportunity for information and improvement. Respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when it's uncomfortable, and once a decision is made, commit wholly and move forward. **Why This Role** Are you the person who walks into a black box and builds order out of it? Roles like this don't come up often, and the people who can actually do it are rare. If that's you, this is your chance to build the Lab Operating System from the ground up. Apply today. Light Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Have you personally built software or automation that replaced a manual workflow in a lab, scientific, manufacturing, or other physical\-world operation? * Can you work full\-time on\-site at our lab in Ann Arbor, MI? Work Location: In person

LiveRampers thrive on building together with curiosity and humility—and have a good bit of fun along the way. We’re always looking for smart, kind, and creative people to grow our team and impact. The primary goal is to support LiveRamp’s product reliability in Production. **You will:** * Design and develop monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting solutions to improve product observability. * Partner with development and SRE teams to understand monitoring needs and define observability requirements. * Develop dashboards and actionable alerts to provide visibility into system health, performance, and reliability. * Design and implement product\-level performance and reliability monitoring. * Build and enhance automation to accelerate troubleshooting, validation, and release processes. * Explore and contribute to AI\-native observability initiatives, including leveraging AI to improve anomaly detection, troubleshooting, and operational insights. * Partner with engineering teams to identify gaps in observability and drive improvements. * Prepare and share observability best practices and product knowledge with SRE, Technical Support, and development teams. * Contribute to improving the overall reliability and operational readiness of LiveRamp’s products. **About you:** * Hands\-on experience with software development, automation, or observability\-related projects. * Experience with monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, or performance testing concepts. * Experience with Python and/or Java. * Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or similar tools. * Experience working with cloud environments such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or similar. * Familiarity with REST APIs, distributed systems, and microservices is a plus. * Interest in AI/ML and applying AI to software engineering, monitoring, and troubleshooting is a plus. * Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment. * Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills with an interest in improving system reliability and developer experience. The approximate annual hourly compensation range is $31\-49/hr.
