jobs.description: **Graduate Rotation Engineer** **Saber Power Services, LLC, (SPS)** , a portfolio company of Greenbelt Capital Partners, is a fully integrated electrical power system services firm providing end\-to\-end solutions across utility, industrial, petrochemical, renewables, and data center markets. Based in Houston, Texas, Saber delivers engineering\-led solutions for medium\- and high\-voltage electrical infrastructure across North America and abroad. **Saber Power** **Services** seeks a professional, dedicated individual with a positive outlook for our Graduate Rotation Engineer opening. **Job Summary:** Develop conceptual designs, direction, consultation and support of substation, oil/gas electrical power facility and short\-line transmission projects. Main Responsibilities * Responsible for substation, plant power distribution and transmission line projects involving Low, Medium and High Voltage system components using switchgear, transformers, and protection systems from a functional and specific perspective. * Has direct responsibility for managing and directing in house and engineering consultants to assure the design meets project objectives in a timely and cost\-effective manner. * Works closely with Saber Project and Construction Management to assure design is constructible and is fully integrated into the project schedule. * The Graduate Rotation Engineer’s responsibilities include the overall electrical design, develop material specifications, review vendor submittal drawings, project electrical studies, creation of system models using ETAP or SKM Power Tools software and supervise designer and drafters for new and upgrades to existing substations. * This position is expected to apply sound and diversified knowledge of electrical engineering principles and practices as well as make independent decisions concerning assigned projects. * Responsibilities may include training and provision of engineering support to a variety of company personnel. * The candidate should possess a strong understanding of the design and operation of substation components, control systems and site layout. * Will be under the supervision of a Senior Engineer for several of the responsibilities Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from accredited program. * Excellent written \& verbal communication skills. * Ability to work in a team environment, as well as strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. SAFETY: Safety is priority number one with our organization. jobs.title: Contract Web Developer — Front-End Focused
jobs.description: **Contract Web Developer — Front\-End Focused** Freelance · Project\-by\-project · Fully remote **Location:** Fully remote (U.S.) **Engagement:** Contract, hourly **Rate:** $50–$75 / hour **Focus area:** Front\-end development for client websites \& web applications **ROLLING APPLICATION — NOT A SINGLE OPENING** We accept applications continuously. This is not a posting for one position. Work comes in as our client projects do, so the need may be immediate or it may be months away. We keep every application on file and reach out when a project matches what you do. **ABOUT THE ROLE** We are building a bench of contract developers we can call on as client work comes in. We are looking for a front\-end focused web developer who is comfortable working across the stack. You will build the interfaces our clients' customers actually use — new sites, single\-page web applications, and feature work on sites already in production. You do not need to architect back\-end systems, but you should be able to work confidently against one: consume REST APIs, read and write SQL, and work in PHP well enough to know where a problem is coming from. Dynamic Digital modernizes outdated technology, builds on proven frameworks, and delivers efficient development that helps our clients grow with confidence. We are a small team, the feedback loop is short, and what you build goes live for real clients. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Build responsive front\-end interfaces in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript using React or a comparable framework, working from designs we provide. * Integrate front ends with RESTful APIs, databases, and third\-party services. * Develop and customize WordPress themes and plugins, and work carefully inside existing client sites. * Contribute to single\-page web applications from scope through launch. * Write and tune SQL queries, and work comfortably in PHP against an existing back end. * Maintain and improve sites already in production — diagnosing issues, resolving bugs, and improving speed. * Write, test, and maintain high\-quality code across multiple projects. * Review every line you ship, including anything produced with AI assistance, for correctness, quality, and security. * Work closely with our team — account management, design, and leadership — to deliver work clients are happy with. * Test before deployment and follow current standards and best practices. * Create and maintain clear technical documentation for the systems you build and touch. * Work from written scopes provided by the account team, and flag scope changes early — before the hours are spent. **REQUIREMENTS** * 2–7 years of professional web development experience * Strong front\-end skills: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a modern framework (React, Vue, or Angular) * Experience consuming and integrating RESTful APIs * Working knowledge of SQL (MySQL or PostgreSQL) * PHP. Much of our client work runs on WordPress, so PHP is required, not a nice\-to\-have. * Enough back\-end familiarity to work against an existing server\-side codebase without needing it explained * Working knowledge of WordPress theme and plugin development * Solid understanding of version control (Git) * Comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools. You are accountable for what you ship with them: AI\-generated code gets the same review for quality and security as anything you write by hand. * Ability to work independently and deliver functional solutions with minimal oversight * Clear written communication — most of our coordination is asynchronous * Availability for occasional scheduled calls during Eastern business hours * A portfolio and a GitHub account we can review. Formal degree not required. **PREFERRED** * Node.js * TypeScript * Deeper back\-end or architecture experience * WooCommerce or Shopify * CI/CD pipelines * Hosting, DNS, and cPanel * SEO fundamentals and Core Web Vitals * Accessibility standards (WCAG) * Working from Figma designs **HOW THE ENGAGEMENT WORKS** * Independent contractor (1099\). You invoice us; you are not an employee of Dynamic Digital. * Hourly at $50–$75, depending on experience and the work. Rate is agreed before each project. * Project\-by\-project. No minimum hours are guaranteed, and we do not ask for exclusivity. * Applications are accepted on a rolling basis. Being accepted to our bench is not a commitment of work by either side. * Every project is scoped in writing — deliverables, hour estimate, and deadline — before work begins. * Fully remote anywhere in the United States. Our team is in Willow Grove, PA and works Eastern hours. * You control your own schedule, tools, and how the work gets done. Dynamic Digital is a web development agency in Willow Grove, Pennsylvania, managed by Sahajanand, LLC. We modernize outdated technology and build on proven frameworks so our clients can grow with confidence. Small team, short feedback loops, and the work you build goes live for real clients. Pay: $50\.00 \- $75\.00 / hour Job Type: contract Education: No education required Work location: This is a remote position Dynamic Digital LLC. 2713 Easton Rd, Willow Grove, PA, 19090

jobs.description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* Job Category Software Engineering Job Details **About Salesforce** Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. Join an agile team with deep startup roots. We operate as a high\-velocity 'startup\-within\-Salesforce,' following our recent acquisition. You’ll be working alongside the founding team and engineers in an organization offering the autonomy of a small team backed by the global scale and trust of Salesforce. You will have the unique opportunity to build a '0 to 1' product in one of the fastest growing verticals within Salesforce. Global supply chains still rely on slow, manual processes—email, spreadsheets, and fragmented data. Nowhere does modernizing them matter more than in the public sector, where the scale and stakes are highest. **Missionforce Operations** is reimagining the public sector supply chain with an AI\-powered platform for designing, automating, and running end\-to\-end business processes, with seamless collaboration through familiar channels like email. jobs.title: Data Integration Engineer I
jobs.description: **JOB OVERVIEW** ---------------- **GENERAL PURPOSE** Responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and supporting data integrations, automations, reports, and software solutions that support county business operations. Transforms data into actionable information, empowers informed decision\-making across the organization and supports strategic and operational goals. **SUPERVISION EXERCISED** None **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS, DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** ---------------------------------------------------- **ESSENTIAL DUTIES** * Design, develop, test, document, monitor, and maintain data integrations between County systems using APIs, database connections, scripts, and other integration tools. * + Conduct analyses of functional business processes and requirements. * Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and requirements. * Identify opportunities to improve processes and work with teammates to implement. * Develop, maintain, and present reports by data mining, collecting, integrating, modeling, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends in formats that meet user needs. * Design, develop, and optimize data models to support reporting, dashboards, and advanced analytics. * Create, install, and test database integrations, permissions and privileges. * Utilize Power BI, Microsoft Reporting Services, or other software in a Microsoft SQL/T\-SQL/M365 environment to bring together data from disparate systems to design and produce models, dashboards, and reports. * Analyze, design, optimize, and automate processes and workflows using county provided platforms and tools. * Support county reports, dashboards, audits, and other data systems while adhering to project deadlines and service level agreements * Coordinate and manage projects, ensuring deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with organizational goals. * Maintain technical documentation for integrations, automations, data models, reports, configurations, and support procedures. * Provide report and system training for various county employees, departments, and organizations. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** -------------------------- **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s\* degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field. * 2 years of experience in data integration, database design, and/or query optimization or in a related IT role. + Approved work experience beyond that required which provides equivalent knowledge, skills, and abilities may be considered and substituted for the stated education. * Have and maintain a valid Driver’s License, as well as meet eligibility requires of “acceptable driving standards” as defined by the County. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES** * Effective communication and interpersonal skills for interacting with diverse individuals. * Ability to multi\-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively. * Proficiency in using the Microsoft Office Suite and other software related to data management, communication, and other common business processes. * Ability to follow established policies and procedures for confidentiality while adapting to evolving privacy standards and technologies. * Ability to build and maintain positive relationships within a team. * Basic knowledge of I.T. security practices. * Extensive technical aptitude skills and ability to comprehend complex technical topics and specialized information. * Ability to disseminate information to technical and non\-technical individuals. * Proficiency in SQL and scripting languages for data manipulation and analysis. * Experience in designing, developing, and optimizing reports, dashboards, and data models. * Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS** ------------------------------------------- The work environment is typically a professional office setting, involving regular use of computers, standard office equipment, and frequent interaction with both internal staff and the public in a structured, task\-oriented atmosphere. Work hours may include evenings, early mornings, weekends, call\-ins, and holidays. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential tasks.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: The Senior Full Stack Engineer leads the end\-to\-end development lifecycle across client engagements, partnering with designers, strategists, and project managers to architect, build, deploy, and maintain high\-quality digital products. This role combines technical expertise with strategic thinking to deliver scalable, maintainable solutions that advance client goals. As a senior member of the team, this individual independently leads technical client relationships, facilitates discovery and technical workshops, and drives engineering best practices across projects. They also help evaluate and advance the agency's AI\-enabled development capabilities to improve delivery, strengthen client solutions, and increase team effectiveness. Savas is a technology\-agnostic agency with an AI\-first mindset, and success in this role requires curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to work confidently across multiple platforms and frameworks. Successful Senior Full Stack Engineers embrace AI as a core part of how they solve problems, deliver technically excellent work, build trusted client relationships, and continuously improve how Savas designs, builds, and delivers digital products. **Compensation** ---------------- This is a salaried, full\-time employee position with benefits. The salary range is **$110,000 to $130,000 per year**, depending on experience. Sales commission opportunities for in\-person relationship building. ### **Responsibilities** #### **Client Delivery** * Lead engineering efforts across multiple client engagements from discovery through launch and long\-term maintenance. * Architect scalable, maintainable, and secure technical solutions aligned with client goals and business requirements. * Build custom web applications, websites, APIs, integrations, and CMS implementations using appropriate technologies. * Collaborate closely with designers, strategists, project managers, and QA throughout the project lifecycle. * Produce, maintain, debug, optimize, and extend applications and user interfaces. * Establish and maintain local development environments using version managers, containerization, and modern development tooling. * Configure and execute deployment workflows across development, staging, and production environments. * Ensure work meets agency standards for accessibility, performance, security, maintainability, and documentation. * Identify technical risks, dependencies, and opportunities early, communicating tradeoffs and recommendations throughout delivery. * Participate in ongoing support, troubleshooting, and maintenance of launched client projects. * Comfortable balancing technical excellence with client budgets, timelines, and evolving priorities. #### **Technical Leadership** * Serve as the primary engineering voice during client meetings, discovery sessions, technical workshops, and solution presentations. * Lead technical planning and solution architecture for new initiatives and enhancements. * Establish and reinforce engineering best practices, coding standards, and development workflows. * Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback that improves code quality and team capability. * Identify, prioritize, and help address technical debt while balancing delivery timelines and long\-term maintainability. * Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and development practices to improve agency capabilities. #### **Agency Growth \& Business Development** * Support business development through estimates, proposals, prototypes and technical discovery. * Evaluate and implement AI\-assisted development workflows. * Contribute to internal tooling, documentation, knowledge sharing, and process improvements. * Participate in internal initiatives, experimental projects, and retreats. ### **Professional Knowledge** * A breadth of full\-stack experience in PHP CMS (Drupal, WordPress, Symfony and Craft) and/or JS stacks (React/NextJS, ReactNative) * Developing themes and using templating languages * Developing APIs and integrating with external APIs * Deployments, establishing development workflows, and setting up local development environments on Docker * Experience deploying applications across modern cloud hosting and Platform\-as\-a\-Service environments (e.g. Pantheon, Vercel, Upsun). * Creating CI/CD pipelines * Communicating directly with clients and can effectively address non\-technical audiences ### **Experience** * 5–8\+ years of development experience, with meaningful time in an agency or consultancy environment * Demonstrated experience leading technical discussions with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Hands\-on experience using AI development tools responsibly to accelerate the delivery of production\-ready software. * Experience collaborating with designers using Figma or similar design tool * Performing well in a fast\-paced, multi\-project environment where priorities shift * Experience making architectural decisions and balancing technical quality against project constraints. ### **Education \& Training** Education and training commensurate with a Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5–8\+ years of experience, preferably in an agency environment.

jobs.title: Scientific Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: We're seeking a **Scientific Machine Learning (ML) Engineer** to join us in our mission to transform the discovery of therapeutics and materials! Our Hit Discovery team builds computational workflows that combine machine learning with chemical physics to efficiently evaluate billions of potential drug molecules. As a member of this group, you'll collaborate with research scientists on improving the accuracy and applicability of these methods and turn them into robust, scalable software products. **Who will love this job:** * An applied problem solver who's excited about addressing challenging problems in computational chemistry and thrives when working with large codebases and data sets * A growth\-oriented engineer who's eager to adopt best practices like automated testing and code reviews * A collaborative communicator who enjoys bridging the gap between ML, software engineering, and scientific research **What you'll do:** * Design, build, and test scalable software for ML virtual screening pipelines, integrating ML applications with physics\-based backends (such as docking and free energy perturbation) to optimize hit and hit\-to\-lead campaigns * Work closely with scientists to adapt and expand our existing workflows for new discovery cases, as well as help develop new methodologies with our current pipelines * Explore scientific literature and benchmark novel ML approaches to improve the applicability and accuracy of core hit discovery workflows **What you should have:** * Bachelor's degree or higher in Chemistry, Physics, Computer Science, or a related field * Between one and three years of production\-level software development experience * Prior ML knowledge (i.e., Reinforcement Learning or Active Learning) for predicting measurable properties of biological and/or chemical systems * Python programming proficiency and experience with ML frameworks like PyTorch **We'd love to hire someone with:** * Familiarity with one of the following areas: molecular dynamics simulation, free energy calculation methods, ligand\-based drug design, cheminformatics, quantum mechanics, virtual screening, and/or structured modeling * Experience with development of relevant commercial and/or open\-source computational chemistry software **Pay and perks:** Schrödinger understands it's people that make a company great. Because of this, we're prepared to offer a competitive salary, equity\-based compensation, and a wide range of benefits that include healthcare (with dental and vision), a 401k, pre\-tax commuter benefits, a flexible work schedule, and a parental leave program. We have a company culture that is relaxed, but engaged, and over a month of paid vacation time. Our Office Management team also plans a myriad of fun company\-wide events. New York is home to our largest office, but we have teams all over the world. Schrödinger is honored to have been included in Crain's New York Best Places to Work, BuiltIn's NYC Best Place to Work, and Newsweek's list of America's 100 Most Loved Workplaces. Estimated base salary range: $130,000 \- $160,000\. Actual compensation package is dependent on a number of factors, including, for example, experience, education, degrees held, market data, and business needs. If you have any questions regarding the compensation for this role, do not hesitate to reach out to a member of our Strategic Growth team. Sound exciting? Apply today and join us! *As an equal opportunity employer, Schrödinger hires outstanding individuals into every position in the company. People who work with us have a high degree of engagement, a commitment to working effectively in teams, and a passion for the company's mission. We place the highest value on creating a safe environment where our employees can grow and contribute, and refuse to discriminate on the basis of race, color, religious belief, sex, age, disability, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, marital status, partnership status, caregiver status, sexual and reproductive health decisions, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. To us, "diversity" isn't just a buzzword, but an important element of our core principles and key business practices. We believe that diverse companies innovate better and think more creatively than homogenous ones because they take into account a wide range of viewpoints. For us, greater diversity doesn't mean better headlines or public images \- it means increased adaptability and profitability.*

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Data Center
jobs.description: Lead the union of customer needs, market opportunities, and technical innovation by identifying, developing, and advancing opportunities that invent the future of the data center market. Serve as the strategic bridge between customers, Marketing, Product Management, Sales \& Customer Service, Engineering Services, and R\&D, transforming ideas, insights, and emerging technologies into differentiated products and solutions that create sustainable customer value, drive business growth, and strengthen SEL's leadership in the industries it serves. **A typical day as a Principal Engineer might include:** 1\. Lead the discovery, development, evaluation, and advancement of innovative ideas, technologies, applications, market opportunities, and growth initiatives that invent the future and support long\-term business objectives. 2\. Drive market analysis, technology benchmarking, competitive intelligence, customer engagement, customer feedback collection, application discovery, and trend analysis to identify unmet needs, emerging opportunities, and differentiated value propositions. 3\. Establish and manage a continuous pipeline of strategic opportunities derived from the union of customer needs, market dynamics, industry developments, technology advancements, and SEL innovation initiatives. 4\. Translate market opportunities into product requirements and development initiatives by collaborating with Product Management, Sales \& Customer Service, Engineering Services, R\&D, Subject Matter Experts, Application Leaders, and other stakeholders. 5\. Provide deep expertise in technologies, systems, applications, and customer challenges to ensure products and solutions address validated market needs and deliver differentiated value. 6\. Influence product strategy, portfolio planning, technology roadmaps, business cases, value propositions, positioning strategies, and technical narratives that support business growth and customer success. 7\. Drive customer adoption, market expansion, application growth, revenue realization, and long\-term commercial success through continuous engagement, feedback integration, market learning, and value realization initiatives. 8\. Serve as the primary bridge between customers, Marketing, Product Management, Sales \& Customer Service, Engineering Services, and R\&D while providing leadership through industry forums, standards organizations, technical committees, and customer advisory groups. 9\. Monitor product performance, customer adoption, revenue growth, market penetration, and customer value realization to identify barriers, guide decision\-making, and improve business outcomes. 10\. Educate internal and external audiences regarding customer needs, market opportunities, SEL capabilities, and emerging technologies through mentoring, technical content, presentations, training, intellectual property development, and knowledge sharing. 11\. Model, teach, and apply SEL Values, Principles of Operations, and World Class Manufacturing Principles; create, protect and advance intellectual property; and contribute to organizational success through innovation, creativity, and the principles of Understand, Create, and Simplify. **This job might be for you if have:** BS degree in Electrical Engineering or an applicable discipline. 15\+ years working knowledge and experience of electric power systems or other equivalent transferable knowledge and industry experience. Recognized as a leader, advocate and expert within SEL inData Centers and applicable industry practices. Demonstrated expertise in the primary focus area (Data Centers), with strong working knowledge of adjacent technologies, applications, products, and market segments necessary to support cross\-functional innovation, product strategy, and customer engagement. Demonstrable enthusiasm for developing and mentoring engineers. Excellent technical training, speaking, writing, and customer service skills. Willingness to travel per business need. Strong writing, documentation, and speaking skills. Ability to learn new skills and assume new responsibilities. Ability to work cooperatively in a team environment. Background check results satisfactory to SEL. Negative drug test result(s). **It is a plus if you have:** Master’s and/or PhD in Engineering discipline. Accomplished author and presenter of technical papers. Holder and major inventor of US patents related to SEL's mission. Registered Professional Engineer. **Focus Area \= Data Center**: Subject matter expert in the application of protection, automation, monitoring, metering, cybersecurity, communications, and software solutions for data center infrastructure, supporting high availability, resiliency, energy efficiency, and mission\-critical operational requirements**.** **Location:** Boise, ID or Pullman, WA **Competitive pay. Superior benefits. Inspiring work.** People are at the core of our company and we hire employee\-owners. We welcome you to learn more about how we support employees. * We’re 100% employee owned. Retirement benefits include an employer funded stock ownership plan (ESOP) and personal 401(k) options. * We offer top tier medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. * We recognize the importance of a healthy life balance and offer: 10 paid holidays, annual vacation accrual starting at 12 days, 9 paid sick days, and paid family and medical leave that covers 90% of your pay. * We foster growth and development of our employees through avenues such as STEM courses, apprenticeships, tuition assistance, and engineering development programs. * Ask our team about other benefits including wellness, fertility, adoption, and flexible spending benefits. **Pay Range Data \- $209,000 \- $270,000 annually** We set starting pay based on job\-related factors such as your experience, training, knowledge, and skills. We anticipate filling this position at the Principal Engineer level, and we welcome applicants with a range of experience. Depending on your background, we may consider you for a different level, with compensation aligned accordingly. **Communication with Applicants** We communicate with all applicants. If you do not receive a response about your application, please check your SPAM filter or reach out to us at careers@selinc.com. SEL is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Vets/Disabled.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer - EDS
jobs.description: About Shift Shift Paradigm is an execution\-led strategic consultancy that bridges the gap between enterprise strategy and technical reality. We partner with Fortune 500 brands and emerging leaders to solve the inherent complexity of modern digital marketing. As partners to the world’s leading MarTech platforms, including Adobe, Salesforce, Optimizely, and Braze, we deploy integrated experts across data analytics, marketing strategy, technology development, engineering, and revenue operations to ensure our clients’ tech stacks don't just exist, but perform. Position Summary Shift paradigm is seeking a Full\-Stack Developer with deep, hands\-on Adobe Edge Delivery Services (EDS) experience and broader modern web and platform skills to join our team in building high\-performance, composable web experiences. The role is best suited to someone who is comfortable in fast\-paced, high\-ambiguity environments, where requirements evolve quickly, priorities shift, and the right path forward is not always fully defined at the outset. This role works directly with our clients on large, complex projects, so client facing or agency experience is a huge plus! **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Design, build, and maintain high\-performance, edge\-rendered websites and web applications using Adobe Edge Delivery Services (EDS), developing reusable, semantic, high\-performance blocks and components in native JavaScript, HTML5, and modern CSS3 * Serve as a secondary point of ownership and backup for our existing EDS\-based digital properties, working alongside our current developer to ensure coverage, continuity, and shared architectural decision\-making * Scaffold and configure new EDS projects on the AEM boilerplate, managing .hlx project configuration, routing/rewrites, and config.yaml * Own page\-loading performance: tune eager, lazy, and delayed loading phases (loadEager, loadLazy, loadDelayed) and programmatic auto\-blocking to hit elite Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and Lighthouse scores * Bridge engineering and content teams by configuring and optimizing document\-based authoring workflows (Google Docs, Microsoft Word, Adobe Document Authoring) * Manage a Git\-first deployment workflow (GitHub, GitHub Actions) where code changes sync directly to the edge, and work with CDN/edge configuration (e.g., Fastly, Cloudflare), including caching and TTL strategy * Serve as a client\-facing technical resource, translating client requirements into working solutions and clearly explaining technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders * Integrate EDS\-delivered pages with the broader Adobe ecosystem where needed (AEM Assets, headless APIs) and with CRM/MarTech systems as our platform strategy requires * Leverage AI/agentic coding tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to plan and execute development work, from task decomposition to autonomous or semi\-autonomous code generation and review. * Participate in technical discovery, estimation, and solutioning conversations with clients during project kickoff and delivery, as needed. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-documented code and contribute to code reviews and engineering best practices **Required Qualifications** =========================== * 4\+ years of professional full\-stack development experience, including 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building, testing, and launching live production websites on Adobe Edge Delivery Services (EDS) \- or a strong AEM background with demonstrated, fast ramp\-up on EDS * Expert\-level native/vanilla JavaScript (ES6\+), semantic HTML5, and modern CSS3 (custom properties, Grid/Flexbox), with sound judgment about when a heavier framework (React, Angular, Vue) is or isn’t the right tool for EDS\-based pages * Proven track record optimizing for Core Web Vitals Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Interaction to Next Paint (INP), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) and Lighthouse performance * Working proficiency in React and Next.js for building non\-EDS front\-end applications and internal tools * Mastery of Git/GitHub workflows: branching, pull requests, code review, and CI automation (e.g., GitHub Actions) * Experience with DevOps practices and tooling (CI/CD pipeline design, infrastructure\-as\-code, containerization, or cloud deployment) beyond basic GitHub Actions usage * Experience with document\-based authoring and document\-to\-HTML content workflows * Experience with back\-end development and API/integration work (REST, GraphQL, or similar) * Proven experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders in a client\-facing capacity * Demonstrated ability to thrive in fast\-paced, high\-ambiguity environments with shifting priorities and evolving requirements * Strong communication and collaboration skills, and the professional maturity to operate as a long\-term, trusted member of the team * Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of deliverables with limited day\-to\-day direction **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience migrating legacy AEM Sites (HTL/Sightly, OSGi, Sling Models) to a modern EDS architecture * Hands\-on experience with agentic AI development workflows \- both planning multi\-step technical work for AI agents to execute and directly operating agentic coding tools in production codebases. * Experience with .NET/C\# for back\-end services or API development * Experience with edge/CDN configuration (e.g., Fastly, Cloudflare), including caching strategy and Edge\-Side Includes (ESI) * Experience with the broader Adobe Experience Cloud (Adobe Target, Adobe Launch / Web SDK, AEM Assets) * Experience in a digital agency or consulting environment supporting multiple concurrent client engagements * SEO fundamentals, Open Graph/schema configuration, and edge\-side analytics implementation * Adobe certifications Compensation \& Benefits The salary range for this role is $130,000 to $145,000 USD. In addition to base salary, SH/FT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD\&D, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks. jobs.title: Finance Data Architect
jobs.description: **Finance Data Architect** Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? **Transform the everyday with us!** **Who are we?** **At Siemens Grid Software, we accelerate and secure a successful Energy Transition** Today the energy world is changing to become carbon neutral. Distributed Energy Resources are growing rapidly and decentralized power generation is transforming how energy systems operate. Utility companies are rethinking their IT/OT landscapes and require agile, data\-driven solutions to operate efficiently and securely. At Siemens Grid Software, we are at the forefront of this transformation, enabling our customers through advanced digital solutions, analytics, and software platforms. Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens Grid Software here: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/energy/topics/smart\-grid.html **Our Culture** At Siemens Grid Software, we foster an ownership culture where employees take responsibility, collaborate openly, and continuously improve. We value innovation, transparency, and data\-driven decision\-making. Our teams operate globally and work closely across functions to drive meaningful business outcomes. We have major locations in Minneapolis, MN; Foster City, CA; Schenectady, NY; Houston, TX; and Wendell, NC. This is a remote opportunity and is located in the United States. **Who are we seeking?** We are looking for a **Finance Data Architect** with a strong foundation in finance and a passion for data, analytics, and automation. This role is designed for a hands\-on builder who enjoys creating scalable tools, data models, and reporting solutions that improve how finance operates. While a portion of the role will support financial analysis and reporting, the vast majority of your time will be focused on developing and enhancing data infrastructure, dashboards, and automation solutions. **We aren't looking for a historian to tell us what happened; we are looking for an architect to build the engine that shows us what is happening** **now** **and what will happen** **next****.** **Key Tasks \& Responsibilities** **Data Modeling, Tool Development \& Automation (\~70%)** * **Build \& Maintain:** Design data models and datasets to support high\-fidelity financial reporting and analysis. * **Visualize:** Develop scalable Power BI dashboards and semantic models for business\-wide use. * **Transform:** Use Power Query and related tools to structure raw data into actionable insights. * **Automate:** Design repeatable reporting workflows and identify automation opportunities using Power Platform and AI\-enabled tools. * **Standardize:** Improve data structures across Actuals, Forecast, and Planning datasets to ensure a "Single Source of Truth." **Finance Analysis \& Reporting (\~20%)** * **FP\&A Support:** Provide variance analysis and forecasting inputs to the controlling teams. * **Targeted Analysis:** Perform deep\-dive data analysis to identify business trends, risks, and opportunities. * **Translate:** Turn complex business questions into clear, data\-driven narratives. **Strategic Project Support \& Integration (\~10%)** * R\&D / PLM Controlling: Assist in financial tracking and cost transparency for product development initiatives and resource allocation. * Ecosystem Integration: Work with SAP data (FI/CO, COPA) and support the integration of data sources into platforms like Snowflake. * Architecture Improvement: Assist in improving data pipelines and overall regional data architecture. **You will make an impact by:** **Qualifications \& Key Competencies** * **Analytical Rigor \& Curiosity:**You don't just "run" reports; you interrogate the data. You have a natural drive to understand the "why" behind the numbers and the "how" behind the data flow. * **Self\-Directed Ownership:**As a "builder" in a remote environment, you must be a high\-agency individual who can identify a problem, design a solution, and execute it with minimal supervision. * **Data Storytelling \& Influence:**The ability to translate complex data models into clear, actionable business narratives. * **Commitment to Data Integrity:**You are the guardian of the "Single Source of Truth." You have an uncompromising eye for detail and understand that a dashboard is only as good as the governance behind it. * **Resilience \& Stakeholder Partnership:**You possess the "strong resolve" necessary to partner with high\-performing, autonomous teams. You can hold the line on data standards and financial discipline while remaining a collaborative business partner. * **Continuous Improvement Mindset:**You are never satisfied with "how we’ve always done it." You are constantly looking for ways to automate, simplify, and scale our financial operations. **Required Education \& Skills** * Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Finance, Accounting, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or Engineering). We value candidates who can bridge the gap between financial logic and data architecture. **Must have 8plus years of the following:** * **The Architect’s Toolkit:** Expert\-level Power BI (DAX) and Power Query (M). * **Data Modeling:** Proven experience building relational data models and semantic layers (Star Schemas). * **SAP Core:** Strong working knowledge of SAP FI/CO and COPA modules. * **Advanced Analytics \& Modeling (Excel):** Expert functionality (Dynamic Arrays, Power Pivot, and complex logic). * **Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without need for current or future employer\-sponsored work authorization.** **Preferred Qualifications** * **Modern Data Stack:** Exposure to Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms. * **Code\-Savvy:** Basic SQL for data querying; Python is a significant plus. * **AI\-Forward:** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to drive development efficiency. * **Domain Expertise:** Experience in R\&D, PLM, or project\-based financial controlling. **Why this role is unique** * **Engineer the Finance Data Stack:** A majority focus on building scalable data infrastructure, moving beyond traditional static reporting. * **Architect the 'Single Source of Truth':** Lead the effort to shape and standardize datasets across the entire business lifecycle. * **Master the Modern Data Stack:** Work at the cutting edge of finance technology, integrating enterprise ERP (SAP) with cloud\-based analytics (Snowflake \& Power BI). * **Be the Architect, Not Just the Consumer:** This is a "builder" role designed to develop a next\-gen skillset at the intersection of Finance, Data Engineering, and Strategic Controlling. **About Siemens:** We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource\-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here. **Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:** We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. $102,459 $175,644 10%

jobs.description: **Why this role is important to us** The Head of Optimization is a senior product leadership role responsible for defining and driving the strategic direction of SimCorp’s optimization product portfolio, including the Axioma Portfolio Optimizer, bringing advanced decision intelligence to the world’s largest asset owners and asset managers on the SimCorp ONE platform. Optimization is a core competency at SimCorp and a defining source of competitive differentiation with our largest and most sophisticated clients. The Axioma Portfolio Optimizer is a best\-of\-breed decision engine, long valued in the quantitative finance community for automating and scaling complex portfolio decisions. Its integration into the SimCorp ONE ecosystem creates a unique opportunity to take optimization beyond the quant desk and embed it across the investment lifecycle — for portfolio managers, CIOs and risk teams across investment styles and asset classes. As a member of the Portfolio Management \& Trading product leadership team, this role shapes the vision, market positioning and execution of our optimization capabilities, and ensures they connect seamlessly with portfolio management, trading, risk, compliance and total portfolio workflows. Portfolio Management \& Trading strategy, enterprise business objectives and evolving institutional client requirements. * You shape how optimization is embedded across SimCorp ONE — from portfolio construction and rebalancing to pre\-trade analysis, risk\-aware decision making and total portfolio management for asset owners. * You identify and capitalize on market opportunities, including users. * You maintain a clear view of the competitive landscape and establish SimCorp and Axioma as the thought leader in portfolio optimization and construction. **Product Execution \& Operational commercial goals, client commitments and user needs, and shortens time\-to\-value for clients. * You drive the integration of the optimizer into SimCorp ONE, managing dependencies with platform, data, risk, AI and front\-office product teams and resolving trade\-offs early. **Customer Insight \& External Engagement** * You build strong, trusted relationships with quantitative and fundamental investment teams, CIOs and risk leaders at our most sophisticated clients, translating their feedback into strategic priorities. * You represent SimCorp’s optimization vision to clients, prospects, partners and industry forums, supporting strategic deals and reinforcing our reputation in the quantitative finance community. * You use product performance data, adoption metrics, competitive intelligence and market research to inform investment decisions and measure business impact. **Leading \& Influencing People** * You lead, mentor and develop a team of product managers. * You cultivate a culture of collaboration, curiosity, innovation and accountability that attracts and retains world\-class product and quantitative talent. You act as a trusted advisor to the Head of Portfolio Management \& Trading and the wider product leadership team, communicating vision, progress and results with clarity, and contributing to planning, prioritization and resource allocation. * **What We Value** **Domain Expertise \& Market Knowledge** * Minimum 10 years of experience in product management and leadership for enterprise investment management or financial services platforms. * Deep subject matter expertise in portfolio optimization, portfolio construction and risk analytics, including factor risk models, constraint\-based optimization and rebalancing workflows. * Strong understanding of institutional asset management and asset owner workflows across asset classes (equities, fixed income, multi\-asset), and of the competitive dynamics in quantitative and portfolio construction technology. **Product Leadership \& Execution Excellence** * Demonstrated ability to define strategic vision and lead high\-performing product teams across multiple products, with a track record of successful launches and measurable business impact. * Experience managing complex products with many stakeholders and constraints, including integrating specialist capabilities into a broader platform. * Demonstrated ability to learn multiple functional areas of the business — engineering, research, design, finance, sales and marketing. * Sound judgement in solving hard problems with many constraints, assessing risk, and making clear, data\-informed decisions. **Strategic Communication \& Influence** * Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to senior executives, sophisticated institutional clients and industry audiences with clarity and conviction. * Ability to lay out your argument in a well\-structured, data\-informed written narrative. Proven ability to build constructive, collaborative relationships with engineers, quantitative researchers, designers and company leaders, and to influence without direct authority. * **Benefits** * Attractive salary and bonus scheme are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. * Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model \- working from SimCorp’s office two days a week. * And opportunities for professional development: there is never only one route \- we offer a personal approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. * Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp . * For New York City only: The salary range for this position is $221,120 – $331,680 USD. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including health care, leave, and retirement plans. Your total compensation may vary based on role, location, department and individual performance. * **Next Steps** * Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. * Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. * At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavour to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. * This role is for an active, existing vacancy. * If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. * The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. * **Who We Are** * For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. * We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. * SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients. * SimCorp is an equal\-opportunity employer. Do** ------------------ **Business Development \& Client Relations** * Develop and maintain relationships with homeowners, architects, interior designers, real estate professionals, and referral partners. * Generate qualified opportunities through networking, referrals, and community involvement. * Represent Skelly Build professionally at industry and community events. * Maintain an organized Project Management team once projects move into construction. * Deliver a responsive, organized, and professional client experience from start to finish. **What Success Looks Like** opportunities. * Converting qualified opportunities into signed construction agreements. * Delivering an exceptional client experience throughout the preconstruction process. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in residential construction, preconstruction, business development, construction sales, or client relationship management. * Experience working with homeowners, architects, designers, builders, or residential construction clients. * Proven ability to develop relationships that generate new business. * Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. * Excellent organization and project management abilities. * Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. * Self\-motivated with a collaborative, solutions\-focused mindset. * Professional executive presence and outstanding interpersonal skills. **Technology You'll Use** ------------------------- * Buildertrend * Pipedrive CRM * As a Data Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain the pipelines that move data from our source systems (ERP, CRM, e\-commerce, marketing, survey, and finance platforms) into Snowflake, and shape it into reliable, well\-modeled data for analytics, Power BI reporting, and AI\-driven applications. You will work within an established architecture and set of engineering standards, partnering with the Data Architect on design decisions and with the Data Analysis team on delivery. Our data engineering team actively uses AI assistants in day\-to\-day development, and we expect engineers to adopt these tools thoughtfully and responsibly. **Responsibilities** *Pipeline Development \& Data Integration* * Build and maintain Python\-based ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from REST APIs, SFTP/flat files, and SaaS platforms (e.g., Qualtrics, Shopify, UKG, ERP, HubSpot) into Snowflake. * Implement incremental loads, MERGE\-based upserts, watermark/control\-table patterns, soft deletes, and idempotent reruns following team conventions. *Data Modeling \& Warehousing* * Develop and tune Snowflake SQL across raw, staged, and presentation layers, including views, tasks, and streams. * Design and build data marts in Snowflake (fact and dimension tables, conformed dimensions, and aggregate layers) that serve Power BI reporting and downstream analytics. *Orchestration, Security \& Data Quality* * Schedule and orchestrate jobs using GitHub Actions, monitor runs, and resolve failures. * Manage secrets and credentials securely via AWS Secrets Manager and Snowflake key\-pair authentication. * Build data quality checks and assertion tests, and detect and remediate schema drift from upstream sources. *AI \& Advanced Data Services* * Support Snowflake Cortex and MCP\-based data services (semantic views, search services) by preparing and governing the underlying data. * Use AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude) as part of the daily workflow to accelerate pipeline development, code review, debugging, and documentation, while retaining full ownership of correctness and quality. *Collaboration, Documentation \& Engineering Standards* * Collaborate with analysts and business stakeholders to translate reporting needs into data models and Power BI\-ready datasets. * Write clear runbooks and data dictionaries. * Participate in code reviews and follow Git branching and pull request standards. **Qualifications** * 3–5 years of hands\-on data engineering experience. * Hands\-on experience building star\-schema data marts (fact/dimension design, grain definition, surrogate keys, and SCD handling) for BI consumption. * Solid understanding of dimensional modeling and warehouse layering concepts. * Strong Python (pandas, requests, boto3, snowflake\-connector) for production pipelines. * Advanced SQL and working experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse. * Experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication, pagination, and rate limiting. * Familiarity with AWS services used in data workflows (S3, Lambda, Secrets Manager, IAM). * Experience with CI/CD and job scheduling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar). * Experience with Snowflake Cortex, semantic models, or LLM/AI\-assisted data workflows. * Demonstrated ability to work effectively with AI coding assistants, including strong prompting, critical review of generated code, and sound judgment on when not to rely on them. *Nice to Have* * Experience with industry\-leading ETL tools, n8n, or similar low\-code integration tools. * dbt or an equivalent transformation and testing framework. * Power BI data modeling or DAX exposure. * Retail, wholesale, or consumer\-products domain experience (ERP, CRM, PLM, e\-commerce data). **Success in the First 6–12 Months** * Independently own eight to ten production pipelines end to end. * Reduce recurring pipeline failures through improved monitoring and data quality checks. * Contribute reusable pipeline templates that shorten onboarding time for new sources. \#LI\-Remote

Join our team as Data Center Engineer I and play a pivotal role in installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting essential equipment and infrastructure that power our data centers. You’ll provide foundational technical support while ensuring reliability and safety, making a tangible difference in our network’s performance and customer experience. **Shift Requirements for this role :** **Tuesday to Saturday 11PM to 8AM EST** **How You’ll Make an Impact*** Install, configure, operate and maintain legacy and new data center equipment using established procedures * Perform routine inspections, operational checks, testing and logging for data center and facility systems * Monitor services and assist with quality assurance and basic troubleshooting of network and facility systems * Install, route, terminate and test Ethernet, coaxial and fiber cabling following engineering and safety practices * Support installation, testing and maintenance of optical transport components and assist with troubleshooting of network issues * Support testing and monitoring of backup power and environmental systems including generators, UPS, DC plants, HVAC and fire/life safety systems * Maintain logs, test records and documentation in compliance with Spectrum procedures and regulations * Maintain a clean, safe and organized work environment while supporting project activities for facility upgrades and equipment installations **Working Conditions*** **Shift Requirements for this role :** **Tuesday to Saturday 11PM to 8AM EST** * Work in a 24x7 fast paced environment * Exposure to continuous moderate noise * Work and travel in inclement weather * Work performed near power facilities and electricity * Ability to work while standing 50 \- 70% of the time * Ability to safely lift up to 50lbs. individually or with assistance **What You’ll Bring to Spectrum** **Required Qualifications** **Education*** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent field experience in science, technology, engineering, electronics or related discipline * Trade/apprenticeship training or discipline\-specific licenses/certifications may be considered for equivalent experience **Experience*** 1\+ years of data center technician, electronics, network implementation or related hands\-on technical experience **Skills*** Basic knowledge of TCP/IP, OSI model and network transport concepts * Basic knowledge of Ethernet, coaxial and fiber cabling installation and testing * Basic knowledge of HFC, DOCSIS, CMTS, video networking, IP transport and related network architectures * Basic knowledge of transport technologies such as CWDM, DWDM, SONET, T1, Ethernet, microwave and wireless systems * Basic understanding of critical infrastructure systems including HVAC, generators, UPS, DC plants, inverters, monitoring/control systems and life safety systems * Basic understanding of voltage, amperage and resistance * Ability to use standard hand tools, ladders, test equipment, ticketing systems and common software applications * Ability to read blueprints, diagrams, system maps and layouts * Strong verbal and written communication skills * Ability to work independently on routine assignments and collaborate with cross\-functional teams * Ability to distinguish wire colors and sizes and work in tight spaces * Ability to work in high stress, fast paced environment **Preferred Qualifications** **Education*** Certifications related to optical transport, critical infrastructure or data center operations **Experience*** 1\+ years managing construction activities and electrical/mechanical trade work within data centers * 1\+ years as an electrical/mechanical technician in mission\-critical facilities, campus central plants or data centers * 1\+ years with electrical/mechanical/monitoring systems in military settings or integrated control systems applications * 1\+ years in computing and networking installation/support across complex environments **Skills*** Knowledge of Spectrum products and services * Knowledge of industry standards such as NEC, ASHRAE, IEEE, IBC, ANSI/TIA and Uptime * Experience in mission\-critical facilities or data center environments \#LI\-RM1 EOP302 2026\-82879 EOP302 2026 Here, our employees don’t just have jobs, they're building careers. Beyond our connectivity solutions, we also provide local news, programming and regional sports via Spectrum Networks and multiscreen advertising solutions via Spectrum Reach. When you join our team, you’ll be keeping our customers connected to what matters most in 41 states across the U.S. Watch this video to learn more. **Grow Your Career Here** We’re committed to growing a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve – providing opportunities for employment and advancement to all team members. jobs.title: Public Works Inspector l or II - Storm Water MS4 Compliance Administrator
jobs.description: **Public Works Inspector I \- Grade 15 ($27\.43 \- $41\.32 DOQ):** Three (3\) years of public works inspection experience; OR an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. Six (6\) years of public works construction, permitting, development, and/or related experience may be substituted for public works inspection experience for up to three (3\) years. Must be a Registered Stormwater Inspector or be able to obtain the certification within one (1\) month. Must have APWA Certified Stormwater Manager (CSM) Certification, Registered Stormwater Reviewer (RSR), and Registered Stormwater Writer (RSW), or be able to obtain these certifications within six (6\) months (dependent upon program availability). **Public Works Inspector II \- Grade 17 ($30\.24 \- $45\.55 DOQ):** Six (6\) years, minimum, of public works inspection experience. Must have APWA Public Infrastructure Inspector Certification. **Department:** Public Works **Position Reports to:** Senior Civil Engineer **Pay Grade:** 15/17 **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Exempt/Nonexempt:** Non\-exempt **Description:** Under the general direction of the Senior Civil Engineer, is responsible for administration and enforcement of the City's Utah Pollution Discharge Elimination System (UPDES), Municipal Separate Storm Sewer System (MS4\) Permit, and inspecting workmanship, materials, and contractor oversight for development and city capital projects. **Duties:** * Coordinate and administer Land Disturbance Permits (LDPs). * Provide technical, professional, and administrative support to the City's storm water management program as mandated by City's Storm Water Management Plan (SWMP), Utah Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (UPDES), and the National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES). * Ensure compliance with City, State, and EPA codes, specifications and guidelines, as required by the City Municipal code and Storm Water Management Plan, the state of Utah UPDES requirements, and the EPA NPDES requirements. * Administer and provide updates to the Construction General Permit for Discharge to the City's MS4 and recommend ordinances, policies, and regulations. * Oversee SWPPP related tasks: + Plan reviews + DRC meetings + Pre\-construction through post construction activities + Long\-Term Storm Water Maintenance Agreement and Plan (LTSWMA/P) completion and compliance * Oversee and manage Illicit Discharge Detection and Elimination program enforcement, ordinances, policies, and education. * Inspect construction projects for conformance with applicable standards, codes, plans, specifications, ordinances, regulations, and completion per contract schedule. * Review submittals, quantities and quality of materials, bonds, change orders, and pay requests. * Maintain daily records and reports of inspections. All other duties as assigned **Qualifications:** * Must be a high school graduate or equivalent. * Must possess a valid Utah Driver's License or be able to obtain one after satisfying the residency requirements. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES** Must have extensive knowledge of city and state related codes for public infrastructure development and standards, specifications, and procedures. Must possess the ability to work and communicate well with engineers, contractors, City employees, and the public. Must have the ability to understand and follow both oral and written instructions and the skill and ability to read code, plans, and specs. Must be able to use computers, various software, and GPS equipment related to the field of construction. Must be able to successfully pass a physical exam and drug test upon being hired and periodically at random thereafter while in the City's employ. **Physical Demands:** Work is performed indoors and outdoors. May be exposed to heavy machinery and extreme weather conditions. Visits to job sites include exposure to dust, extreme hot and cold temperatures, noise, and inclement weather in a construction zone environment, with occasional exposure to hazardous work conditions. Physical demands consist of frequent standing, climbing, walking, lifting, bending, or stooping. May be required to lift and carry items weighing up to 50 pounds.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, RegLab - Stanford Law School
jobs.description: This is for a **ONE\-YEAR FIXED TERM** position with the opportunity for extension based on performance. Multiple Positions will be Filled **\*Budgeted Range: The Law School’s budgeted pay for or this position is: $93,163 \- $104,477 per annum.** The Regulation, Evaluation, and Governance Lab (RegLab) at Stanford University is looking for a full\-time Data Scientist to provide analytical expertise across our research programs. **About Us:** Stanford RegLab builds the evidence base and technology for effective government. Our interdisciplinary team of engineers, data scientists, social scientists, and legal experts partners with agencies at every level—from federal departments to states, counties, and cities—bringing frontier AI, machine learning, and causal inference to the public sector. RegLab’s work has prompted an overhaul of tax auditing, mapped racial covenants across millions of records, and enabled streamlining of statutes and regulations. **You will:** * Work closely with the Faculty Director, Research Directors, Senior Data Scientists, and teams of fellows and students to drive forward a diverse research program focused on machine learning and policy evaluation * Design, implement, and interpret the results of new experiments and studies. * Work with large untapped data sets, such as: arge legal corpora, administrative records for public programs, LLM traces and benchmarks, health and environmental enforcement data * Develop and devise state\-of\-the\-art machine learning models, algorithms, and statistical models, while leading the collection of new data and the refinement of existing data sources. * Devise methods for identifying data patterns, trends in available information sources using a variety of qualitative and quantitative techniques. * Determine and recommend additional data collection and reporting requirements. * Lead the implementation of data standards and common data elements for data collection. * Work with self\-initiated direction to assess and produce relevant, standard, or custom information (reports, charts, graphs and tables) from structured data sources by querying data repositories and generating the associated information. Write and distribute reports based on data analysis to applicable agencies, researchers, or other internal end\-users. * Serve as a resource for non\-routine inquiries such as requests for statistics or surveys. Have the opportunity to receive co\-authorship on research papers * **Preferred Qualifications:** * A bachelor's degree, or MS or Ph.D., in a relevant quantitative field (e.g., data science, computer science, statistics, engineering, mathematics, economics, or a related field) and three years of (a) relevant professional experience or (b) combination of education and relevant professional experience * Expert knowledge of programming languages (such as Python, R, and/or SQL) * A deep understanding of modern statistical and machine learning models, when to apply them, and how to evaluate their performance * Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a focus on achieving results * Ability to work effectively with multiple internal and external customers, and ability to take a leadership role on projects and with users/clients. Self\-guided, self\-learner, and engaged in the mission of the Lab * **Nice to Haves:** * Specialization in machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, TF, PyTorch, Scikit Learn, etc.), NLP, LLM evaluation, computer vision, or related fields Academically\-minded, with experience working in an academic setting * **How to apply:** There will be two rounds of application review. The deadline for the first round is **7:00AM PST on Friday, October 23, 2026** . All applications received before this date are guaranteed to be read while there is a spot open. After this date we will still be accepting applications received by December 1, however preference will be given to first round applications. Applicants with Optional Practical Training (OPT) temporary employment authorization are eligible to apply. Depending on the circumstances, Stanford may sponsor J\-1 visas for this position. There is a two\-step process to be considered for this fellowship: * Please submit your resume and cover letter when you apply through Stanford’s career site – reference job number: 201247 * Additionally, upload all of the following here https://reglab.stanford.edu/work\-with\-us/. * Brief cover letter explaining your interest in the position * Current resume or CV * Transcript (unofficial version acceptable) * Writing/code sample * Contact information for no fewer than two academic references who can attest to your academic research skills and for any additional references who can speak to your character and professional skills **Core Duties** : * Collect, manage and clean datasets. * Employ new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize multivariate relationships in data. * Create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical models, and perform statistical analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements. * Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and determine root cause for data problems from input errors or inadequate field edits, and suggest possible solutions. * Develop reports, charts, graphs and tables for use by investigators and for publication and presentation. * Analyze data processes in documentation. * Collaborate with faculty and research staff on data collection and analysis methods. * Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff. * Communicate with government officials, grant agencies and industry representatives. **Minimum Education** : Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and relevant experience. **Minimum Experience** : Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics or engineering. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** : * Substantial experience with MS Office and analytical programs. * Strong writing and analytical skills. * Ability to prioritize workload.
